jobs.title: Senior Materials & Processes Engineer, Welding
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Materials and NDE (Non-Destructive Evaluation) team plays a central role in enabling Terran R to fly, re-fly, and scale: developing, characterizing, and inspecting materials and processes across all parts of the vehicle. From welding and additive manufacturing to advanced composites, the team works at the intersection of innovation and execution, balancing performance and reliability with cost, quality, and schedule. As we move toward first flight and beyond, the challenges become more exciting, offering opportunities to shape how we design and develop for re-use. With ownership across products, systems, and disciplines, engineers gain broad exposure and drive key decisions across design, manufacturing, and operations.

About the Role:

• Be the M&P discipline expert for all weld materials & processes at Relativity Space

• Qualify weld materials and products for flight + reuse

• Drive system level requirements and workflows to qualify welded products for damage tolerant design, inspection, flight, and reuse

• Develop, implement, and maintain technical specifications and engineering standards for weld materials & processes

• Drive weld development + optimization in partnership with weld engineering

• Interface with: Weld Engineering to qualify and iterate weld processes Materials engineering product owners to qualify weld process usage through full product lifecycle, including failure analysis (part concept to retirement) Laboratory staff to characterize weld materials and processes Design Engineers for weld properties + allowables integration in product analysis and design Manufacturing Engineers to reduce cost + rate while maintaining needed performance from our weld materials Quality assurance to facilitate specification compliance validation across all weld processes Relativity + Customer Fracture Control Boards to achieve vehicle reuse with welded products Company Leadership to elevate risks and power through roadblocks

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in materials science or engineering, or related field

• 5+ years of relevant materials engineering experience Leveling is flexible and will be adjusted for candidates with more experience

• Experience in process-structure-property-performance problem solving to weld materials

• Experience with general aerospace hardware M&P activities, such as material selection, weld process development and qualification, damage tolerance, inspections, risk assessments, and failure analysis

• A core commitment to accountability, collaboration, and execution

• A desire to establish and foster strong interdisciplinary relationships across the company

• An authentic, introspective, and inclusive mindset towards technical, interpersonal, team growth, and development

• Passion to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment on constantly iterating launch vehicle products, driving big impact on critical program needs as we ramp manufacturing rate + achieve reuse

Nice to haves, but not required:

• Industry-leading experience in weld materials & processes for production of reusable aerospace parts

• Expertise in aerospace friction stir + fusion welding (Laser Welding, Orbital Tube Welding, EBW, GTAW, GMAW, etc.) and downstream effected processes (heat treat, coatings, passivation, precision cleaning, etc.)

• Expertise in applying AWS D17.1, D17.2, or internally developed requirements for weld process qualification of nickel, ferrous, aluminum, or titanium metal alloy systems

• Expertise in welded aerospace products (tubes, bellows, additively manufactured parts, plate/sheet/bar, forgings, castings)

• Knowledge of relevant materials engineering disciplines (media compatibility, non-destructive evaluation, corrosion, fatigue and damage tolerance)

• Expertise in statistical experimental design and design allowable calculation methodology

Sono Bello is America's top cosmetic surgery specialist, with 185+ board-certified surgeons who have performed over 300,000 laser liposuction and body contouring procedures. A career at Sono Bello means being part of a dynamic and high-energy work environment where every team member can make a difference. We love what we do, and it shows! We believe everyone deserves to have their best body today and pursue their best life now.

The Registered Nurse is responsible for delivering excellent patient care first and foremost, coordinating and ensuring a safe and compliant working environment, assisting in surgical procedures, ensuring accurate and complete patient charting, conducting pre- and post-operative visits, and fostering a spirit of teamwork.

Qualifications:

• A.D.N. or B.S.N. required; active Compact Nursing License accepted in lieu of state-specific licensure.

• Maintains active license and meets renewal requirements.

• Current ACLS certification

• Proficient in MS Office and EMR systems

Key Responsibilities:
Patient Care & Clinical Duties:

• Conduct pre/post-op assessments, patient education, and wound evaluations

• Support physicians during procedures; monitor patient vitals and safety

• Administer and document medications; monitor lidocaine use and antibiotic prophylaxis

• Preference to have Post Op and/or OR Circulator experience. Not required, will train on job.

Safety, Compliance & Infection Control:

• Leads emergency drills, maintains Banyan Stat Kit and AED checks

• Enforces HIPAA, PHI protections, and proper documentation

• Conducts narcotic counts and monitors medication security

Quality & Records Management:

• Maintains accurate and timely patient records in compliance with AAAHC

• Participates in QA/QI initiatives and peer reviews

• Ensures timely documentation, incident reporting, and follow-ups

Leadership & Communication:

• Assists with RN/LPN interviews and staff evaluations

• Educates staff on safety protocols and clinical procedures

• Collaborates with Practice Manager to ensure adequate medical staffing

Operational Support:

• Maintains sterile field and proper OR setup

• Oversees equipment sterilization, stock levels, and clinic readiness

• Completes daily/weekly logs and inspections per protocol

Physical Requirements:

• Able to lift 25 lbs., stand/walk for extended periods

• Visual/hearing acuity and stress tolerance required

Note: This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role but is not intended to be all-inclusive. Additional tasks may be assigned, and existing responsibilities may be modified or removed as necessary to meet operational needs, within the scope of the individual’s role, licensure, and applicable regulatory standards.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Job Title: Software Engineer II, Data Analytics and Engineering

Intro: We’re looking for a Software Engineer II, Data Analytics and Engineering to improve the quality, reliability and velocity of data science and product development at Pinterest. You’ll build scalable data foundations, analytics tooling and analysis pipelines that enable trusted, self-service access to datasets, insights and metric investigations across cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do:

• Develop and document practical instrumentation and experimentation standards, then partner with product engineering teams to apply them to priority product development work.

• Maintain clear documentation for tools, datasets, metrics and operating practices to make team data assets easier to use.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to communicate actionable insights and inform product improvements.

• Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping and iteration, while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness, quality and responsible use.

What we’re looking for:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience delivering analytics engineering or data solutions in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

• Experience using SQL and Python, R or a comparable programming language to work with large, high-dimensional datasets, including nested data structures, window functions, query optimization and data partitioning.

• Experience building and operating data workflows, including workflow orchestration, ETL/ELT pipelines and DAG dependencies across complex datasets.

• Experience translating open-ended partner needs into clear, impactful technical objectives and collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in day-to-day engineering workflows.

• Strong track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work through testing, data validation, source-checking or peer review.

• High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Director of Patient Care Services – Home Health
jobs.description:
Director of Patient Care Services

Join our team as Director of Patient Care Services and lead clinical excellence across our home health services.

$10,000 Sign-On Bonus! Join our team and receive a $10,000 sign-on bonus, subject to eligibility and applicable terms and conditions.

We are seeking an experienced and compassionate Registered Nurse leader to serve as our Director of Patient Care Services. In this key leadership role, you will provide clinical direction and operational oversight while ensuring patients receive safe, high-quality, compassionate, and compliant care.

You will work closely with clinical, operations, quality, and leadership teams to drive strong patient outcomes, support and develop clinicians, maintain regulatory readiness, and create a positive experience for both patients and employees.

What You’ll Do

As Director of Patient Care Services, you will:

• Provide clinical leadership and oversight of daily home health patient care operations.

• Ensure care is delivered in accordance with professional standards, agency policies, and applicable state and federal regulations.

• Oversee the coordination and management of patient care from referral and admission through ongoing assessment, care planning, transfers, and discharge.

• Ensure individualized plans of care are developed, implemented, evaluated, and appropriately documented.

• Review and approve OASIS documentation as required.

• Supervise, coach, mentor, and develop clinical leaders and field staff to promote competency, accountability, and professional growth.

• Ensure clinicians maintain required licensure, training, competencies, and compliance standards.

• Lead quality and compliance initiatives, including QAPI, incident investigations, corrective action plans, accreditation, survey readiness, and audit response.

• Monitor clinical performance, patient outcomes, patient satisfaction, and workflow metrics and develop improvement strategies when needed.

• Partner with operations and leadership on staffing, productivity, resource allocation, and on-call coverage.

• Provide clinical leadership during emergency preparedness planning, response, and post-event review.

• Serve as a clinical resource and escalation point for complex patient, caregiver, and staff concerns.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a confident, collaborative clinical leader who is passionate about quality patient care and developing others.

Minimum Qualifications

• Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of practice.

• Current CPR certification.

• Minimum of 2 years of home health experience.

• Clinical leadership, management, or supervisory experience preferred.

• Strong knowledge of home health clinical practices, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.

• Strong communication, organizational, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to effectively coach and support clinical teams while maintaining accountability for performance and outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

As Director of Patient Care Services, you will have a direct impact on the quality of care we provide to our patients and the success of the clinicians who serve them. This is an opportunity to combine your clinical expertise, leadership skills, and passion for patient-centered care to help shape a high-performing home health program.

If you are an experienced home health RN leader who is ready to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today to join our team!

Pay Range for Posted Region

$130,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.title: Sr Analytics Analyst- Inbound Logistics
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The Sr. Analytics Analyst designs, develops, and continuously enhances analytics solutions that transform inbound logistics and customs compliance data into trusted, business-ready insights that support operational execution and strategic decision-making. Working collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders, the Sr.  Analytics Analyst translates business requirements into scalable analytics solutions that improve visibility and decision-making for operational, managerial, and executive leadership. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role is responsible for the continuous evolution of the department's analytics ecosystem by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, strengthen analytics capabilities, and support the organization's evolving operational and strategic objectives.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Translate Operational Data into Actionable Insights: Analyze and transform inbound logistics and customs compliance data into meaningful, business-ready insights that improve operational visibility, identify trends and opportunities, and support strategic and operational planning.
• Enable Informed Decision-Making: Provide timely, accurate, and trusted analytics that enable stakeholders to monitor performance, evaluate opportunities, respond to operational challenges, and make informed business decisions.
• Deliver Scalable Analytics Solutions: Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable analytics solutions, dashboards, reports, data models, and visualizations that expand self-service access to trusted information and adapt to evolving business requirements.
• Improve Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to streamline business processes, reduce manual effort, eliminate repetitive tasks, automate reporting, and improve operational productivity through data-driven solutions.
• Curate Business-Ready Datasets: Consolidate, cleanse, validate, and transform logistics and customs compliance data into trusted, reusable datasets that provide a consistent foundation for reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
• Automate Analytics Workflows: Develop automated data pipelines, workflows, and reporting processes that improve efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and support recurring analytics and operational reporting activities.
• Ensure Data Quality and Reporting Standards: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve data governance practices, business rules, metric definitions, and reporting standards to ensure consistent, accurate, and reliable analytics across the organization.
• Partner Across Business Functions: Build collaborative relationships with Operations, Transportation, Customs Compliance, Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and other business partners to understand operational challenges and translate stakeholder requirements into impactful analytics solutions.
• Champion Analytics Adoption: Drive the successful adoption of analytics solutions by engaging stakeholders, incorporating user feedback, providing user support and training, and promoting data-driven decision-making throughout the organization.
• Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen analytics capabilities and improve business processes by evaluating emerging technologies, implementing analytics best practices, and recommending innovative solutions that enhance organizational performance.
• Support Strategic Business Initiatives: Lead and support cross-functional analytics projects, operational improvement initiatives, executive reporting, and strategic analyses that align with business objectives and deliver measurable value.
• Perform Other Duties as Assigned: Complete additional responsibilities and special projects in support of departmental and organizational objectives.
• Other Responsibilities: As Assigned by Manager

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Five (5) or more years of experience designing, developing, and delivering analytics solutions supporting logistics, transportation, customs compliance, supply chain, distribution, or other operational business functions.
• Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions through the development of business-ready datasets, automated data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytics workflows.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

• Strong knowledge of modern analytics technologies supporting data integration, automation, cloud-based analytics, and data visualization, including advanced SQL, Incorta, Tableau, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Python, APIs, or comparable technologies.
• Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform complex operational data into meaningful business insights that drive decision-making.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and build effective cross-functional partnerships.
• Experience supporting analytics for global logistics, transportation, customs compliance, import/export operations, or other supply chain functions.
• Ability to evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance analytics capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support business process optimization.
• Demonstrated growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and willingness to improve processes through new methods and technologies.

PREFFERED SKILLS

• Master's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.

What It’s Like to Work Here:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Thermal Engineer, Thermal Protection Systems (TPS)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team enables Anduril's rapid hardware development cycle by ensuring advanced defense systems perform reliably in demanding real-world environments. The team works across high-power, tightly integrated products where thermal architecture, analysis, testing, and cross-functional design decisions directly affect product performance, reliability, and mission success.

About the Role

We are looking for a Thermal Engineer specializing in Thermal Protection Systems (TPS) to join our team. In this role, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of thermal protection for hypersonic and high-speed flight systems operating in extreme aerothermal environments.

This role is ideal for someone with deep expertise in aerothermal heating, ablative material response, and high-temperature thermal analysis — someone who can work across first-principles hand calculations, material response modeling, and detailed CFD to guide fast, high-consequence design decisions for systems where thermal survival is the critical constraint.

What You'll Do

• Own TPS design, material selection, and thermal analysis for hypersonic and high-speed flight vehicles, including missiles, reentry systems, and advanced flight platforms.

• Perform aerothermal heating analysis using engineering correlations, boundary-layer methods, and CFD to define the thermal environment across flight trajectories.

• Conduct ablation and material response modeling to predict TPS recession, in-depth thermal response, and structural thermal margins under mission-representative conditions.

• Evaluate and select TPS materials, including carbon phenolic, PICA, silicone-based ablators, ceramics, and high-temperature composites, based on aerothermal loads, mass constraints, and manufacturability.

• Partner with aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and systems engineers to integrate TPS into vehicle design while managing mass, volume, and performance tradeoffs.

• Define and execute thermal and material characterization tests, including arcjet testing, furnace testing, and instrumented flight-article thermal testing.

• Build and maintain thermal models spanning hand calculations through detailed FEA/CFD to predict system performance, establish design limits, and support qualification.

• Present TPS status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations in internal design reviews and customer-facing technical reviews.

• Support failure reviews and root-cause investigations using test data, thermal analysis, and first-principles reasoning.

Required Qualifications

• MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field with a focus on aerothermodynamics, heat transfer, thermal sciences, or materials science.

• 2+ years of experience in TPS design, aerothermal analysis, or high-temperature material response for aerospace or defense systems.

• Strong first-principles understanding of aerodynamic heating, ablation, high-temperature heat transfer, and material thermal response.

• Experience with material response modeling tools such as FIAT, CMA, TITAN, or equivalent ablation/thermal response codes.

• Experience supporting thermal design for hypersonic vehicles, reentry systems, missiles, rocket nozzles, or other systems operating in extreme aerothermal environments.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with aerothermal CFD tools such as DPLR, US3D, Loci-CHEM, CFD++, ANSYS Fluent, or STAR-CCM+ for high-speed reacting flow analysis.

• Experience with arcjet testing, thermal characterization testing, or flight-article thermal instrumentation.

• Experience with high-temperature materials including carbon phenolic, carbon-carbon, PICA, SLA-561V, silicone-based ablators, or ceramic matrix composites.

• Experience with radiation modeling tools such as NEQAIR, HARA, or equivalent nonequilibrium radiation solvers.

• Experience using MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for trajectory-based heating analysis, thermal margin assessment, or engineering trade studies.

• Familiarity with NASA TPS heritage tools and databases (TPSX, CEA, CBAero).

• Experience supporting PDR/CDR, qualification testing, or flight programs.

• Strong motivation to support Anduril's mission of defending the United States and allied partners.

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Payroll Calculation
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the payroll calculation team

Payroll is one of the most mission-critical systems a company runs. It has to be correct, compliant, explainable, scalable, and trusted by every employee who depends on it. At Rippling, payroll is also one of our biggest product and engineering frontiers: we’re expanding upmarket to serve much larger companies, scaling internationally across new jurisdictions, and rebuilding core calculation infrastructure for a future where payroll is more automated, transparent, and intelligent.

The Payroll Calculation team owns the systems that determine earnings, deductions, taxes, loans, garnishments, pensions, contributions, and jurisdiction-specific payroll logic. These systems sit at the intersection of distributed systems, product engineering, compliance, data modeling, and customer experience. A great payroll calculation platform does more than produce the right number; it helps admins and internal teams understand why that number is right.

As Rippling serves larger enterprise customers and expands native payroll into more countries, the team is building the technical foundation for payroll at global scale. That means designing calculation frameworks that are configurable, versioned, auditable, debuggable, and explainable, while evolving the architecture to support dramatically more volume and complexity.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead this work. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to build mission-critical systems, set architectural direction, develop exceptional teams, and make payroll accurate, understandable, and dependable at global scale.

What you will do

• Lead architecture and technical strategy for Rippling’s payroll calculation systems.
• Write critical production code and lead from the front on high-impact technical initiatives.
• Design frameworks that make payroll logic configurable, versioned, testable, explainable, scalable, and easy to debug.
• Leverage AI to make payroll logic easier to build, validate, explain, and operate, without compromising accuracy, auditability, or control.
• Build systems that support enterprise-scale payroll for large employers with complex legal-entity structures and approval workflows.
• Help expand Rippling’s native payroll capabilities across new countries and jurisdictions.
• Drive improvements in distributed systems, database performance, caching, reliability, and operability.
• Partner cross-functionally with product, design, payroll operations, HRIS, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end customer outcomes.
• Mentor senior and mid-level engineers across payroll calculation areas such as platform, earnings, deductions, taxes, and jurisdiction-specific logic.

What you will need

• Staff-level experience designing and scaling complex production systems where correctness and auditability are critical.
• Strong engineering fundamentals across architecture, data modeling, distributed systems, databases, caching, and reliability.
• A track record of setting technical direction and leading complex initiatives across multiple teams.
• Strong product judgment and the ability to connect platform decisions to customer outcomes.
• Excellent communication skills and comfort driving alignment across engineering, product, and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly.
• Payroll experience is helpful but not required. We value engineers who have worked on other high-integrity domains where correctness, auditability, and customer trust are essential.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
$127B industry. 14,000 advisors on Tern today, 20,000 by year end. We've grown 4x in the last year. An industry so tight that everyone talks to each other, resulting in Tern quickly becoming the system agencies trust to run their business on. 

You will work directly with the Head of Sales and the COO, sitting close to the largest deals in the industry. You get a chance to build a business, to help others build businesses, to ultimately help people travel- one of the most fundamentally life changing things you can experience.

We are the best platform, now we need someone to own our mid-market deals the way they deserve to be run.



ABOUT TERN

Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it.

Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations, giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel.

But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of.

At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both.





ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

Agencies use Tern to run their business: client profiles, supplier connections, commissions, back-office accounting, and the reporting an owner needs to know how the business is actually doing. That has changed what the sale is. You are not selling a nicer front office to a solo advisor. You are selling an operating system to an agency owner, their operations lead, and the person who reconciles commissions every month. All three have to say yes.

The travel advisor market is finite and tightly networked. Agencies talk to each other in communities, at conferences, and in group threads. That shapes how we sell: researched, named accounts rather than volume; a documented reason to reach out before the first touch; a no that is honored. The reps who win here are the ones agencies want to hear from again.

This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying role. You source, you run discovery, you demo the whole platform including accounting, you build the coalition inside the account, you close full commitments, and you hand a complete record to implementation. Post-sale support is not your job. Adding revenue is.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a named book of agencies. Build and maintain a researched list of target agencies, typically 10 to 100+ advisors. Every account has a documented entry path before you reach out: a Tern user already inside the agency, a referral, a community or consortium connection, a real engagement signal, or specific research on their business.

Run every deal as a multithreaded deal. Map the account. Engage the economic buyer, the operations or back-office lead, and advisor-level users. Map who signs, who blocks, who champions. Get the signer on a call. Build a deal room with dates the customer has agreed to. Deal size does not change the standard.

Sell the whole platform, including the back office. Run discovery with an agency's accounting or finance stakeholder on your own. Demo commissions, reconciliation, and supplier statements with confidence. Quantify what Tern is worth to the agency in dollars, not features.

Quarterback Deals. Bring product, implementation, SMEs or leadership into a deal with a written brief beforehand so the call does real work. You run the deal. You get the right people in the room at the right time and drive to close.

Close full commitments. Sell the whole cohort of seats up front, with staged billing where it helps the customer. Create urgency from real consequences: kickoff dates, implementation capacity, the customer's own timeline. Never from invented ones.

Forecast with precision. Weekly forecast submitted on time, every open deal complete in HubSpot, pipeline coverage maintained against target. Predictable attainment quarter after quarter, not a big month followed by two empty ones.

Hand off cleanly. A complete HubSpot record and a scoped implementation plan at close. Then implementation owns the relationship and you go find the next agency.

Feed the loop. Closed-lost reasons, recurring objections, and product gaps go back to marketing and R&D in a form they can act on.



WHAT YOU HAVE

Consistent quota attainment in full-cycle B2B SaaS. 3+ years closing, ideally at least mid-market. You can show quarter-over-quarter attainment, not one big quarter and a story about the rest.

Experience selling something operational. Systems of record, vertical SaaS, ERP, accounting or commissions tooling, anything where the buyer's back office had a vote. You can learn what accrual accounting means for an agency and explain it in plain language.

A multithreading track record. You have closed deals that required an owner, an operator, and end users to all say yes, and you can walk through exactly how you got there.

Discovery depth. You uncover the real problem, quantify what it costs, and tie the solution back to dollars. You ask the question that gets a true answer instead of a polite one.

Pipeline rigor as a habit. HubSpot is complete because that is how you work, not because someone asked. Your forecast is accurate. Your next steps have dates.

Judgment in a small market. You know when to stop. You write like a person, not a template. You understand that one burned prospect in a tight community costs more than one deal.

You implement coaching. Feedback shows up in your next call, not your next quarter.



HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - Travel industry experience, especially with host agencies or consortia

 - Vertical SaaS with an accounting or commissions component

 - Account-based selling in a defined market

 - Experience running mutual action plans or deal rooms

 - Fluency with AI tools for research and call prep (research with AI, write as yourself)



HOW THIS ROLE IS MEASURED

 - Monthly MRR quota, with accelerators above quota and GMV-based bonuses once quota is met

 - Pipeline coverage against target, built from named accounts

 - Weekly: forecast submitted on time, every open deal complete in HubSpot

 - Deal quality on named accounts: stakeholders engaged, buying roles documented, signer on a call, deal room with agreed dates

 - Full-seat commitments at close

 - Certification on the Tern platform, including accounting, within your first 60 days



WHAT WE VALUE @ TERN

🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity.

🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve.

💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust.

Operating Principles:

👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in.

➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now".

📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego.

🏃 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality.

🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last.



WHY JOIN TERN?

 - Be part of a mission-driven team transforming the travel planning space

 - Work with a supportive, curious, and creative team

 - Sell a product that agencies run their business on, to buyers who care about the outcome

 - Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package

Tern is committed to building a team that represents people from many different backgrounds and life experiences, reflecting our worldview coinciding with the users and customers we serve across the world. We prefer that you apply, so think of our postings as the start of the conversation. Take the chance, you may be a wonderful add to our Tern team, even if you don't fully match every requirement on the job description.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer (Optical Comms)
jobs.description:
About Apolink

Apolink is building the first-ever backward-compatible data relay constellation in low Earth orbit. By enabling efficient data aggregation and relay through our hybrid RF-optical inter-satellite link (ISL) architecture, we support scalable and resilient space infrastructure across commercial, federal, and defense applications.


About The Role:

The Chief Engineer (Optical) is the company’s technical lead for optical communications across our LEO data relay constellation. They own the optical architecture, requirements, link design, and verification, and lead technical decisions with our optical terminal vendor. The vendor handles terminal manufacturing, while this role remains hands-on with analysis, integration, and testing. This is a sole-contributor leadership role.



Responsibilities:

 - Own optical ISL and feeder-link architecture: wavelength plan, modulation and coding, aperture and divergence sizing, data rate vs range tradespace.

 - Develop and maintain end-to-end optical link budgets, including coherent receiver sensitivity, PAT margin, platform jitter, point-ahead, Doppler, stray light, fade statistics, and BER against realistic FEC.

 - Author optical requirements and ICDs, and manage flowdown to the vendor and to internal bus, flight software, and ground teams.

 - Direct the vendor technically: down-select, diligence, SOW and NRE scoping, design review participation, and accountability for performance and schedule.

 - Adjudicate R&D direction with the vendor; what warrants NRE investment, what is technically unviable, what we buy versus co-develop.

 - May lead a ZR-800G-class coherent transceiver NRE with the optical terminal.

 - Maintain compliance with applicable standards, including CCSDS O3K and SDA OCT where relevant to federal programs.



Qualifications:

 - Direct, hands-on experience with LEO-LEO optical inter-satellite links: designing, building, or verifying crosslink terminals between spacecraft in low Earth orbit.

 - 6+ years in free-space optical communications, coherent optical transport, or spaceborne photonics.

 - MS or PhD in optics, EE, or physics, or equivalent demonstrated depth.

 - Demonstrated experience directing vendor technical performance and NRE programs.

 - Capacity to exercise independent technical judgment as the sole optical authority and be accountable for it.



Preferred:

 - Direct experience with 400ZR, 800ZR, OpenZR+, or OIF coherent pluggables.

 - Flight heritage on an optical comms payload.



Benefits:

 - Competitive salary and benefits package

 - Meaningful early-stage equity

 - Opportunity to own optical for a constellation end to end

 - Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), relocation assistance
   
   Salary: $180,000-$220,000
   
   

Additional Information

To conform to the U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Manager Executive Protection
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly collaborative, discreet, and integrity-driven Executive Protection Manager to join our Global Security & Investigations team. This role is responsible for leading global executive protection and protective intelligence efforts supporting senior leadership, while proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating security risks across travel, workplace, residential, and event environments. The ideal candidate is an experienced risk management professional who combines sound judgment, operational excellence, and strong interpersonal skills to build trusted partnerships across the organization and with external stakeholders worldwide. This position requires a strategic yet hands-on leader capable of managing complex security operations, coordinating crisis response activities, and driving continuous improvement in executive protection programs, policies, and training while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, collaboration, and ethical conduct.

What Your Impact Will Be:

EP Security Operations and Emergency Response

• Partner with internal stakeholders, Executive Assistants, Human Resources, Facilities, Legal, Travel, and other cross-functional teams to ensure safe, secure, and seamless operations related to executive workplace safety and security initiatives.
• Lead executive workplace physical security monitoring and response in coordination with overall site security team.
• Manage C-suite emergency response protocols and ensure readiness for security incidents involving senior leadership.
• Engage closely in global crisis management efforts, including emergency response, executive protection and communications during incidents.
• Develop and implement incident detection, escalation, and resolution policies aligned with Global Security operations.
• Provide strategic oversight for executive protection incidents, while collaborating with operational teams responsible for daily execution.

Risk Assessment, Protective Intelligence and Threat Management

• Conduct threat, vulnerability, and risk assessments related to executives, residences, workplaces, events, and travel associated with executive protection operations.
• Perform protective intelligence activities, including social media and open-source monitoring, insider threat evaluations, executive threat profiling, and pre-incident indicator analysis, independently and in coordination with Global Security Intelligence and Corporate Communications teams.
• Develop and implement tailored security plans, risk mitigation strategies, and protective measures supporting executive protection operations globally.
• Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of executive protection policies, standards, procedures, and best practices aligned with corporate security objectives and industry standards.
• Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor on executive protection, protective intelligence, and threat management matters across the organization.
• Build and maintain relationships with external industry partners, security providers, intelligence resources, and law enforcement agencies to support threat identification, risk mitigation, and executive safety initiatives.

Executive Travel Security

• Conduct advance security assessments for domestic and international travel, particularly in elevated-risk environments, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending appropriate protective measures and security protocols.
• Develop and implement executive travel security plans, contingency procedures, and emergency response protocols for travel and special events.
• Plan and coordinate travel security arrangements for senior leadership (SVP and above) when traveling to high-risk locations, including transportation, accommodations, medical support, and emergency response resources.
• Coordinate with internal department members, international security providers, law enforcement, hotels, transportation vendors, and internal stakeholders to support safe and secure executive travel globally.
• Maintain real-time awareness of travel risks, geopolitical developments, civil unrest, crime trends, and other emerging threats that may impact executive movements or business operations.
• Provide protective intelligence support and travel briefings to executives and key stakeholders prior to travel.

Policy Development, Compliance, and Governance

• Develop, implement, and maintain global executive protection policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks aligned with legal requirements, corporate policies, and industry best practices.
• Utilize intelligence analysis, operational metrics, and data-driven insights to enhance protective operations, risk mitigation, and program effectiveness.
• Maintain accurate and confidential documentation related to executive protection operations, incident reporting, threat assessments, travel security activities, and risk mitigation efforts.
• Ensure executive protection programs and operational practices align with enterprise security frameworks, corporate risk management objectives, and broader Global Security strategies.
• Develop and support long-term initiatives to strengthen executive protection capabilities, operational readiness, and integration with global security programs.

Vendor and Security Program Management

• Manage third-party executive protection vendors, including vendor selection, contract oversight, performance management, and the development of standardized KPIs to ensure service quality, operational effectiveness, and risk mitigation.
• Coordinate on the selection, management, and operational oversight of CCW (armed security) providers, ensuring alignment with Global Security standards, executive protection requirements, and applicable legal regulations.
• Support executive protection-related procurement activities, budgeting, and expense management in accordance with Mattel policies and financial controls.

Training and Program Development

• Develop and deliver executive protection training programs focused on protective operations, threat recognition, situational awareness, emergency response, and security best practices.
• Recruit, train, mentor, and support the professional development of executive protection personnel, drivers, and security analysts.
• Establish continuous improvement initiatives, training standards, and career development pathways to strengthen overall executive protection program capabilities and operational readiness.
• Partner with Global Security leadership to support executive and C-suite Workplace Violence Prevention Program (WVPP), active threat, and crisis response training initiatives.

Leadership and Organizational Impact

• Manage Security Analyst’s responsibilities for threat monitoring, protective intelligence, risk analysis, and executive protection planning.
• Oversee executive driver operations and executive protection vehicle resources in coordination with Executive Assistants and other key stakeholders.
• Collaborate with GSOC leadership and operational teams to support executive protection operations, intelligence sharing, incident response, and monitoring capabilities.
• Partner with regional and international Global Security leadership to coordinate executive travel security and regional executive protection programs globally.
• Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and trusted advisor to leadership on executive protection, threat management, and protective operations.
• Provide leadership, mentoring, coaching, and professional development opportunities for security professionals and analysts.
• Maintain a professional executive-level appearance and demeanor, serving as a positive representative of the Global Security organization and a role model for the team

Reporting and Communication

• Provide daily and weekly reports and briefings to senior leadership on plans, incidents, risk assessments, and executive protection operations.
• Maintain strong communication and effective collaboration with executives, Executive Assistants, internal stakeholders, and external security partners to support seamless protective operations.
• Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive security assessments, intelligence summaries, and risk analyses to support informed decision-making and operational planning.
• Ensure timely and accurate reporting of security incidents within Mattel’s Security Incident Management system, including oversight and quality review of subordinate reporting, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Continuous Improvement

• Benchmark security practices against peer organizations, industry leaders, and government security standards through participation in professional organizations and partnerships.
• Conduct post-incident and monthly operation reviews to develop corrective action and continuous improvement plans.

What We’re Looking For:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in related fields such as Criminal Justice, Security Management, Business Administration or other fields.
• Minimum 5 years in executive protection, corporate security, military, or law enforcement; and 3 or more years of managerial or supervisory experience.
• Skills: Strong collaborative leadership skills and team management. Deep observational, analytical, and crisis management abilities; expertise in security, communication and collaboration technologies. Open-source Intelligence analysis, Strong communication ability both written and verbal.
• Attributes: Professional demeanor, discretion, adaptability, confidentiality, and integrity in handling sensitive information.
• Certifications: Proficiency in first aid, defensive driving, evasive driving
• Ability to navigate and manage under high stress situations.
• Travel Requirements: Willingness, availability and ability to travel frequently and on short notice. Adaptable to work evenings weekends and on holidays depending on need.

Preferred:

• CCW certification
• Specialized certification in security or protection: Examples could include Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Executive Protection Specialist (EPS) or similar international certifications.
• Global experience, multi-lingual and a strong geographic understanding.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance & Investment Banking Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THNDR



Thndr is Egypt's leading digital retail investment platform and the country's first investment supermarket. We were ranked the number one fastest growing company in Africa in the 2026 Statista and Financial Times ranking, the first Egyptian company to top the list, and we're the number one brokerage in Egypt, with close to 6 million downloads and more than US$1 billion in customer assets. We were admitted as the first ever remote trading member of the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange, have received in-principle approval from the Saudi Capital Market Authority, and are backed by some of the most prominent global and regional venture capital investors.




ABOUT THE ROLE



We're building a Finance function capable of supporting Egypt's Home for Deposits and the MENA region's Home for Active Trading. You'll help build our FP&A capability from the ground up: the group model, the budget and reforecast cycle, monthly performance reporting, and the unit economics the leadership team runs the business on. Alongside that sits Strategic Finance — being the finance partner on decisions. Pricing and revenue model design, new product and market business cases, partnership economics, capital allocation, and corporate development. Wherever a decision hinges on a number nobody has built yet, that's your work. You'll also own investor and board reporting and support our fundraising, which means the numbers you build don't just inform internal decisions — they're what our investors and board see.

You'll also play a key supporting role in building our Investment Banking 2.0. Egypt's productive economy is far larger than its investable economy, and a great deal of real economic activity has no route to public or retail capital. We're building the capability to change that: originating retail-first investment products, and advising the businesses traditional capital markets underserve, including startups and SMEs. Think of it as investment banking pointed at underserved segments. You'll be part of building that from scratch — structuring, modelling, underwriting analysis and advisory work.

You'll report to the Group Head of Finance and the Head of Investment Banking, and work directly with the founders, the board and our investors. Both functions are being built from the ground up, and you'll be central to getting them there.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

FP&A

 - Own and build the group business plan and strategic financial plan as the single source of truth for planning, board and investor reporting, and fundraising

 - Establish and run the annual budget and quarterly reforecast cycle with business and functional leads

 - Produce monthly performance reporting: actuals versus budget and forecast, variance analysis, and a clear read on what's driving the business

 - Build visibility on unit economics, revenue drivers and cost drivers — acquisition cost, revenue per funded account, contribution margin by product and market — and turn it into a framework the business runs on

 - Own cash, runway and scenario forecasting, flagging inflection points before they arrive

Strategic Finance

 - Build the financial case behind pricing and revenue model decisions, including commission structures, fee design and partnership economics

 - Model new product and new market business cases, including the financials behind regulatory applications

 - Support corporate development: opportunity screening, valuation, structuring and diligence

 - Run capital allocation analysis and support prioritisation decisions across the business

 - Build visibility on the cost base and identify where spend can be optimised without slowing the business down

Investor Relations

 - Own investor reporting: the monthly and quarterly updates, KPI packs and metrics our investors receive, delivered on a reliable cadence

 - Own board reporting — the board pack, the supporting analysis, and the numbers behind every discussion in the room

 - Support fundraising end to end: the model, the data room, diligence responses, and investor-facing materials

 - Be a point of contact for investor questions and ad-hoc information requests, and turn them around fast

 - Maintain the cap table and track shareholder and reporting obligations

Investment Banking

 - Support the origination of new investment products: structuring, financial modelling, underwriting analysis and risk assessment

 - Build valuation and transaction models for prospective issuers and portfolio opportunities

 - Support advisory mandates for startups, SMEs and other businesses preparing to access capital

 - Prepare investment memos, committee papers and client-facing materials

 - Contribute to the investment framework, governance and risk limits as the function is stood up




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 3–5 years in investment banking, analyst 3 through associate level — time in a genuine deal environment is the core requirement

 - Exceptional financial modelling skills

 - Command of valuation across methodologies, and the judgement to know which one the situation calls for

 - Strong three-statement fundamentals and the ability to build fully linked operating models

 - Experience running or supporting live transactions end to end

 - Track record producing IC memos, pitch materials, IMs, board packs or equivalent to institutional standard

 - Strong educational and academic background; CFA a strong plus

Nice to have

 - Structuring or origination experience — real estate, private placements, debt, securitisation, or equity capital markets

 - ECM or IPO execution experience, including regulatory documentation and prospectus work

 - Fintech, brokerage or asset management experience

 - Egyptian or MENA capital markets experience

 - Regional exposure — experience across GCC or wider MENA markets, or on cross-border transactions

 - SME or startup advisory exposure

 - CFA charterholder or candidate

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Delivery
jobs.description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

$135,000 - $180,000
Full-time / Onsite SF or NY (5 days/week) / ~25% Travel

About The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Agent Delivery to deploy production AI agents inside some of the world’s largest supply chain companies.

You’ll work directly with customer operators, engineers, and executives to understand how critical workflows actually run. Then you’ll design integrations, debug production systems, and ship AI-powered workflows into environments that are often undocumented, fragmented, and business-critical.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer operations. You’ll own deployments from initial discovery through production launch, spending time with customers both remotely and onsite, solving complex operational problems and turning those solutions into reusable product capabilities.

Success in this role is measured by outcomes: can you get systems live, make them reliable, and solve problems in environments you don’t fully control? Every deployment teaches us something new about how supply chain companies operate. The patterns you uncover become product features, and what you solve for one customer often becomes a capability we ship across the platform.

The impact you will have

• Production Agent Delivery: Lead high-impact customer deployments from problem definition through production. Design and build production-grade AI agents, workflows, integrations, and supporting infrastructure that solve real customer problems and operate reliably at scale.

• Transformational Customer Impact: Partner with customers to identify workflows where AI agents can fundamentally change how work gets done. Own the technical delivery from end-to-end design and prototyping through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and iteration.

• Turn Ambiguity into Working Software: Embed deeply in customer workflows, understand how their teams and systems actually operate, and translate messy business requirements into clear technical solutions. Move quickly from an idea or manual process to a production system delivering measurable value.

• Own the Architecture: Make architecture and design decisions across agent behavior, application logic, data, integrations, evaluations, security, and reliability. Ensure solutions meet customer requirements while establishing strong patterns for how Pallet agents should be deployed in production.

• Integrate Into the Customer Stack: Connect Pallet agents to the systems, data, APIs, and tools customers already rely on. Work directly with customer engineering and operations teams to navigate technical constraints and make Pallet a reliable part of their production workflows.

• Own Production Outcomes: Stay accountable beyond the initial build. Debug failures, improve agent quality, evaluate performance, and work across Pallet Engineering and Product to rapidly resolve issues that stand between a customer and a successful deployment.

• Customer Immersion: Build relationships across the customer organization, from technical ICs and operators to executives. Develop a deep understanding of their workflows, constraints, and goals so that what you build solves the underlying problem—not just the initial request.

• Build Once, Scale Many Times: Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable agents, integrations, evaluations, frameworks, and implementation patterns. Help Pallet move from bespoke customer work toward repeatable products that can be deployed across many customers.

• Shape the Product: Serve as a tight feedback loop between customers and Pallet’s Product and Engineering teams. Identify recurring needs, product gaps, and opportunities uncovered in the field, and help turn them into improvements to the core Pallet platform.

Who You Are

• 1-3 years of experience building and owning production systems in high-growth startups or similarly demanding environments.

• Strong experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and event-driven architectures.

• Proven ability to debug complex systems in production.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where documentation is incomplete, and requirements evolve quickly.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience working directly with customers is a strong plus

Our Tech Stack

• Backend: Node + TypeScript on Encore.dev. Event-driven design with message passing and queues. Hosted on GCP

• Database: PostgreSQL

• LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for foundation models; fine-tuned models on Vertex AI

• Browser Automation: Playwright

• Frontend: Next.js + React + TypeScript. Hosted on Vercel

• Observability: Datadog for logging and metrics

The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000–$180,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

Our Benefits

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

• 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits

• 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation

• ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance

• ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

• 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff

• 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future

• 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families

• 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend

• 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees

• 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office

• 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space

• 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided

• ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely

• 🥤 Monthly happy hours

• 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@pallet.com.

jobs.title: Senior Thermal Engineer, Expeditionary AI / HPC Data Centers
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Thermal Engineering team's work is essential to support our rapid innovation cycle and maintain the performance and reliability of advanced defense technologies. Thermal Engineers own the full development life cycle from conceptual design through prototyping, lab and field testing, and operational deployment, ensuring high-performance, resilient systems that meet the demands of complex, contested environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Thermal Engineer in Costa Mesa, CA to own the thermal management of expeditionary AI/HPC data centers—air-transportable, modular compute and command-and-control infrastructure built to run at forward operating locations. You will apply a deep understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and HVAC to keep high-density compute running reliably in austere environments with extreme temperatures and limited power.

What You'll Do

• Own the thermal design and analysis of deployable data center cooling systems—air-side and water-side cooling, heat rejection, chilled water plant, and liquid cooling—from rack and chip level up through the full facility.

• Use first principles to discern the right level of analysis, running hand calcs, spreadsheets, and MATLAB/Python first-order models before detailed design.

• Define cooling architecture and heat-rejection strategy—CRAH/CRAC, air-side economization, chilled water plants, dry coolers, CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers, and direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling—to keep equipment within limits as power density scales.

• Develop cooling approaches for high-density racks and trade off air, liquid, and hybrid cooling for modular, transportable systems in austere, high-ambient environments.

• Work with electrical, mechanical, and facilities engineers to characterize IT and equipment heat loads across operating and failure modes.

• Weigh cooling architectures against reliability, efficiency (PUE/WUE), and total cost, driving trade studies that balance thermal margin with capital and operating cost.

• Own the thermal FEA/CFD and system models, predict facility performance, and set red/yellow limits for commissioning and operation.

• Lead prototype builds, field testing, commissioning, and operational validation of cooling designs (CAD, sensor and DAQ selection, data post-processing, results).

• Present thermal status at internal and customer reviews with a clear view of timelines and technical status.

• Develop internal tools to improve analysis effectiveness and efficiency.

• Support failure reviews and root-cause analysis with test data and thermal analysis.

Required Qualifications

• MS or higher in mechanical engineering, applied physics, or related field focused on heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and HVAC

• In-depth understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics

• 5+ years designing thermal management systems for data centers or comparable mission-critical infrastructure

• Full-spectrum data center thermal experience—air-side and water-side cooling, heat rejection, chilled water plant design, power density management, and liquid cooling

• Steady-state and transient system modeling of thermal management systems, including HVAC and refrigerant simulations

• Validating and testing data center thermal equipment, with knowledge of applicable operating standards

• Track record of staying abreast of the latest data center thermal management technologies

• CAD experience with Siemens NX or SolidWorks

Preferred Qualifications

• Coding in Python or MATLAB for applications such as lumped-capacitance steady-state and transient analysis

• Thermal FEA/CFD experience—STAR-CCM+, ANSYS, Icepak or FloEFD.

• Familiarity with efficiency metrics (PUE/WUE) and thermal design for high-density AI/HPC compute

• Experience with modular, transportable, or ruggedized data centers and operation in austere, high-ambient environments

• Be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.
