jobs.title: QA Engineer III, Accessibility - Central QA Ops
jobs.description:
As a QA Engineer, you will work with numerous disciplines to drive quality ownership across the software development life cycle, as well as helping to establish and execute team wide quality goals. It will be important for you to aggressively protect the player experience and deliver results in a high pressure, agile development environment. You will also be accountable as the quality owner of an area or product in addition to identifying and implementing quality improvements to the team’s development process. Additionally, you may partner with and mentor remote QA teams to ensure features are delivered at a high quality bar. Lastly, you will identify and mitigate risks to feature delivery and product quality and craft data to report on the quality of the product and update partners.

As an QA Engineer III on the Accessibility team, you will help ensure that Riot products deliver high-quality, inclusive experiences for players. You will own accessibility quality activities across the product development life cycle, partnering closely with product, engineering, design, UX, research, production, compliance, and QA teams. This role combines hands-on accessibility validation with scalable capability building. You will perform and guide accessibility testing, help teams identify and mitigate risk, and establish repeatable practices, tools, metrics, and training that enable product teams to build accessibility into their work from the start. You will be expected to operate as an accessibility quality subject-matter expert across one or more products or initiatives, influence decisions beyond your immediate team, and contribute to improving how accessibility quality is practiced across Riot. This role reports to the Director of Product Accessibility.

Responsibilities:

• Define accessibility test approaches and integrate them into product QA strategies, test plans, regression processes, and release readiness.

• Plan, execute, and guide manual and automated accessibility testing across games, web, video, and other digital experiences.

• Test with assistive technologies and interaction modalities, including screen readers, keyboard navigation, controller input, and flash-rate testing tools.

• Conduct accessibility audits and regression testing; translate findings into actionable user stories, defects, quality reports, and remediation guidance.

• Triage and prioritize accessibility risks using player impact, severity, likelihood, product context, and release needs.

• Establish quality metrics and use test results, defect trends, and player feedback to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

• Create reusable guidance, tools, checklists, and training that help product teams build accessibility into planning, design, development, and testing.

• Coach QA professionals, external testers, and product partners on accessibility test design, execution, and reporting.

• Communicate accessibility quality status, risks, and recommendations while collaborating across distributed teams and disciplines.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of software quality assurance experience, with multiple examples of successful product or feature delivery.

• Experience designing, implementing, and executing test approaches as part of an overall test strategy.

• Experience with accessibility testing across digital products, games, web experiences, or comparable software.

• Experience with manual testing and familiarity with automated testing approaches, tools, or frameworks.

• Experience using assistive technologies, including common screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver.

• Experience testing keyboard navigation and other relevant input methods or assistive technologies.

• Experience performing flash-rate or photosensitivity testing, including use of tools such as Harding or PEAT, or the ability to quickly develop equivalent expertise.

• Strong understanding of accessibility standards, principles, and techniques, including WCAG, WAI-ARIA, Section 508, CVA and EAA with the ability to interpret requirements and advise product teams.

• Experience creating test plans, test cases, user stories, and quality or coverage reporting.

• Experience triaging accessibility issues and communicating remediation guidance to technical and non-technical partners.

• Experience coaching or mentoring QA team members and/or external testers on test design, planning, and execution.

• Experience driving continuous improvement within a team or product development process.

• Experience partnering effectively with software engineers, designers, artists, producers, project managers, and other cross-functional partners.

• Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Knowledge of and fluency in the software development life cycle.

• Experience using task and defect management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience testing games or interactive experiences across PC, console, and/or mobile platforms.

• Experience with accessibility testing for game engines or game UI technologies, such as Unity or Unreal.

• Experience with web technologies and accessibility testing in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or related UI systems.

• Experience designing or maintaining accessibility test automation, tooling, or reusable QA infrastructure.

• Experience establishing quality metrics that influence product decisions and drive change.

• Experience working with distributed teams, vendors, or external testing partners.

• Experience conducting user testing or incorporating feedback from players with disabilities into quality practices.

• ISTQB Foundation Level, ISTQB Agile Tester, ICAgile Agile Testing, or comparable certification.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

• Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data

• Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors

• Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks

• Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Mid-Atlantic Truck & Equipment

Senior Accountant | Easton, MD

We’re looking for a Senior Accountant to join our accounting team and play an important role in keeping our financial operations accurate, organized, and running smoothly. This is a hands-on position with broad responsibilities across general accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, payroll support, vendor management, and tax-related activities.

The right person will be someone who enjoys digging into the details, identifying and resolving discrepancies, and taking ownership of their work. You’ll work closely with the Controller and collaborate with other departments to support accurate financial reporting and day-to-day accounting operations.

Benefits:

• Salary Range: $75,000–$95,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

• Work Schedule Perk: This is a full-time, Monday–Friday position. In-office days are set for Tuesdays and Wednesdays at our Easton, MD corporate office, with additional days in the office as needed. A company laptop is provided for work outside the office.

• Comprehensive Benefits Package: Access excellent medical, dental, vision, and additional benefits.

• Paid Time Off: Accrue two weeks of PTO during your first year, plus 8 hours of personal leave annually and 7 paid holidays.

• 401(k) with Company Match: Secure your future with our company-matched retirement plan.

• Employee Referral Program: Earn rewards by referring qualified candidates.

• Employee Assistance Program: Access resources to support your well-being.

• Career Growth Opportunities: Benefit from stability, professional development, and pathways for advancement within the company.

What You’ll Do

• Lead and complete month-end close and general ledger accounting, including account reconciliations, journal entries, supporting schedules, and financial reporting.

• Analyze account balances, transactions, and variances to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure accurate financial records.

• Process and reconcile sales commissions, quarterly incentive payments, and benefit accounts, and research and resolve payroll tax issues. Provide backup support for payroll processing.

• Handle accounts payable and vendor accounting, including AP aging, vendor reconciliations, open receiving, and equipment and parts subledgers.

• Complete tax and compliance activities, including W-9s, 1099 reporting, personal property tax, corporate tax-related activities, and internal controls.

• Provide accounting, financial analysis, and reporting support to the Controller, including budgeting, forecasting, audits, inventory, and special projects.

• Collaborate with the accounting team and other departments to resolve issues, improve processes, and maintain efficient day-to-day accounting operations.

About Us

Mid-Atlantic Truck & Equipment is a premier wholesale retailer and service provider of heavy trucks and equipment. Our mission is to empower our customers by delivering top-quality equipment and service solutions, allowing them to focus on their business instead of their equipment.

We’ve built a team-oriented, service-driven culture focused on excellence and collaboration. We’re looking for talented, motivated people who want to contribute to our team and make a meaningful impact on our customers’ success.

Why This Role Matters

As a Senior Accountant, you’ll play an important role in keeping our financial processes accurate, organized, and running smoothly. We’re looking for someone with strong accounting fundamentals who can ask questions, dig into discrepancies, solve problems, and take ownership of their work.

What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting is required

• 3+ years of progressive corporate accounting experience, preferably in a Senior Accountant or similar role.

• Strong experience with month-end close, account reconciliations, journal entries, and general ledger accounting.

• Experience preparing or reviewing financial statements and financial reports.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes.

• Experience with AP, AR, vendor accounts, and other accounting operations.

• Experience with payroll, commissions, benefits, or tax-related accounting is a plus.

• Experience working with an ERP or accounting system.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with the accounting team, other departments, and external contacts.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction or sponsorship requirements.

• Must reside within a one-hour driving radius of MATE’s Easton, Maryland corporate office.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Come Join Our Team At Anteriad and innovate the way B2B marketers make data-driven business decisions.

About Anteriad

We are not just another B2B solution provider. We're problem solvers. We believe that data is the key to unlocking effective solutions that span a range of marketing challenges - from customer acquisition to demand generation to account-based marketing. Data is at the core of everything we do. Our team works tirelessly to create powerful solutions that drive real results for our clients. Whether it's through innovative technology or deep analysis, we're committed to finding the best path to growth for every one of our customers.

Why Join Our Team?

Are you a rare hybrid marketer who loves digging into the technical weeds of marketing automation but also thrives on building strong client relationships?

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Automation Specialist & Account Manager with 5+ years of hands-on Oracle Eloqua experience and hands-on HubSpot experience to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary partner for our enterprise B2B clients, owning both the high-touch account management and the day-to-day tactical execution of their marketing campaigns. You won't just advise from the sidelines—you will actively plan, build, deploy, and analyze complex campaigns while keeping client projects running smoothly and on schedule.

Anteriad means “always moving forward” and we apply that to our company culture by tirelessly promoting an environment that allows our employees to thrive:

• Flexible PTO

• Training & development with unlimited access to Percipio LMS.

• Mix of collaborative & independent work

• Community outreach via Anteriad Cares - Encouraging staff to take time to volunteer

• Professional mentoring program - Career guidance from leadership

What You'll Do:

Client & Account Management

• Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the day-to-day trusted advisor for assigned B2B client accounts, managing project intake, timelines, and deliverables.

• Campaign Planning: Partner with clients to plan their marketing roadmaps, translating high-level business goals into production-ready Eloqua campaign briefs.

• Project Oversight: Manage project scope, set realistic timelines, and lead regular status meetings to keep clients aligned and informed.

• Stakeholder Navigation: Manage client expectations on timelines and scope, and navigate a client's internal legal, compliance, or brand review processes where needed.

Hands-on Eloqua Execution & Operations

• Campaign Build & Deploy: Design, test, and execute complex, automated multi-step nurture programs, event-triggered streams, and batch emails using Eloqua Campaign and Program Canvases.

• HubSpot Operations: Build and maintain HubSpot workflows, lists, and reporting; experience migrating between or running parallel Eloqua/HubSpot instances is a strong plus.

• Asset Development: Code, edit, and troubleshoot responsive HTML/CSS email templates, landing pages, and web forms that match client brand standards.

• Data & Lifecycle Architecture: Implement advanced B2B lead scoring, custom data objects (CDOs), automated segmentation, and bidirectional CRM synchronization (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle CX).

• Reporting & Analytics: Generate performance reports, analyze key metrics (deliverability, engagement, conversion), and present actionable optimization strategies to clients.

What You'll Bring:

• Eloqua Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on, daily technical configuration and campaign deployment experience specifically within Oracle Eloqua.

• Hubspot Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lists, and reporting.

• B2B Experience: Deep understanding of complex B2B buying lifecycles, lead routing protocols, account-based marketing (ABM), and revenue operations (RevOps).

• Client-Facing Track Record: 3+ years in an agency or client-facing corporate role with proven success managing client communication, expectations, and feedback loops.

• Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email rendering, advanced Microsoft Excel for data management, and native CRM integrations.

• Compliance & Governance: Strong understanding of email deliverability best practices and global data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

• Certifications: Oracle Certified Eloqua Master or Luminary status is highly preferred; HubSpot certifications (Marketing Software, Workflows) a plus.

• Database & Platform-Agnostic Thinking: Strong understanding of relational databases and data structures (not just platform UI knowledge) — able to reason deduplication and segmentation logic in a way that transfers across marketing automation/selection tools, not tied to Eloqua or HubSpot specifically.

Benefits We Bring To You:

• Comprehensive medical (choice of 3 plans), dental and vision coverage

• Company paid short-term disability, long term disability and life insurance

• Optional supplemental life, accident and critical illness insurance plans

• 401K with company match

• Flexible PTO and generous paid holiday schedule

• Fully paid primary caregiver leave (12 weeks) & parental bonding leave (2 weeks)

#LIremote

Our Values:

• Lead & Learn We lead with unrivaled vision, innovation and execution, always learning and embracing new ways of doing things to stay out in front​

• Collaborate & Celebrate We build great things when we work together as one Anteriad team, celebrating our achievements – both great and small – along the way ​

jobs.description:

This role balances inventory across multiple distribution centers and sales channels while partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure product availability, optimize inventory investment, and support business objectives throughout the product lifecycle.

• Oversee the complete product lifecycle, from initial demand planning through end-of-life, partnering closely with Product Development, Marketing, Retail Operations, Finance, Manufacturing, and Global Supply Planning.

About the Job

The Training and Development Specialist for the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program holds a crucial role in the design, implementation, and evaluation of training programs. These programs aim to ensure all staff possess the requisite knowledge and skills to effectively deliver ECM services. This individual will contribute to workforce development by managing onboarding processes, compliance training, continuing education, and quality enhancement initiatives, all of which are aligned with California’s Medi-Cal transformation goals under CalAIM.


At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: California, Georgia, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Utah and Washington.




What you'll do

 - Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive training programs for the ECM Quality and Training Department.

 - Coordinate and deliver training sessions on ECM core competencies, program standards, documentation requirements, and cultural sensitivity.

 - Conduct onboarding for new ECM team members and facilitate ongoing training for existing staff, adhering to CalAIM and Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) guidelines.

 - Assess and evaluate the efficacy of training programs through assessments, feedback mechanisms, and performance metrics.

 - Participate in internal and external audits, assisting with performance improvement plans as required.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Instrumentation & Controls Engineer, SCADA
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role

As the Sr Staff Instrumentation & Controls Engineer, SCADA, you will own SCADA governance and drive the scaling strategy for deploying SCADA across an assigned portfolio of Crusoe data center projects, spanning modular, colocation, and hyperscale builds. You will define the standards and levers that ensure uniformity where it matters and flexibility where it's needed, giving the cloud team and downstream customers the operational data and telemetry required to run and improve data center performance.

This role demands deep technical ownership of telemetry and data governance and the control layer, paired with the judgment to know when a standard approach should flex to meet a specific project's requirements. You will work directly with engineering peers to build approaches that vendor field teams can actually implement at speed, and you'll direct the documentation practices that keep vendor performance accountable across the pipeline. As a Sr Staff level engineer, you're expected to informally raise the technical bar for those around you, sharing knowledge and perspective with peers even where mentorship isn't a formal part of the job. This is a Full-Time position requiring an estimated 25% travel, varying by project needs and tied to escalation events, First of Kind (FOK) deployments, and direct vendor support.

What You'll Be Working On

 - Control Layer Governance: Own tag naming taxonomy and govern interfacing with the control layer across assigned SCADA deployments, ensuring consistent data structures that feed downstream cloud and customer systems.

 - Version Control Strategy: Provide guidance on version control system usage across active projects in the pipeline, establishing practices that protect configuration integrity as programs scale.

 - Governance Documentation: Draft and maintain the documentation that drives governance across tagging, version control, and vendor standards, ensuring the frameworks other teams rely on are clear, current, and enforceable.

 - Cross-Program Standardization: Partner directly with engineering peers to develop approaches flexible enough to meet project-specific requirements while maintaining uniformity that accelerates deployment velocity.

 - Vendor Implementability: Validate that governance frameworks and technical approaches are realistically implementable by vendor field workforces, balancing standardization with practical field constraints.

 - SME-Level Review: Serve as the subject matter expert for escalated or ambiguous documentation and governance questions, providing authoritative guidance where standard processes don't clearly apply.

What You'll Bring to the Team

 - Mission-Critical Systems Mastery: 10+ years of experience in mission-critical or related critical industrial control systems environments.

 - Ignition & Version Control Expertise: Deep mastery of the Ignition SCADA platform and version control systems as applied to industrial control projects.

 - Hosting & Infrastructure Fluency: Strong familiarity with hosting methodologies including containerization and orchestration alongside bare-metal deployment, plus a fundamental understanding of server hardware and topologies.

 - Protocol Proficiency: Extensive knowledge of data center and industrial control protocols, including Modbus TCP/IP / RTU and BACnet IP / MS/TP, EtherNet/IP, and working knowledge of IEC 61850 and related IO protocols.

 - OT Security Familiarity: Working familiarity with OT/ICS security fundamentals, including concepts like the Purdue model and secure remote access practices, sufficient to collaborate effectively with security stakeholders.

 - Clear, Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders both inside and outside the department, building alignment across engineering, vendors, and cloud teams.

 - Mandatory Education: A Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

Bonus Points

 - Hyperscale Program Experience: Experience developing mission-critical applications at scale within a hyperscale portfolio, where multiple teams and workstreams are developing simultaneously, is invaluable given the coordination demands of Crusoe's pipeline.

 - Deeper OT Security Ownership: Experience actively owning or architecting OT security controls, beyond general familiarity, is a strong plus.

 - Linux & Containerization Depth: Working knowledge of Linux, containerization, and industrial networking, with deeper mastery in these areas considered a strong plus.

 - Industry Certifications: Relevant certifications in industrial cybersecurity or SCADA-specific frameworks.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $190,000 -$215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Revenue Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Relay is the Intelligent System of Action for the physical economy. While the digital revolution has often left the deskless workforce behind, we are closing that gap by transforming analog frontline operations into a data-rich, AI-powered ecosystem. We aren't just selling radios, we’re building the digital foundation for the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't work at a desk.

What makes our Sumer Intern program different:

• Executive and senior leadership team exposure - regular touchpoints with Relay's leadership team, including Q&A coffee chats, Breakfast with the CEO, and working sessions.

• Cross-functional cohort - work alongside interns across every part of the business, not just your team.

• Structured learning - regular skill-building sessions covering topics from product strategy to financial modeling to sales craft to professional networking and interviewing skills.

• Real ownership - you'll own a project from kickoff to final presentation, with mentors and fellow Relayers who are invested in your success.

• Intern showcase - present your work to the full company at the end of the summer

• Raleigh HQ experience - team lunches, volunteer Intern Impact day, social events, and a chance to see how a scaling tech company operates up close! Work from our amenity-rich Raleigh campus (fitness center, sports courts) with a team dedicated to "Best Work In My Life" (BWIML).

If you're passionate about technology, driven to make a difference and align your work to a bigger mission, and excited to join a company that's shaping the future of frontline work, we encourage you to explore opportunities at Relay!

Why Join Relay?

• A Proven Winner: Join a hyper-growth company trusted by over 10% of the Fortune 500, continuing to move upmarket with massive impact.

• High Value, High Impact: With 47% of our revenue from $100K+ ARR customers and 135% Net Revenue Retention (NRR), you'll be joining a company rooted in value creation.

• Market-Leading Innovation: The Relay platform captures 1 billion new data points weekly and features award-winning AI tools like TeamTranslate™, with 500% YoY growth.

• World-Class Leadership: Our stellar leadership team is built to help us scale toward our next major milestones.

• The Relay Culture: We’re dedicated to helping you do the best work of your life (BWIML), investing in your growth through L.I.T., living our CHASE values, and learning from incredibly talented, supportive teammates who make the work (and the wins) better every day.

Now, here’s what we’re building, and where you come in.

What you will do:

• Work directly with our Revenue Accounting team on ASC 606 compliance, deferred revenue analysis, and month-end close processes, developing an understanding of Relay's products and the order-to-cash cycle along the way

• Get exposure to how the team applies ASC 606 revenue recognition, including reviewing sales orders, customer contracts, and invoices under guidance for both standard and non-standard arrangements

• Partner with the Senior Manager of Revenue Accounting on a cross-functional initiative to redesign internal revenue reporting — evaluating existing report structure, aligning with how Finance and the business track performance, and delivering improved reporting that scales with the company

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Legal on contract and order questions, reflecting how revenue accounting actually operates in a fast-moving B2B company

• Take on a defined project during the internship focused on identifying a recurring manual process within revenue accounting and either building a tool to automate it, conducting a deep analytical review to improve it, or developing documentation/training materials to support the team's operations.

• Present your project findings/deliverables at our Intern Showcase at the end of the internship

• Support the broader Accounting team on ad hoc requests and special projects as needed

What you will have:

• Accounting major entering their final year (rising senior), or a recent grad who will begin a Master's in Accounting program in the fall following the internship

• Comfortable working in Excel

• Experience or interest in using AI tools for data analysis

• Attention to detail and a solution-oriented mindset

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable asking questions

What would be preferred:

• Exposure to accounting coursework covering ASC 606

• Any familiarity with NetSuite or other ERP systems

About Relay | Culture, Benefits & Perks

Our culture hinges on Relayers getting LIT up in an environment that fosters Learning, Impact, and Teamwork, where we CHASE the best work of our lives. We call this BWIML (Best Work In My Life).

The future of frontline work is being built here. Come build it with us. We can’t wait to hear from you.

Transcripts are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel and retained consistent with our data retention policies. jobs.title: Product Lead, Visitors
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com



About the Role: Product management here at Envoy is the most critical role in ensuring customers and their end-users love the products they use. Every decision you make will directly impact tens of thousands of workplaces around the world and their millions of occupants, be them employees, visitors, contractors, etc. Envoy seeks to deliver next-level operational efficiency, data-drivenness, safety, and security for everyone involved, and our solutions must be highly thoughtful about this at scale. You will be responsible for this for your product or product line. This isn't an easy job, but if high stakes is your game, you'll enjoy things a lot.



We are currently looking for a product leader to own and evolve a large portion of Envoy Visitors, our flagship visitor management platform used by companies all around the world. Visitors is very powerful – customers are using it to meet strict regulatory compliances in their industries. They need to do background checks to make sure people aren't from sanctioned countries, they are requiring specific OSHA trainings of their contractors, they need full audit logs of all changes over hundreds of facilities, they need to provision access control credentials for specific vendors, there's a lot going on and at scale. What you'll be working on is absolutely critical to the safety and security of their operations so thoughtfulness is critical every day. There’s a lot of surface area, a lot of different customer needs, and a lot of opportunity to make big industry-changing decisions. It's what they've been waiting for.



We're currently a small and nimble product team looking to grow from leadership previously being spread throughout product design roles, product marketing, engineering management, and we even have some IC engineers running their products externally. Needless to say, we recognize this isn't going to scale, and we want to get ahead of it with your ownership and help. This brings inward opportunity too – as the product team grows, we'll need product line leaders and organizers, and we'd much rather promote from within when possible. But for now, this is an IC PM role as that's the immediate need.



This is a full-time, 5-day onsite role in San Francisco (410 Townsend St). Please remember we are a workplace company. We build products for workplaces and we believe that we can only become experts in something when we surround ourselves in it! We're happy to help move you out here if necessary. We also help with visa transfers if needed.



We hope this all sounds great to you so far! 

As a baseline, you will need

 - 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in B2B with enterprise exposure and 0-1 product building experience

 - An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative field
   

In this role, you will

 - Meticulously own vision, roadmap, strategy, and execution of your products

 - Launch products and be ultimately responsible for the success/failure of the products/features based on the goals/metrics you define.

 - Push for quality and urgency despite constant challenges for one or the other. You need to enjoy this battle.

 - Be the primary switchboard and gather feedback from customers directly, our sales/success teams, and others cross-functionally to create an opinion and get things iterated, built, and launched. You must be good at rational decision-making; not everyone will always agree, yet you'll still need their support.

 - Be the point person to customers during beta or high-iteration periods in products. And you'll run internal dogfooding.

 - Story-tell internally the importance of what we're building to engineering ICs, designers, researchers and the general company, encouraging bottoms up ownership, creative thinking and internal contribution.

 - Own much of pricing and packaging, and you'll ensure sales training happens as you expect for your products. There is no throwing-over-the-wall allowed here.

 - You'll bring your existing product processes and help us all elevate our product execution.

 - And yes, it has to be said, roles change over time; this job description is dynamic, you need to be comfortable in an environment where things can change a lot.



Your values: Every company is unique, with its own culture and community, and specific values that make things gel. There is no one general fingerprint for what makes a 'good' company or a 'bad' one, it's all dependent on your personal values and how well they map to the values of the company you're part of. It's therefore critical you and us match well together. As you explore the list below, please be real with yourself – is this the kind of environment you really want? If not "yes absolutely", it's best to not apply, trust us, you're going to have a bad time. If however, these describe you, you're going to have an amazing time here with friends you'll retain for years to come. We hope this describes you!

 - You have a passion for workplaces, have strong end-user intuition and demand products you yourself can proudly use daily

 - You thrive in ambiguous, low-guidance environments. You seek accountability and to own the success (and failure!) of everything you work on.

 - You have a high bar for everything you build, including the way it looks and feels, spending the time necessary to achieve quality to winning standards. Especially in Enterprise software, notorious for putting quality by the wayside.

 - You create and hold yourself and your team to success metrics. You are data-driven, relying on numbers to persuade versus necessarily just high-paying customer anecdotes.

 - You are impatient and expect things sooner than in a couple weeks, months or quarters

 - You have high empathy and humility and understand you're always learning. You're also aggressively a believer that everyone you work with must be this way too.

 - You rely on AI tooling and truly see it as a massive force multiplier and you are excited about constantly evolving yourself to best reap its benefits. You are also excited to share the AI discoveries that you're continuously making (and you expect the same of your peers too).

 - You believe teams being in-office are the best way to solve problems fast and build great products.

jobs.title: Director, Wholesale Beauty
jobs.description:
About The Company

goop is a lifestyle platform dedicated to exploration, curation, and groundbreaking conversation. From its award-winning beauty and fashion lines to its expansive editorial lens, goop invites women to embrace the process of becoming, and to discover deep joy in the pursuit of pleasure, beauty, and growth in all phases of life.

Gwyneth Paltrow began goop in the fall of 2008 as a weekly newsletter. It has expanded into a beauty, fashion, and food business that’s also known for its products, curation, podcast, TV shows, live events, and retail stores.

ABOUT YOU

You are a dynamic and driven sales professional with deep experience and passion for the beauty. You’re comfortable managing complex retail relationships, analyzing sales data, and building effective sales strategies. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are equally skilled at high-level business development and day-to-day operational execution. A team player at heart, you can lead, mentor, and jump in where needed to ensure smooth operations and achieve ambitious sales goals.

Culturally, results are your native language— clear goals, clear numbers, a visible line from contribution to outcome. AI is integral to how you work, raising the bar on what a small group can accomplish. Authority sits comfortably within your working style: your scope is defined, and you exercise real decision authority. Founder mode isn’t a stage you are curious about; it’s how you operate.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Director, Wholesale, you will oversee goop Beauty’s wholesale business across domestic and international accounts, including key wholesale partnerships. Reporting to the Vice President of Wholesale & Wholesale Marketing, you will manage sales operations, retail partner relationships, and business development initiatives while driving growth and maintaining goop’s brand integrity. This role requires a strategic thinker who is hands-on, detail-oriented, and adept at managing both client-facing and operational responsibilities.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for key wholesale accounts, ensuring strong relationships, consistent communication, and growth-focused account management.

• Manage communications to ensure continuity in service and account oversight across the team.

• Drive wholesale sales through direct selling to small and boutique accounts, expanding goop presence in domestic and international markets.

• Ability to build retailer plans which include but are not limited to; launch plans, marketing plans, education plans, promotional plans and sell through plans.

• Work cross functionally with marketing, creative, digital, product development and retail teams to ensure brand messaging and priority cohesion.

• Analyze sales reports, forecasts, and performance data to inform business decisions and improve account management strategies. Collaborate with Merch Planning and FP&A teams to ensure efficiency between inventory and financial planning

• Handle administrative tasks, back-office duties, and order management as needed to support seamless sales operations.

• Leverage prior experience with major retailers and international partners to navigate complex account structures and drive long-term growth.

• Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members, including serving as the primary manager for specialist support

• Supervise a team of field sales representatives and brand ambassadors

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• 8+ years of experience in wholesale sales or account management within the beauty, wellness, or consumer goods industries, minimum of 3 years of managerial experience

• Experience working with large domestic retailers, as well as international accounts

• Proven track record of managing and growing key retail partnerships, meeting sales targets, and exceeding revenue goals

• Strong understanding of retail operations, sales forecasting, and budgeting

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

• Comfortable with CRM tools, sales reporting, and analytics platforms

• Experience managing and mentoring team members

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel

• Ability to work independently, multitask, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

FAQ

• Compensation: $140,000 - $160,000 + Variable Incentive Compensation + Equity. This is a full-time, exempt role. Please note that this range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for the Los Angeles, CA based position. The actual base salary will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, training, knowledge and skills, and if the location of the job changes.

• Perks: “goopcation” paid company summer break, generous goop discounts, special offers with brand partners, access to custom lifestyle resources and events, and a beautiful workspace in Santa Monica

• Work Philosophy: At goop we believe that creativity, innovation and camaraderie are essential to our business, our culture and our employee’s growth and development. For those in Los Angeles or New York we are in office a minimum of Tuesdays and Thursdays, with more days in office based on proximity. 100% remote candidates are also encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About the Role

The Senior Operations Manager helps ensure the account operates efficiently and has the processes, information, and coordination needed to support successful delivery. Reporting to the Director of Operations and Project Management, this role supports a broad range of operational needs, including systems and processes, resourcing, workflows, access management, partner coordination, and other activities that support the account’s day-to-day operations. The Operations Manager works across internal teams and external partners to keep information accurate, drive timely follow-through, and identify and escalate operational risks.

Responsibilities:

Operational systems and process management

• Day-to-day administration of the systems, tools, trackers, and documentation used to operate the account.

• Implementation and maintenance of operational processes, SOPs, R&Rs, intake processes, escalation paths, and ways-of-working documentation.

• Monitoring adoption and identifying recurring workflow issues, inefficiencies, or gaps for escalation to the Director of Operations and Project Management.

• Coordination of operational readiness for new systems, tools, and process rollouts.

Resourcing and capacity management

• Maintenance of allocation, availability, open-role, freelance, transition, leave, and capacity tracking across the business.

• Coordination with Account, Project Management, Casting, and department leads to keep resourcing information current.

• Preparation of recurring capacity and resourcing reporting for Operations and account leadership.

• Identification and escalation of allocation issues, coverage gaps, and staff-plan discrepancies.

• Administrative coordination of approved staffing changes, while Project Management retains ownership of project-level assignments and delivery needs.

Finance and procurement operations

• Maintenance of operational inputs and audit trails for scope, budget, burn, reconciliation, invoices, purchase orders, vendors, and payments.

• Coordination with Finance, Account, Project Management, and Production to ensure financial information is accurate and submitted on time.

• Monitoring and follow-up on invoices, job numbers, purchase orders, time entry, vendor setup, payments, and other outstanding actions.

• Preparation of recurring financial and operational reporting inputs for leadership and client reporting.

• Escalation of financial and procurement risks to the Director of Operations and Project Management.

Onboarding, access, and business continuity

• Coordination of onboarding and offboarding requirements for internal and external team members.

• Management of access requests, distribution lists, org-level Slack channels, shared drives, YubiKeys, team rosters, and related documentation.

• Identification and escalation of access, coverage, and continuity risks before they affect delivery.

Publishing and external-partner operations

• Day-to-day operational coordination with Little Dot Studios and other operational partners.

• Maintenance of partner access, documentation, escalation paths, actions, and outstanding dependencies.

• Coordination with Account and Project Management to align publishing operations with client priorities and delivery plans.

• Escalation of partner workflow and business-continuity concerns to the Director of Operations and Project Management.

Reporting and operational governance

• Preparation of recurring operational reporting and tracking of monthly deliverables.

• Monitoring of operational deadlines, required inputs, owners, and cross-functional follow-ups.

• Documentation of decisions, owners, and next steps from key operational and financial forums.

• Quality control of operational data and reporting before leadership or client distribution.

About You

The essentials:

• 5+ years of progressive operational leadership in a creative agency setting.

• Experience in leading projects involving AI technology and data analytics.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated expertise in conducting comprehensive assessments and providing actionable recommendations.

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

• Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and guide teams toward achieving strategic goals.

jobs.title: Propulsion Manufacturing Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today, Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe— large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization. Astranis has raised over $750 million from some of the world’s best investors, from Andreessen Horowitz to Blackrock and Fidelity, and employs a team of 450 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Propulsion Manufacturing Intern (Summer 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.

As an Intern, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past interns have designed and tested hardware/software that is heading to space on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to be an Associate Engineer.

Role

• Design & Build the factory that builds satellites.

• Deliver a physical propulsion subsystem, from tank to thruster, that is ready to operate in space.

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering

• Proficiency in a CAD software (Solidworks, Creo, NX, etc.)

• A passion for building things, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development

• Strong interest in manufacturing; learning "How It's Made," and applying that knowledge

• Compulsion to fix anything that's broken, whether its a piece of equipment, a bad process, or communication between teams

• Don't meet them all? Not a problem. Please apply even if you do not meet all these criteria.

Bonus

• Experience building or testing liquid propulsion systems

• Experience writing work instructions, test procedures, or using MES/ERP software

• Experience welding, machining, or designing welded/ machined components

The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.

Base Hourly Pay

$29—$29 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

jobs.title: Manager Digital Marketing
jobs.location: East Aurora, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The Manager Digital Marketing will lead the development and execution of a social-first brand strategy, shaping how the brand shows up across platforms, communities, and culture. This role partners with the Director to evolve the long-term brand vision, with a primary focus on driving cultural relevance, audience engagement, and growth through social, creator, and digital ecosystems.

This individual will be responsible for translating brand strategy into best-in-class social and integrated campaigns, ensuring the brand is not only present in culture but actively participating in it. They will bring deep expertise in social platforms, creator partnerships, and emerging digital behaviors, with a strong ability to turn insights into content, conversation, and community.

The Manager will lead end-to-end social strategy and execution, from identifying trends and defining narratives to activating campaigns and measuring impact. They will serve as a key point of contact for Mattel’s Inter Agency Team (IAT), while directly managing social, influencer, and creative agency partners to deliver breakthrough, culturally resonant work.

A highly visible leader, this individual galvanizes teams, influences stakeholders, and ensures alignment around a social-first, audience-centric approach. They are both strategic and hands-on, equally comfortable defining the vision and executing it in real time.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Social & Brand Strategy Leadership

• Lead the development of a social-first brand strategy, ensuring the brand shows up authentically and consistently across platforms
• Translate cultural trends, social behaviors, and creator/influencer dynamics into actionable content and campaign strategies
• Define the brand’s voice, tone, and storytelling approach across social channels
• Establish social and content guardrails to ensure consistency while enabling creative flexibility
• Partner with Toy, Franchise, and Studio teams to embed social thinking into product, content, and launch strategies from the start
• Act as the central connector across content, product, experiences, and marketing to ensure social is integrated, not additive

Social Activation & Execution

• Own and lead end-to-end social campaign development and execution, from concept through launch and optimization
• Develop and execute always-on and tentpole social strategies, including key cultural moments, launches, and partnerships
• Partner with Influencer team to shape creator and influencer strategy, including identification, briefing, and relationship management
• Oversee the creation of platform-native content designed to drive engagement, sharing, and community participation
• Partner with creative and production teams to deliver high-quality, social-first assets (short-form video, trends, reactive content, etc.)
• Collaborate with regional teams to ensure global strategies translate effectively across markets

Performance & Optimization

• Define social KPIs (engagement, reach, sentiment, creator performance, conversion)
• Track, analyze, and optimize campaign performance in real time, using insights to refine strategy
• Monitor brand health through social listening, community engagement, and cultural relevance
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness and platform performance

What We’re Looking For:

jobs.title: Sr Associate, Digital Marketing - American Girl CRM
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The CRM Senior Marketing Associate is responsible for supporting the execution and optimization of American Girl’s CRM programs across email and SMS channels. This role will manage day-to-day campaign planning, production, and deployment, while leveraging performance insights to continuously improve customer engagement and business outcomes and support CRM channel performance against key engagement, conversion, and revenue goals.

The SMA will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Loyalty, Ecomm/Merchandising, IT, and external agency partners to deliver personalized, on-brand communications that support acquisition, retention, and lifetime customer value. The ideal candidate brings a balance of strong execution, attention to detail, and a data-informed mindset, with a passion for creating meaningful customer experiences.

What Your Impact Will Be:

1. Campaign Planning, Production & Execution: Support the planning and execution of CRM campaigns across email and SMS, including promotional campaigns, product launches, and loyalty and seasonal initiatives. Maintain and manage the CRM calendar to ensure alignment with broader marketing strategies, business priorities, and retail moments. Develop clear and actionable creative briefs and partner with internal creative teams (design and copy) to deliver engaging, on-brand messaging. Provide input on messaging, subject lines, and creative to optimize performance and maintain brand voice. Coordinate campaign production across internal teams and external partners, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

2. Customer Lifecycle & Audience Management: Execute audience segmentation strategies to support customer acquisition, onboarding, retention, and re-engagement. Build, launch, and optimize automated lifecycle journeys (e.g., welcome series, browse/cart abandonment, post-purchase, loyalty, winback). Leverage customer data to support personalization efforts and deliver relevant, timely messaging. Partner with merchandising and site teams to ensure strong alignment between CRM campaigns and on-site experience, contributing to a seamless omnichannel customer journey.

3. Optimization & Testing: Support ongoing optimization of CRM campaigns through A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, creative, messaging, timing, and audience segments. Monitor key campaign performance metrics

and apply learnings to improve future campaign effectiveness and support overall CRM performance against business and revenue objectives. Conduct thorough QA across all campaigns, ensuring accuracy of content, links, tracking, and overall customer experience.

4. Performance Reporting & Insights: Support CRM performance tracking by contributing to regular reporting for campaigns and key business moments. Monitor campaign performance and identify trends, insights, and opportunities to improve engagement and conversion. Partners with teams incorporating CRM efforts into broader marketing plans and sharing performance learnings to inform future campaign planning and optimization efforts. Assist in the development of performance summaries and marketing decks as needed.

5. Data Stewardship & Best Practices: Maintain strong customer data hygiene and support ongoing audience quality initiatives. Ensure all CRM communications adhere to email and SMS compliance standards (e.g., CAN-SPAM, TCPA) and deliverability best practices. Utilize CRM and project management tools (e.g., Klaviyo, Monday.com) to execute campaigns efficiently and accurately. Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs) or marketing data systems is a plus.

What We’re Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or email/SMS marketing, preferably within retail or consumer products
• Hands-on experience with an ESP (Klaviyo preferred) and end-to-end campaign execution
• Integrated marketing experience required across paid and owned channels, including ecommerce, retail stores, social, print/direct mail
• Experience building CRM calendars, segmentation strategies, and lifecycle campaigns
• Experience working cross-functionally with creative, marketing, and merchandising teams
• Excellent written/verbal, time management and quantitative/analytical skills required
• Familiarity with campaign performance metrics and using data to inform optimization decisions
• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills preferred

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Customer-Centric Thinking: Understands the importance of delivering relevant, personalized communication across the customer lifecycle. Able to translate brand storytelling into meaningful CRM touchpoints that resonate with adults and gift-givers.
• Executional Excellence: Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills. Able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and quality in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
• Data-Informed Decision Making: Comfortable working with campaign performance data to identify trends and inform optimizations. Able to apply insights to improve future campaigns and support business goals without requiring deep analytical ownership.
• Collaboration and Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams including Creative, Marketing, and Merchandising. Able to contribute ideas and recommendations that influence campaign direction and execution.
• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Demonstrates flexibility, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and grow.

jobs.title: Territory Leader - Pasadena
jobs.description:
About the role: We are hiring frontline sales professionals to be part of a diverse and elite biopharma sales team dedicated to helping patients in need. With a laser focus on the eye care customer, the Territory Leader will be responsible for territory disease state education along with the launch and ongoing growth of XDEMVY. They will deliver high standards for the ongoing launch and beyond and will champion a culture of outstanding performance, compliance and full ownership of all activity and results. The Territory Leader will be experts in account management, business ownership, sales execution, resource utilization, and they will build and foster relationships with key eye care customers. The Territory Leader will relentlessly pursue excellence to maximize sales in their territory while learning to adapt to changes and needs of the business. In doing so, they will have the unique opportunity to meaningfully contribute to the growth and performance of Tarsus. This critical sales role will be ideal for someone who thinks strategically, operates with tactical precision and strives for excellence.

Geography: Candidates must live in Pasadena (LA Metro).

Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role:

Account Management & Eye Care Experts

• Experts in eye care clinical information: anatomy, disease state, products, XDEMVY and office treatment patterns

• Experts in selling skills and account development including building relationships with all key stakeholders

• Experts in pull through tactics with a full understanding of managed care hurdles

• Understand all functions within an ophthalmology/optometry practice and how their roles impact product prescribing and pull through

• Maximize managed care opportunities within the territory and have an understanding of how it impacts the District, Region and Nation and share important feedback

• Understand key opinion leaders within respective geographies and foster engagement with Tarsus leadership

• As eye care experts, champion compliant promotion in alignment with our corporate values

Business Acumen & Sales Execution

• Drive top tier execution by exceeding sales performance goals and key productivity metrics across the territory

• Use expert analytical skills to guide highly productive activity – prioritize key customer engagements, drive reach and frequency to extend depth and breadth of product trial and utilization

• Drive a successful launch and ongoing performance by monitoring all key performance metrics weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annually – ability to adjust approach as needed based on data

• Ensure actionable business plans are set - align all selling activities to drive impact

• Share ongoing insights with leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure feedback is captured

• Personal accountability for driving the highest standards of ethics and compliance

Business Owners & Culture Champions

• Drive our culture of commitment, empowerment and teamwork which includes extreme ownership, high accountability, continuous improvement and relentless pursuit of excellence

• Achieve success and be prepared to adapt in a complex selling environment partnering with many stakeholders: district leaders, marketing, market access, medical affairs, sales ops, inside sales, training, and other important stakeholders

• Provide frontline feedback and intel to sales leadership and the broader organization

• Ensure PDMA compliance and adhere to all company & industry compliance guidelines

• Share ongoing best practices among peers and leadership to elevate national performance

• Maximize all key resources that lead to territory success

Factors for Success:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, science, or related field or commensurate experience

• 2+ years pharmaceutical sales / relevant healthcare sales experience or a proven track record of business to business sales - required Proven track record of pharmaceutical launch experience - strongly preferred Eye Care experience- preferred

• Established track record with evidence of excellent problem solving and collaboration

• Highly adaptable to change, able to quickly pivot and respond given new market information in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication and change management skills

• Proven ability to escalate difficult issues and make tough decisions

• Established track record in the following job competencies: Selling skills High performance Impact & influence Customer focus & account management Maximizing resources Analytical skills Relationship building Decision making & judgment Teamwork & collaboration Adaptability & GRIT

A Few Other Details Worth Mentioning:

• This is a field-based position reporting to the District Sales Leader

• Geography: Candidates must live in Pasadena, (LA Metro).

• Travel will be required within the selling geography and beyond to sales meetings, possibly across various customer conventions and occasional travel to HQ in Irvine CA

• 40% - 50% travel required in some larger geographies

• Territory Leader Salary Range;

• Associate Territory Leader – 2+ years proven B2B selling - $110,000 Territory Leader – 1-2 years pharma selling - $123,000 Territory Leader – 2-5 years pharma selling - $139,000 Sr. Territory Leader – 5-8 years pharma selling - $145,000 Sr. Territory Leader – 8+ years pharma selling - $161,000

jobs.title: Sr Analyst, Co-Manufacturing (Publishing)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

This role supports the Product Supply organization by driving strategic project management office activities across the co-manufacturing portfolio. The Senior Analyst helps translate business priorities into structured workplans, governance, reporting, and cross functional follow through to improve supply reliability, execution discipline, and decision making. The role partners closely with internal, procurement, planning, finance, quality, logistics, and external co-manufacturing stakeholders to monitor initiatives, surface risks, and track delivery against milestones. This position contributes to scalable processes, stronger operating rhythm, and visibility across the broader co-manufacturing strategy.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Support the strategic PMO agenda for co-manufacturing initiatives, including project planning, milestone management, risk tracking, issue resolution support, and status reporting.

• Build and maintain integrated project plans, action logs, governance trackers, and executive ready updates for key Product Supply priorities.

• Partner with cross functional teams such as Procurement, Planning, Quality, Logistics, Finance, Engineering, and regional supply teams to align process, deliverables, dependencies, and timelines.

• Track performance of co-manufacturing initiatives against defined objectives, KPIs, savings targets, service metrics, and implementation milestones.

• Analyze data and synthesize insights related to capacity, supply continuity, inventory implications, cost, and operational readiness to support business decisions.

• Prepare recurring and ad hoc materials for leadership reviews, steering committees, and project governance forums.

• Identify project risks, timeline slippage, and execution gaps, then recommend mitigation actions and escalation pathways when needed.

• Support onboarding, transition, expansion, or optimization activities for co-manufacturing partners in coordination with key stakeholders.

• Drive consistency in templates, reporting standards, meeting cadences, and PMO routines to strengthen execution discipline across the portfolio.

• Document decisions, assumptions, and action items to ensure follow through and transparency across stakeholders.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying process simplification opportunities and standard work that enhance speed, visibility, and collaboration.

• Ensure project documentation and communications are organized, current, and aligned with internal governance expectations.

What We’re Looking For:

jobs.description:

The Territory Leader will be experts in account management, business ownership, sales execution, resource utilization, and they will build and foster relationships with key eye care customers. The Territory Leader will relentlessly pursue excellence to maximize sales in their territory while learning to adapt to changes and needs of the business. In doing so, they will have the unique opportunity to meaningfully contribute to the growth and performance of Tarsus. This critical sales role will be ideal for someone who thinks strategically, operates with tactical precision and strives for excellence.

Geography: Candidates must live in Toledo, OH or Ann Arbor, MI.

Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role:

Account Management & Eye Care Experts

• Experts in eye care clinical information: anatomy, disease state, products, XDEMVY and office treatment patterns

• Experts in selling skills and account development including building relationships with all key stakeholders

• Experts in pull through tactics with a full understanding of managed care hurdles

Business Acumen & Sales Execution

• Drive a successful launch and ongoing performance by monitoring all key performance metrics weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annually – ability to adjust approach as needed based on data

• Share ongoing insights with leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure feedback is captured

• Personal accountability for driving the highest standards of ethics and compliance

Business Owners & Culture Champions

• Ensure PDMA compliance and adhere to all company & industry compliance guidelines

• Maximize all key resources that lead to territory success

Factors for Success:

• 2+ years pharmaceutical sales / relevant healthcare sales experience or a proven track record of business to business sales - required Proven track record of pharmaceutical launch experience - strongly preferred Eye Care experience- preferred

• Established track record with evidence of excellent problem solving and collaboration

• Highly adaptable to change, able to quickly pivot and respond given new market information in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication and change management skills

• Proven ability to escalate difficult issues and make tough decisions

• Established track record in the following job competencies: Selling skills High performance Impact & influence Customer focus & account management Maximizing resources Analytical skills Relationship building Decision making & judgment Teamwork & collaboration Adaptability & GRIT
