jobs.title: Assistant Director, Legal Transformation & Enablement
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

The Assistant Director, Legal Transformation & Enablement leads Telix's legal operations, technology enablement, process optimization, and contracting infrastructure function. This role serves as the strategic bridge between Telix Legal & Compliance and enterprise functions — translating legal and business requirements into scalable systems, workflows, and data-driven processes that enable the department to operate at scale while reducing reliance on external counsel. The role combines hands-on commercial contracts and procurement legal competency with structured legal transformation leadership, including direct ownership of legal technology platform architecture and integrations (Contract Lifecycle Management, e-billing, artificial intelligence tools), process-improvement methodology, vendor management, change management, and departmental metrics/key performance indicator reporting. The role manages the Legal Operations Specialist, United States and is central to the legal function's insourcing thesis (targeting 15-25% outside counsel spend reduction funded through productivity gains and artificial intelligence-enabled efficiency). This job description incorporates enhancements informed by benchmarking against comparable legal transformation and enablement leadership roles at other companies.

This role is the legal function’s transformation lead: part lawyer or legal-operations expert, part systems architect, part change leader. It owns the operating model that allows a lean global legal department to scale, reduce external counsel reliance, and improve business-partner experience.

We are a dynamic, fast-growing biopharmaceutical company where everyone counts. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer health and wellbeing incentives, bonus incentives, and support for learning and development. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives.

Key Accountabilities:

• Own the legal front door, intake/routing, matter management, contract playbooks, template libraries, knowledge management, and business self-service tools for the Legal & Compliance function.

• Lead AI-enabled legal workflows and agent design and management, approved prompt libraries, and artificial intelligence-assisted contract review/drafting with appropriate human oversight and privacy/security controls; proactively identify, test, and deploy new artificial intelligence capabilities to streamline legal operations.

• Partner with Information Technology and enterprise technology teams to translate legal operations requirements into system specifications, user stories, workflows, and integration requirements for Contract Lifecycle Management and adjacent legal technology platforms (e.g., e-billing, matter management, CRM/enterprise resource planning integrations).

• Collaborate with Information Technology and vendors through the full technology delivery lifecycle — requirements gathering, design, testing/user acceptance testing, and production rollout — ensuring legal technology solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with legal, risk, and governance standards.

• Own and mature the department's legal operations metrics and key performance indicator reporting, including contract cycle-time, outside-counsel spend visibility, contracting throughput, self-service adoption, and legal department satisfaction metrics, to inform continuous improvement decisions and report results to the Group General Counsel.

• Implement and manage e-billing, matter taxonomy, outside counsel guidelines, spend reporting, and budget forecasting for legal technology and enablement initiatives to drive measurable outside counsel spend reduction.

• Lead structured change management and organizational adoption programs for new legal processes and technology — including communications planning, targeted training, stakeholder feedback loops, and adoption tracking — to ensure sustained utilization across the legal function and business partner community.

• Build and maintain scalable contracting infrastructure: playbooks, escalation matrices, fallback positions, and legal front-door processes for high-volume commercial and procurement contracting; apply structured process-improvement methodology to identify and eliminate inefficiencies.

• Manage vendor relationships and budgets for legal technology and enablement tools, including Contract Lifecycle Management, e-billing, artificial intelligence platforms, and related services; develop business cases and return-on-investment models for technology investments proportionate to Telix's lean, cost-disciplined legal function.

• Manage and develop the Legal Operations Specialist, United States, and coordinate with the Legal Governance & Operations Specialist, Australia (reporting to Patent & Legal Enablement Manager) on cross-functional legal operations.

• Partner with Procurement, Information Technology, Finance, Commercial Operations, and business stakeholders to improve contracting throughput, cycle-time, and governance.

• Work closely with Finance and Group General Counsel to maintain legal budget including strong metrics, financial discipline and forecasting.

• Support contract negotiation and commercial contracting for procurement and operational matters as needed, maintaining practitioner-level legal skills alongside operational leadership to preserve credibility as a subject-matter resource for the legal team.

• Own the legal enablement strategy, including playbooks, templates, intake/routing, knowledge management, systems administration, self-service tools, and cross-functional process improvement.

• Define adoption benchmarks, stakeholder feedback loops, and change-management plans

Position Requirements

Education and Experience:

• 8+ years of combined legal practice and/or legal operations leadership experience; strong legal process and technology experience required.

• Prior in-house experience at a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or healthcare company strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience with Contract Lifecycle Management platform architecture and integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., CRM/Salesforce-type platforms, enterprise resource planning, e-billing, matter management); hands-on configuration or implementation experience with at least one Contract Lifecycle Management platform preferred.

• Experience collaborating with Information Technology teams through the full software/technology development lifecycle (requirements, design, user acceptance testing, production rollout) for legal technology solutions.

• Demonstrated experience with e-billing systems, AI/legal technology tools, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, and process/change management.

• People management experience required; project management certification (PMP, Agile/Scrum) or experience a plus.

• Some direct experience negotiating or reviewing enterprise-level commercial agreements preferred, to maintain credibility as a subject-matter resource for the legal team; however, this is secondary to the role's primary transformation and enablement mandate.

• Budget/forecasting experience for technology or operations initiatives preferred, including ability to articulate financial impact of process and technology investments.

Key Capabilities:

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world.  We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Portfolio Management Analyst
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The Portfolio Management Analyst enables data-driven portfolio decisions by connecting Global Product Brand Teams with regional planning functions and commercial organizations. The role analyzes portfolio and supply chain performance, identifies trends, risks, and opportunities, and translates complex data into clear executive insights and recommended actions.

As a critical member of the Portfolio Management team, the analyst will own the monthly Portfolio Management Review analytics and presentation process, strengthen performance measurement and governance, and support cross-functional process improvements across the S&OP organization. The analyst will also apply modern analytics and responsible AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of analysis and decision support.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Own the end-to-end monthly Portfolio Management Review (PMR) analytics and PowerPoint deck development process, including data collection, validation, synthesis, storyline development, executive-ready visuals, and distribution of supporting materials.
• Analyze portfolio performance across brands, regions, product lines, and planning horizons; identify meaningful trends, variances, outliers, risks, and opportunities that require management attention.
• Translate large and complex data sets into concise business narratives, clear recommendations, and actionable metrics that help leaders understand what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.
• Develop and maintain standardized KPI views, scorecards, dashboards, and presentation templates to improve consistency, comparability, and efficiency across monthly reviews.
• Conduct ad hoc analysis, scenario modeling, and what-if assessments to evaluate portfolio choices, timing changes, demand shifts, item productivity, and process impacts.
• Partner with Global Brand Teams, regional planning, commercial teams, Finance, Product Development, and Sourcing to understand business challenges, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive alignment on decisions and follow-up actions.
• Lead or support strategic initiatives that improve Portfolio Management and S&OP processes, including defining requirements, documenting workflows, measuring outcomes, and managing implementation milestones.
• Partner with Supply Chain Analytics to validate data, perform user acceptance testing, improve dashboard usability, and increase adoption and understanding of reporting tools.
• Use approved AI and automation tools responsibly to accelerate research, data preparation, quality checks, meeting summaries, and presentation development while applying sound judgment, protecting confidential information, and validating outputs before use.
• Maintain action logs and decision records from PMR sessions, monitor follow-through, and escalate unresolved risks or dependencies when appropriate.

What We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Analytics, Finance, Operations, or a related field.
• 2-3 years of relevant experience in supply chain, portfolio management, product development, business analytics, or a related function; consumer products experience preferred.
• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to frame ambiguous business questions, test assumptions, distinguish signal from noise, identify root causes, and form evidence-based recommendations.
• Demonstrated ability to develop recurring management presentations that combine accurate analysis, effective data visualization, and a compelling executive storyline.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data cleansing, scenario modeling, and management of large data sets; experience with Power Query or similar automation capabilities is preferred.
• Highly proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, with strong capability in slide architecture, chart selection, visual hierarchy, and communicating complex information clearly to senior stakeholders.
• Working knowledge of Business Intelligence and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms; ability to validate dashboard outputs and interpret underlying data.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

At Builder Prime, we're revolutionizing the home improvement industry by doing more than just building software—we're giving hardworking contractors their time and freedom back. Our all-in-one business management solution is the essential platform for companies at their "level-up" moment, seamlessly integrating CRM, estimating, production management, payments, and reporting. By replacing disjointed tools with a unified data and automation foundation, we empower businesses to operate more efficiently, win more jobs, and achieve their growth goals. We look for collaborative and community-oriented team members who bring initiative and curiosity to the challenge of solving problems for our customers.

Builder Prime is backed by Blueprint Equity and is an AI-forward company. That means every employee is expected to use AI on real problems—not hypotheticals, not demos, but the actual work on their desk. We invest in tools, training, and time for our team to experiment and share what they learn. We're not waiting on the sidelines, and we don't have it all figured out. We're building this practice alongside our team, in the open.




THE ROLE

This is a remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship, who presently reside in the US. There is a preference for candidates in states where we already have Builder Prime employees; California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Nebraska, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin. Builder Prime has an office in the greater Denver metro area (Westminster) that some of the sales team works out of.

We are seeking a Senior Manager of Demand Generation and Growth Marketing to help manage and grow Builder Prime's demand engine. This is a hands-on individual contributor role that blends planning and execution. You will carry a sourced-pipeline number, diversify how we generate demand, sharpen the path from lead to closed deal, and pull our lead mix upmarket toward the customers we most want to win. You will set and run the day-to-day plan and work closely with our agency and operations partners on execution, in partnership with marketing leadership on strategy. The role starts with a demand generation mandate and has room to grow into broader, full-funnel growth as the function matures. This role reports to the SVP of Marketing.



THE DAY-TO-DAY

Demand Engine and Pipeline: Manage the demand generation plan and contribute to the sourced-pipeline number that feeds sales. Recommend the channel mix and budget allocation, and run the day-to-day of the engine, measured on pipeline, cost per lead, cost per MQL, channels launched and optimized, and campaign throughput. You set and manage the plan while marketing leadership holds overall strategy and final spend approval.

Paid Channels and Optimization: Diversify demand beyond paid search into new channels including LinkedIn, paid social, TikTok, retargeting, bumper video, and intent and review platforms such as Gartner and G2, then optimize relentlessly for efficiency and pipeline contribution. Work closely with our paid media agency partner, briefing campaigns and managing performance, while the hands-on campaign setup and trafficking run through the partner.

Lead-to-Sale Orchestration: Own and fix the flow from lead to sale and the handoff to sales, cut by audience across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise, and by product interest. Partner closely with the SDR and sales teams on follow-up cadence and service-level agreements to ensure no qualified lead falls through the cracks, and serve as the connective tissue that keeps demand generation, operations, and sales aligned.

ABX and ICP Targeting: Support and help grow an account-based (ABX) motion against our target-account list, and shift our lead mix upmarket toward ideal-customer-profile accounts and away from poor-fit, sub-scale leads. You contribute to the targeting logic and account selection, meaning who we go after and why, while marketing operations owns the hands-on list building, sequencing, and technical execution. Strategy and targeting live here; the build stays with ops.

AI in the Demand Engine: Put AI to work on demand generation problems, not just on drafting. Within 90 days, we expect working AI-assisted workflows that you own: Think, scoring target accounts against our ICP at volume, enriching list data, mining sales calls for the triggers that precede a purchase, and reporting that answers what our dashboards do not. Builder Prime runs on Claude, with training from your first week.




THE MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years of experience in demand generation or growth marketing, preferably at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

 - A track record of owning a pipeline or MQL/SAL/SQL number and hitting it, with a goal- and KPI-driven, ROI-focused mindset.

 - Hands-on experience planning and managing paid media channels (paid search, LinkedIn, paid social, retargeting, video, and intent platforms such as Gartner & G2) and directing agencies or vendors against a budget.

 - Experience with account-based marketing or ABX, including how to define target accounts and coordinate air cover with sales.

 - Strong command of marketing funnel and pipeline metrics (MQL, SQL, conversion rates, cost per lead, and cost per MQL), and comfort using attribution to prove sourced pipeline.

 - Can build and interpret dashboards and reporting for demand and growth channels, and knows reporting best practices.

 - Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, and a clear understanding of how leads route, score, and flow to sales.

 - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to align cross-functional partners across marketing, operations, and sales.

 - Strong organizational skills with attention to detail, can prioritize a dynamic workload, and successfully handle multiple deadlines with a busy schedule.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment - move quickly, think strategically, identify opportunities, and excel at tactical execution.

 - Adept at using Google Suite, Slack, and CRM software.

 - Self-starter. You can work on multiple projects with many stakeholders simultaneously. You take ownership, sweat the details, and see projects through to the end with little to no support needed.

 - Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for company events, trade shows, and team offsites.

 - You have built and run at least one AI workflow that connects to a real system, such as a research agent wired to your CRM or a reporting pipeline on a cadence. Prompting and editing alone does not meet this bar.

 - You can name a specific time AI got something wrong in your work and what you changed as a result. The incident and the fix, not a general policy.

 - You use AI daily in the tools where your work lives, and can tell us what changed in how you work over the last six months.
   
    


THE NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Knowledge or experience in SaaS and the home improvement industry.

 - Experience generating demand into mid-market and enterprise segments, or moving a lead mix upmarket.

 - Hands-on experience with ABX or ABM platforms.

 - A working understanding of outbound and data-enrichment tools such as Apollo, Clay, and Instantly, and the ability to bring strong use cases to the team that runs them, even if the hands-on build stays with operations.

 - A test-and-learn mindset, with experience running structured experiments to improve funnel conversion and channel efficiency.

 - Strong understanding of business management CRM software and its application in improving business processes.

 - AI work that goes beyond chat: agents or automations connected to a CRM or data source, lightweight code (Claude Code, Apps Script, Python) applied to a marketing problem, or an AI-assisted build of something a customer or prospect actually touched.

 - Early-stage start-up (series A/B) experience.




THE BENEFITS

Why You'll Love Working Here:

 - Exceptional Health Coverage – We cover 95% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees (Aetna & Guardian), plus 50% for dependents

 - Strong Retirement Match – 401k with up to 4% company match that's immediately vested (no waiting period!)

 - Generous Time Off – 20 PTO days, 48 hours sick time, 9 paid holidays, plus a paid volunteer day to give back to your community

 - Annual International Retreat – All-expenses-paid company trip to connect with teammates in amazing destinations (This year we went to Cancun, Mexico! Join us for our next one in 2027)

 - Life Happens Coverage – Company-paid life insurance ($50k), AD&D, and short-term disability, plus optional accident, hospital, critical illness, and additional life insurance

 - Grow With Us – $300 annual professional development stipend, plus an incredible sabbatical at 5 years (2 extra weeks PTO + $1,000 travel bonus)

 - Comprehensive Parental Leave – 10 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing parents

 - Fully Equipped From Day One – Company-provided laptop and all the equipment you need to succeed



PLUS…

 - Room to Grow: We LOVE to promote from within. Show us your best stuff, and you'll have ample opportunity to grow and advance.

 - Flexible Work Arrangements: We are currently a mix of hybrid and fully remote roles across multiple time zones to support work-life balance.

 - We Hate Red Tape: We never restrict our team's creativity, so you'll have the freedom to experiment and test out new ideas. At Builder Prime, "Iterate To Innovate" is a foundational philosophy.

 - Strong Culture: Through the use of platforms like Bonusly, the Coffee Chat slack app, and other events and initiatives (both virtual and in-person), we strive to make work both a place where you can do the best work of your career AND have fun. There is no reason it can't be both!



This position will pay a base salary of $135,000 to $145,000, depending on experience and location, with an additional variable compensation element to be discussed in the interview process.

Builder Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at all levels. We also participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in the U.S.

jobs.title: Electrochemical Engineer II/III​
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Solid Power is seeking an Electrochemical Engineer to join our talented team working to revolutionize the battery industry through the development of next-generation all-solid-state rechargeable batteries. Solid Power offers a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment where engineers contribute directly to advancing cutting-edge technology. This position will be part of the Electrolyte Systems Engineering team and will focus on characterizing the electrochemical performance of current and future generations of electrolyte materials. The Electrochemical Engineer will execute and improve electrochemical testing methods, analyze data, and translate results into engineering insights that support product development, process optimization, and scale-up activities from pre-pilot through pilot manufacturing.

Job Duties:

• Design, execute, and interpret electrochemical experiments to evaluate the performance and stability of current and next-generation solid-state electrolyte products.

• Translate electrochemical feedback into actionable product and process improvements.

• Correlate electrolyte processing conditions, material properties, and microstructure to electrochemical performance, enabling process-structure-property-performance (PSPP) understanding and decision-making.

• Perform electrochemical characterization such as electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), cyclic voltammetry (CV), critical current density (CCD) testing, DC polarization, rate capability testing, and long-term cycling studies, with opportunities to apply more advanced analysis methods such as distribution of relaxation times (DRT) analysis.

• Support the development and refinement of characterization methods and analytical approaches to improve understanding of electrolyte behavior, degradation mechanisms, and electrochemical stability.

• Apply statistical and data analysis tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Python) to evaluate experimental results, identify significant trends, and support data-driven decision making.

• Contribute to root-cause investigations involving material performance, product variability, process changes, and customer-relevant cell outcomes.

• Analyze, visualize, and communicate complex electrochemical datasets to technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and development priorities.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrochemistry, Materials Science & Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical field.

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience developing or applying electrochemical characterization methods in batteries, solid-state batteries, electrochemical materials, or related technologies; level will be determined based on experience.

• Working knowledge of electrochemical techniques including EIS, CV, galvanostatic cycling, CCD testing, DC polarization, and interpretation of electrochemical datasets; experience with DRT or other advanced analysis methods is preferred.

• Strong understanding of structure-property-performance relationships in electrochemical systems and the ability to connect material behavior to product performance.

• Experience designing statistically sound experimental plans (DOE), analyzing large datasets, and drawing actionable conclusions from experimental results.

• Proficiency with data analysis and statistical software (JMP, Minitab, Python, MATLAB, Origin, or similar).

• Experience with root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-functional technical problem solving.

• Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to engineers, scientists, management, and external stakeholders.

• Ability to independently execute technical workstreams and contribute to cross-functional projects in a fast-paced development environment.

Physical Requirements:

• Required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as necessary including, but not limited to eye protection, hair net, gloves, face mask, coveralls, full-face respirator or PAPR

Salary Range: $80,000 - $125,000/year

Benefits: Solid Power offers a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical/dental/vision insurance, employer paid Life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance, 401k with company match, 8 paid holidays + the week between Christmas and New Years off, Unlimited PTO, up to six (6) weeks paid FMLA leave, cell phone reimbursement and eligibility to participate in our bonus and equity plans.

Export Control Requirements: This position could require access to technology, software and other information that is subject to governmental access control restrictions, due to export controls. Employment in this position is conditioned on the continued availability of government authorization to authorize release of such items, to the extent required, including without limitation an export license, or other documentation required to establish authorization to receive access to such items.

Company may delay commencement of employment, rescind an offer of employment, terminate employment, and/or may modify job responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and/or access to Company facilities and information systems, as Company deems appropriate, in order to ensure compliance with applicable government access control restrictions.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 7 days and will remain open until filled or adjusted based on the volume of applicants.

All offers of employment at Solid Power are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background check.

Please no soliciting from staffing agencies. Thank you!

jobs.title: Director, Global Medical Excellence
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

As we continue to expand our global footprint, we seek an innovative and experienced Director, Global MSL Excellence to lead the development, standardization, and continuous enhancement of Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Medical Advisor (“Field Medical”) capabilities across regions. Reporting to the Head of Medical Content and Training (MCT) within Global Medical Excellence, this role is a critical driver of global Field Medical strategy, performance, and operational excellence. The Director will design and implement frameworks, tools, processes, and training that strengthen the effectiveness, consistency, and scientific impact of the Field Medical organization.

This highly visible role partners closely with Global Medical Strategy, Field Medical, Medical Content and Training, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Compliance, and regional Medical Affairs teams to ensure globally harmonized and high impact Field Medical roles. Key responsibilities in this role include:

Global Field Medical Strategy & Standards

• Lead the creation and execution of a cohesive global MSL excellence strategy aligned with medical and corporate objectives.

• Establish global standards for scientific exchange, insights generation, field activity execution, and external engagement.

• Partner with regional Field Medical leaders to ensure consistency while enabling region-specific adaptability.

Competency Framework, Onboarding & Capability Development

• Develop and maintain a global MSL competency model, certification programs, and role expectations.

• Partner with Medical Content and Training to design robust field medical onboarding programs and continuous learning curricula (e.g., journal clubs, reinforcement/verbalization trainings), including scientific acumen, communication skills, engagement planning, and compliance requirements.

• Partner with MCT to plan and execute integrated launch trainings, new data, congress preparation, and medical platforms.

Insights, Execution Quality & Field Performance Optimization

• Partner with Medical Analytics and Insights/Medical Solutions teams to streamline insights capture, governance, and analytics, driving high-quality, actionable intelligence into medical strategy.

• Define KPIs and dashboards measuring MSL performance, impact, and scientific engagement excellence to foster continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Vertical Marketing Manager, Automotive & Emerging SMB Verticals
jobs.description:
The Position

CallRail is looking for a lead engagement platform: we show businesses which marketing drives their calls, forms, and chats, and we help them answer, qualify, and route those leads around the clock. We're looking for a Vertical Marketing Manager to own a portfolio of our emerging markets, with automotive at the center. Think of the role as general manager for that portfolio: you set the strategy, you own the number, and you're the company's go-to on these markets.

You'll build the personas, positioning, and messaging for these verticals, verticalizing our go-to-market narrative for each audience. From there you'll partner with demand generation, customer marketing, and content on how it comes to life, and work closely with sales, product, and leadership on what we build and say. Expect roughly equal parts strategy and execution.

Automotive is the priority. It's one of our fastest-growing segments, and the aftermarket — repair and service businesses, tire and quick-service shops, collision centers, and the parts suppliers and retailers who serve them — is where you'll go deepest. Alongside it, you'll own a portfolio of our emerging small business verticals. They sit at different stages and require different levels of investment, and determining where to focus is a core part of the role. What connects them is the customer: small businesses that win or lose on the leads they capture.

What You'll Do

• You act like an owner. These markets are your line of business. You know their performance, their risks, and their opportunities inside and out, and you carry the accountability that comes with it.

• You bring an informed point of view. You represent home services in cross-functional and leadership conversations, and your perspective carries weight because it's grounded in real expertise — what customers are telling you, what the data shows, what competitors are doing.

• You advocate for what your markets need. You don't wait for a door to open; you open it. When you see something we need in order to win, you build the case for it, bring the rationale and the numbers, and champion it until it gets a real decision.

• You go deep. You're genuinely curious about this industry, its buyers, and the forces shaping it. You want to keep learning, testing, and refining what works.

What You'll Own

Portfolio strategy and business performance

• Own the go-to-market strategy across your automotive & other SMB verticals: how we position and message to each audience, and the plan to hit our acquisition and revenue goals

• Decide where your time and our investment go. These markets won't all need the same thing, and setting that balance — then making the case for it — is yours to own

• Live in the numbers that define the health of the business: customers, new MRR, churn, ARPU, conversion rate, and product adoption. You'll spot emerging trends and issues early, work cross-functionally to understand what's driving them, and bring a plan when one is needed.

• Report on performance to leadership with the insight and executive presence to explain what's changing, what it means, and what you're doing about it

Automotive market and competitive expertise

• Be CallRail's subject matter expert on the automotive aftermarket: the buyers, the workflows, the operational realities, the vendor landscape, and the economics of how these businesses grow

• Own the automotive buyer personas and the value propositions, positioning, and messaging built on them — the work that differentiates CallRail in an increasingly crowded lead engagement and AI voice market

• Build the proof that makes our case credible: customer stories, benchmarks, and ROI framing grounded in how these businesses actually operate

• Track the competitive set continuously: who's winning, who's new, where they beat us, where we beat them, and what we should do about it. Feed that intelligence to product, sales, and leadership

• Regularly surface the headwinds and tailwinds shaping the market and translate them into implications for our strategy

• Validate market requirements through customer interviews, surveys, win/loss analysis, sales insight, and usage data

• Be the face of CallRail in the automotive market: trade shows, industry speaking engagements, webinars, panels, podcasts, etc.

Your broader vertical portfolio

• Own the positioning and messaging for the other emerging small business verticals, scaling the depth to the opportunity.

• Keep a live read on each: where we're winning, where we're losing, and which ones are showing early signs of becoming a bigger bet

• Size and pressure-test opportunities, in these markets and in ones we haven't entered: how big, how winnable, what it would take, and what we would have to be right about

• Bring recommendations with a clear case for investing or passing. Knowing which markets to walk away from matters as much as knowing which to chase

• Run early, lightweight tests where the signal looks promising — positioning, messaging, and proof — and build a repeatable approach the team can use the next time we look at a new vertical

Cross-functional leadership

• Serve as the hub between sales, product marketing, customer marketing, demand generation, and product development, feeding market insight into each function and making sure everyone is marching in the same direction

• Serve as the messaging authority for your verticals: consulting across marketing for campaign and content development

• Pressure-test the work happening across teams against a simple bar: does it solve a real customer pain point, strengthen our competitive position, resonate with the segment we're targeting, and drive measurable results?

• Partner with product development teams as the voice of your customers, bringing market insight that shapes the roadmap

• Enable sales and support: train them on the problems we solve for these buyers, and work with sales enablement to build the internal tools and external collateral they need

What You'll Need

• BS/BA and 4–6 years of experience in a strategic marketing role focused on small business buyers, including direct experience marketing to automotive businesses

• A track record of owning a strategy end to end and being accountable for the results, not just executing someone else's plan

• Experience entering or evaluating a new market: sizing the opportunity, building the case, and standing up positioning where none existed

• Strong analytical instincts and genuine comfort with data — you can get to the story behind the metric and build a case around it

• Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence and presence to represent your point of view to senior leaders and to external audiences

• Demonstrated ability to influence and align cross-functional partners without formal authority

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where you'll prioritize, make tradeoffs, and shift between strategic thinking and hands-on execution in the same day

If you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience.

Additional Perks

• Healthcare (one option covered at 100% for employees), Dental & Vision Coverage

• Competitive HSA with company matching

• Paid parental leave

• Flexible vacation policy

• 401K options with company dollar-for-dollar match

• Employee stock options available from day one

• $2,000 annual educational allowance

• Catered lunch every Tuesday * an in-office perk

• MARTA transportation or office parking expenses covered

• Employee charitable donation company match, up to $500 annually

• Regular company outings and events

• Hybrid work options with $500 office stipend to set up your home office

• Designated bike storage

Learn more: https://www.callrail.com/about/

You Are Welcome Here

CallRail understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company's core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Continuous adoption of AI technologies is essential to this role. You will be expected to leverage AI platforms to streamline operations, solve complex problems, and stay ahead of industry benchmarks.

*** This position is based out of our Atlanta office. Through December 2026, employees are expected to work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Beginning in January 2027, CallRail will transition to a 3 day hybrid work model. Employees will work in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Development & Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Wildfires are a $20 trillion crisis. Earth Force is building the technology that dramatically increases the pace and scale of fuels reduction and forest thinning—creating resilient forests and protecting people and communities from the devastating effects of wildfire.

We develop integrated computer vision systems—hardware through UI—deployed on forestry machines operating in remote forest environments. Our platform measures trees in real time, automates production reporting, and enables precision silviculture at a scale the industry has never seen. We work primarily with the U.S. Forest Service and their implementation partners under multi-year program agreements.

We’re commercially deployed and approaching scale. Our next season of growth will deliver on the capabilities our tech has developed, broadening the trust we've built with our partners to serve those working to protect land from catastrophic wildfire.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Earth Force exists to reduce the risk of catastrophic wildfires through technology, data, and operational excellence. As we continue to grow and scale our impact, we are seeking a Director of Corporate Development to help drive the company’s most important strategic, financial, and capital formation initiatives. This role will partner closely with the CEO, executive leadership, and Board of Directors to support capital strategy, strategic finance, business intelligence, and high-priority corporate development opportunities. The ideal candidate combines strong financial and strategic judgment with intellectual curiosity and the ability to investigate complex opportunities, develop clear recommendations, and help drive them through execution.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience in corporate development, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, management consulting, investing, or similar roles.

 - Experience interfacing directly with Boards of Directors, institutional investors, and senior executive stakeholders.

 - Experience with capital formation, fundraising, or complex financing transactions, including evaluating creative and non-traditional sources of capital.

 - Strong strategic finance capabilities, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, long-range planning, capital allocation, and investment evaluation.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently investigate new markets, technologies, R&D or laboratory initiatives, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

 - Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to connect operational, financial, and strategic considerations.

 - Exceptional communication skills, including experience creating Board, investor, and executive-level materials.


PREFERRED

 - Experience in investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate development, or a similarly rigorous financial environment.

 - Experience supporting significant capital raises, ideally across multiple financing structures.

 - Experience with project finance, structured capital, government funding, strategic investment, or other non-traditional capital sources.

 - Experience supporting M&A, partnerships, new business opportunities, or other corporate development initiatives.

 - Experience in a high-growth, investor-backed company environment.

 - Exposure to climate, forestry, infrastructure, energy, construction, industrial services, or other asset-intensive industries.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-stakes business problems, developing creative approaches to capital and growth, and serving as a trusted thought partner to the CEO, CFO, Board, and investors.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Project Manager - Digital Transformation 
Sunrise Farms is a group of companies with primary focus in the poultry industry. 
From our hatcheries to our “ready to eat” state of the art cooking facilities we service customers in the retail, food service and industrial sectors. We are proud of our support of the Canadian farm as well as our investment in the latest equipment and technologies at our facilities across Canada.  
Role: 
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager (PM) to join our Digital Transformation Program, a multi-year initiative modernizing business systems, processes, and data capabilities across our manufacturing operations in Canada.  
The PM’s first project will be the Data Foundations Project, which includes establishing data governance and a reporting center of excellence (COE), enhancing an interim SQL Warehouse solution, and finally delivery a true modern data platform (Snowflake) with medallion architecture.  On this project the PM will oversee a number of technical resources, as well as a tiger team of analysts from across the organization who represent all of our key departments. 
The PM will also manage dependencies across other key program initiatives, including the ERP (Syspro) Implementation Project, the WMS/MES Implementation Project, CMMS Implementation Project, and the EDI Transformation Project.  Being able to build relationships and coordinate activities in an environment where there is A LOT going on is a must. 
Our organization is continuing to grow, and the ideal candidate will be able to lead more than one project at a time.  They will play a long-term role in leading enterprise projects and strategic initiatives that support and enable that growth, including future data specific projects (AI, IOT), enterprise solution projects (CRM, TMS, QMS), and subsets of M&A projects. 
The ideal candidate will have a technical background paired with project management expertise, strong communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. 
Responsibilities: 
Assign, track, and manage tasks for a technical team of data integration analysts, report analysts, and other specialists. 
Manage both technical and business resources assigned to the project from our ERP implementation partner and any other vendor as required.  Track hours of vendors against a budget. 
Manage and enable a tiger team of analysts from across the business in validating solutions and reporting, and in highlighting project progress to key stakeholders across the organization. 
Implement simple common sense master data management processes. 
Enhance our current SQL based data warehouse to allow for the sustainment of key reporting through the plant by plant phased rollout of our new ERP (Syspro).  
Establish reporting governance and a reporting COE that leverages both IT resources, and enables tiger team members to create reports and conduct analysis tasks, 
Maintain a backlog of reports 
Lead the implementation of a best-in-class data platform solution (snowflake) with medallion architecture. 
Manage dependencies and resource constraints across projects in the program. 
Take on any other tasks related to Data as required by the program. 
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource plans 
Apply project management best practices (waterfall or hybrid)  
Identify and manage project risks, issues, and change requests 
Facilitate workshops, steering committee updates, and decision-making sessions with executive sponsors and project stakeholders. 
Requirements: 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field 
PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or ITIL certifications considered an asset 
8+ years of progressive project management experience, including at least 3 years managing large-scale enterprise IT or digital transformation projects 
Hands-on experience managing technology implementations involving enterprise software vendors and systems integrators 
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in manufacturing, industrial, or asset-intensive environments preferred 
Hands-on technical experience such as in ELT, SQL Stored Procedures, Python or in pipes, coding, or scripting that connects to databases. 
Familiarity with data governance, data platforms, or analytics modernization projects preferred 
Competencies: 
Strong technical competency with data related topics 
Strong organizational and time management skills with a focus on delivering results 
Lead multiple projects and initiatives at the same time 
Excellent communication, facilitation, and negotiation abilities across all organizational levels 
Strategic thinker who can also dive into execution details when required 
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities 
Play a key role in a company-wide digital transformation that is reshaping how we operate and make decisions. 
Collaborate with talented professionals in IT, Operations, and Data disciplines. 
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

Partnering with design engineers early on in the process, you will ensure manufacturability, build the first prototype, design the build flow and fixturing, and finalize the process for transition to production. Once transitioned, you will own the effort to scale production and meet K2's ever-growing demand. You will pioneer new techniques for manufacturing complex PCBAs, harnessing, and integrated electronics systems, and set the direction for how mechanical teams approach the electromechanical assemblies and machined components these electronics integrate into. In your first 6 months you will develop manufacturing methods and tooling for integrated avionics systems, define manufacturing flows for electronic subsystems, and lead Design-for-Excellence (DFX) guidance across PCBs, PCBAs, machined components, and higher-level assemblies. As a Principal on the team, you will also set manufacturing policy and standards, proactively flag risk in upcoming designs before it becomes a problem, plan ahead for the manufacturability of future programs, and build tools that make the rest of the Manufacturing Engineering team faster and more effective.

Responsibilities

• Lead DFX reviews with design engineers across PCBs, PCBAs, machined components, and assemblies for initial design, flight hardware, and tooling

• Lead the development of innovative manufacturing systems for spacecraft electronics, including PCBA integration, wire harnessing, and electromechanical sub-assemblies

• Set manufacturing policy, standards, and best practices for the Manufacturing Engineering organization, proactively identifying and mitigating manufacturability, process, and quality risks before they surface

• Plan manufacturing strategy, tooling, and capacity investments ahead of future product designs and program roadmaps

• Research and pilot new assembly methodologies and automation technologies, using data-driven analysis to optimize current production and inform manufacturing business decisions

• Create custom tools, automation, and processes, including Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software, to support the manufacturing technologies you create and streamline the work of the broader Manufacturing Engineering team

• Demonstrate the advanced manufacturing techniques on prototypes, working with the design teams to continuously improve the manufacturability of the designs

• Develop the subassembly build flow and iterate to create an efficient production flow for the satellite and ensure that build times align with current takt times

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior Manufacturing Engineers, technicians, and design peers on electronics manufacturing best practices

• Partner with a team of advanced manufacturing engineers to lead R&D of novel manufacturing technologies for current and future spacecraft products

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, mechanical, aerospace, or other relevant engineering discipline

• 10+ years of experience in a high volume, rapid production environment in a manufacturing, integration, and/or design engineering role with demonstrated excellence leading product development and process improvements.

• Strong understanding of IPC standards (e.g., IPC-A-610, IPC-A-600, J-STD-001) for PCB/PCBA workmanship and inspection

• Strong understanding of how to set up a manufacturing/production floor for first article builds and transitioning from low to high-rate manufacturing of wire harness manufacturing or PCBA/mechanical enclosure integration.

• Strong understanding of DFX) principles, with the ability to guide design teams across PCBs, PCBAs, machined components, and mechanical assemblies

• Strong understanding of GD&T and mechanical assembly drawings, with the ability to review and provide feedback on electrical and mechanical designs

• Strong understanding of conformal coating and associated inspection/rework methods for PCBAs, per standards such as IPC-CC-830 and NASA-STD-8739.1

• Demonstrated ability to set manufacturing policy and proactively identify and mitigate manufacturing risk across programs

• Experience developing or deploying tools, automation, or software that scale the efficiency of a manufacturing engineering team

• Deep understanding and experience with CAD software (NX or equivalent)

• Strong understanding and experience working with MES, with the ability to set up the foundation for procedure creation, template generation and documentation of non-conformances

• Demonstrated ability to independently develop production processes from the ground up, including driving design improvements for manufacturing

Nice to Have

• Strong understanding and track record of tooling design for electromechanical subassemblies and electronics

• Experience with aerospace manufacturing standards such as soldering standards, torque specifications, and quality assurance standards

• Familiarity with data analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL) or automation platforms used to process manufacturing data and drive business decisions

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $175,000 – $200,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa, skrátený pracovný pomer 30h týždenne, Banská Bystrica
jobs.location: Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia (Slovak Republic)
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Športová karta Multisport,
• Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
• Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
• Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
• Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
• 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na skrátený pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 30 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Bánskej Bystrici.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 6,18 € brutto/hod., vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 04.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­­­­­­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: Facility Asset Data Collection Specialist - ADC
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend has an exciting new opportunity! The purpose of the Asset Data Collection Specialist position is to conduct thorough, high-quality physical assessments of diverse facilities, serving as a critical frontline resource for our data-driven consulting services. This role demands precision, technical curiosity, and a commitment to delivering accurate information that empowers our clients to make informed capital investment and operational decisions.

The successful candidate will be personable, a strong communicator, and a team player. They will possess a relentless work ethic, a high level of self-motivation, and the ability to maintain a positive attitude while managing demanding travel schedules and complex site environments.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conducts detailed, onsite walk-through surveys (ranging from single-day visits to multi-day assignments) to inspect mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, fire and life safety systems, building envelopes, and site improvements. (This may require climbing two-story ladders, accessing roof systems, or utilizing lifts; lift operating certification is a plus).

• Operates as a team player, collaborating with colleagues and senior staff, communicating clearly and effectively, and bringing a positive attitude to each work day, project, and situation.

• Communicates effectively with site stakeholders and internal project teams to ensure seamless project execution and to resolve on-the-ground challenges immediately.
• Travels up to 75% of the time, including internationally, to various facility locations, requiring excellent time management and organizational discipline.
• Other duties as assigned.

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY

• Decisions are made with an understanding of standard operating procedures, data collection protocols, and safety policies.
• This position is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of data that will ultimately drive significant client decisions.
• Errors in judgment or data collection could impact the reliability of project deliverables, necessitating a high degree of accountability, attention to detail, and proactive communication with supervisor and project teams.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in architecture, engineering, construction management, facilities management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 0-3 years of experience in building evaluation, field inspection, or construction operations, with a working understanding of major building systems: mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, structural, building envelope, material handling.
• Demonstrated experience with onsite data collection or field auditing is highly desired.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on clarity and precision.
• Strong organizational skills, with a proven ability to manage time and tasks while working remotely and traveling extensively.
• Ability to translate complex technical observations into clear, usable data.
• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Teams, Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.).
• Advanced proficiency in using mobile technology, including data collection applications, digital photography, and virtual collaboration tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to troubleshoot site-specific issues independently.

CERTIFICATES and/or LICENSES

COMMUNICATION SKILLS
