jobs.title: Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
jobs.description:
About the Team

Netlify’s Finance team builds the financial foundation that helps the company plan, operate, and make informed decisions. The team owns our operating model, management reporting, budgeting and planning, and the company-level metrics leadership uses to understand performance and make tradeoffs.

As Finance Manager, you’ll own the core corporate finance cycle - from monthly reporting and forecasting to planning, scenario analysis, and KPI reporting - and help shape how those processes evolve as Netlify scales. This is a hands-on role with meaningful room to improve how the function operates: strengthening the models and insights behind business decisions while using AI, automation, and better tooling to make Finance faster, more scalable, and less dependent on manual work.

What You'll Do

• Drive the monthly reporting cadence: updating operating models, variance analysis, and the management reporting package, with actionable insights for leadership

• Take full responsibility for the 3-statement operating model and driver-based forecast, including structural changes to how the model is built as our business scales

• Help drive the annual planning process, including planning templates, scenario models, and turning strategic priorities into the assumptions and targets the plan is built on

• Build and maintain the company-level KPI and metrics layer, including ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC payback, and Rule of 40, and explain what moved and why each month

• Build the scenario and sensitivity models leadership uses to make capital and headcount decisions

• Own department-level budget tracking, and serve as the standing point of contact for department leaders on budget, headcount, and software spend

• Automate manual work across the close and forecast cycles using AI and better tooling, with measurable reduction in cycle time

• Opportunity to partner with GTM leadership on sales planning and KPI tracking

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years in FP&A or strategic finance, including several at a SaaS or usage-based business. An investment banking, consulting or private equity background preferred; but strong modeling skills, ability to develop frameworks to solve complex problems and ability to run scenarios is a must

• A history of building 3-statement models from scratch, with scenario and sensitivity analysis, and of making structural changes to a model rather than only updating inputs

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and core accounting principles

• Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, and comfort with large datasets

• Deep command of SaaS metrics and their drivers, with a point of view on which ones actually matter at our stage

• Understanding of how financial data flows and experience reconciling systems

• Working knowledge of SQL

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and defining your own approach to problems that arrive without a defined scope

• Experience as the finance point of contact for non-finance leaders, and the ability to make financial concepts clear to people who don't speak finance

• Hands-on experience building AI workflows for finance work, including validating AI output and understanding where AI fails

• Deep curiosity about our business, product, customers, competitors and industry trends

This Role Is a Great Fit If

• You want to own a function, not contribute to one. The monthly close, the operating model, and the planning cycle would be yours to run and to redesign.

• You're comfortable being the only person on this work. There is no junior analyst supporting the role and no plan to add one. You will build it and run it yourself.

• You take quality seriously. You know the difference between a variance explanation that's technically accurate and one that's actually useful to a business leader, and you hold yourself to the latter.

• You notice when something is slower or more manual than it needs to be, and you fix it without being asked.

• You feel confident communicating directly with department leaders about budget and headcount.

• You're excited to build. The tooling, the reporting layer, and the automation work are all genuinely open, and there is room to make this function structurally better.

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include:

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to "build a better web" and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we're excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify's equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $123,000 - $166,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Line Lead Cosmetic Repair - Chesterfield, VA
jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Corporate Development
jobs.description:
WHAT IS KALSHI?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

 - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

 - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.




ROLE ROADMAP

As part of the Corp Dev / BD team at Kalshi, you'll help identify and execute the strategic opportunities that can accelerate the company's growth. You'll work directly with leadership to evaluate where Kalshi should build, buy, partner, or expand - from acquisitions and strategic investments to partnerships, new markets, and distribution opportunities. You'll be responsible for finding the right opportunities, developing the business case, and driving them from initial conversation through execution.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Identify and evaluate M&A, strategic investment, partnership, and other business development opportunities

 - Build relationships with founders, financial institutions, fintech companies, technology platforms, investors, and other strategic partners

 - Develop business cases, financial models, and strategic analyses to evaluate potential transactions and partnerships

 - Lead opportunities from initial sourcing and outreach through diligence, negotiation, execution, and launch

 - Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, strategic partnerships, investments, and acquisitions

 - Build and maintain a pipeline of companies, partners, and opportunities that could be strategically valuable to Kalshi

 - Track market developments, competitors, and emerging trends across trading, fintech, payments, financial infrastructure, and adjacent markets

 - Support post-transaction integration and help ensure strategic partnerships and acquisitions deliver against their objectives




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years of experience in corporate development, business development, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, strategy, or a related field

 - Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience evaluating complex strategic or transaction opportunities

 - Experience sourcing, negotiating, or executing M&A, investments, partnerships, or other strategic transactions

 - Excellent judgment - able to quickly understand a business or opportunity and identify the factors that matter most

 - Strong commercial instincts and comfort negotiating with sophisticated counterparties

 - Experience working directly with senior leadership and communicating complex analysis in a clear, concise way

 - Ability to build relationships with founders, executives, investors, and strategic partners

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and a lot of ambiguity

 - High level of ownership and the ability to drive complex, cross-functional projects from idea through execution

 - Familiarity with trading, fintech, financial services, payments, crypto, or regulated businesses is a plus
   
   


NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE

Salary Range: $200,000 – $275,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.




OUR CULTURE

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.




COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Avionics Technician
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled Specialized Technician to join our Avionics Test team. In this role, you will be responsible for the wiring harness assembly, test rack builds, and the mechanical build of the FlatSats. You will work in a cleanroom environment, transforming high-level schematics into test-ready hardware.

Key Responsibilities

 - Wire Harness Fabrication: Build, route, and terminate complex satellite wires and coax harnesses, including crimping, Shielding, and potting, adhering to strict NASA or IPC standards.

 - Precision Assembly: Proficiency in precision assembly techniques, including mechanical fastening, bonding, and alignment.

 - System Integration: Perform assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) activities for satellite and spacecraft development projects, following engineering specifications, procedures, and safety protocols.

 - Functional Testing: Use oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and spectrum analyzers to perform continuity checks, insulation resistance tests, and power-on self-tests.

 - Documentation: Maintain meticulous "as-built" records, logs, and red-line drawings to ensure full traceability for every flight component.

 - Cleanroom Protocol: Maintain a controlled ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) safe environment and follow strict ISO Class cleanroom procedures.

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in satellite or spacecraft assembly and integration, specifically in aerospace structures, avionics integration, and harnessing.

 - Certifications: Active or prior certification in NASA-STD-8739 or IPC-J-STD-001 (Space Addendum).

 - Technical Proficiency: * Expert-level ability to read complex electrical schematics and 3D CAD models.

 - Experience with high-density connectors (Micro-D, Nano-D, Circular Mil-Spec).

 - Familiarity with quality standards and processes related to aerospace manufacturing.

 - Knowledge of vacuum-compatible materials and outgassing prevention.

 - Working knowledge of precision measurement tools and equipment used in satellite and spacecraft assembly and integration.

 - Ability to work effectively in a team environment, collaborating with engineers and technicians.

 - Strong commitment to safety, always adhering to safety protocols and guidelines.

 - Soft Skills: Extreme attention to detail—spaceflight doesn't allow for a "do-over."

Physical Requirements

 - Ability to work under a microscope for extended periods.

 - Manual dexterity for handling tiny components and delicate wiring.

 - Ability to work in a manufacturing lab environment.

 - Ability to carry 50lbs




WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package to reset and recharge - starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan with generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup and all the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office with the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference

Ready to join a team where your contributions matter and your future is bright? Let's build something extraordinary together.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Operations Coordinator

Compensation: $65,000–$80,000 annually
Equity: Equity included
Location: El Segundo, CA
Work Policy: Onsite
Level: L2
Hiring Count: 1

Who we are

Rangeview is on a mission to build the foundry system that reindustrializes America. We exist to break the legacy manufacturing trap by reinventing critical production for the twenty-first century. Through advanced software, deep automation, breakthroughs in materials science, and modern financing strategies, Rangeview rewrites both the cost curve and the power structure of making metal parts.

What’s in it for you

As an Operations Coordinator at Rangeview, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring people-centric logistics are executed flawlessly.

You’ll work closely with Executive Leadership and Talent Acquisition and coordinate across the company, giving you broad visibility into how a rapidly growing advanced manufacturing company operates and expands.

This is a highly visible role for a capable coordinator who enjoys bringing order to moving pieces, managing complex schedules and logistics, anticipating what people will need, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from the start. Rather than simply receiving administrative tasks, you’ll be expected to develop systems and processes to manage recurring workflows, effectively and efficiently navigate complex coordination, and help improve the user experiences that are crucial to Rangeview’s growth.

What you’ll do

Scheduling, Travel & Operational Coordination

• Coordinate complex calendars, meetings, schedules, and operational logistics across the organization.

• Support company leadership with calendar management, meeting coordination, travel, and related administrative logistics.

• Coordinate logistics for important internal meetings, facility tours, and company activities.

• Coordinate business travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, itineraries, and schedule changes.

• Prepare and maintain clear travel itineraries and ensure travelers have the information they need before departure.

• Manage last-minute scheduling and travel changes and communicate updates to everyone affected.

• Maintain accurate schedules, trackers, documentation, and other operational information in a manner that ensures appropriate visibility without adding undue burden

• Identify recurring coordination challenges and help develop simple, scalable processes to address them.

• Partner across teams to ensure operational details are handled flawlessly from planning through completion.

Recruiting & Interview Coordination

• Own interview scheduling and coordination across candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.

• Coordinate complex interview schedules across multiple interviewers while balancing candidate and team availability.

• Coordinate onsite interviews, including schedules, rooms, candidate arrival, interviewer communication, and other day-of logistics.

• Communicate schedule changes and interview details clearly to candidates and internal interview teams.

• Maintain accurate candidate, interview, and scheduling information in Greenhouse.

• Serve as a responsive and professional logistical point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process.

• Facilitate rapid processing of candidates through the recruiting pipeline.

• Partner closely with Talent Acquisition to coordinate candidate next steps and deliver an organized, responsive candidate experience.

Visitor Experience

• Create a polished and welcoming onsite experience for candidates, investors, suppliers, partners, and other important visitors.

• Prepare for scheduled visits by coordinating arrival details, parking, meeting spaces, schedules, hosts, tours, and other logistics.

• Greet visitors and connect them with the appropriate Rangeview team members.

• Provide front-desk presence during scheduled tours and important visits.

• Support administration of resources to ensure visitor satisfaction (i.e. availability of beverages, marketing materials, etc.)

• Coordinate internal communication so relevant employees know when guests are arriving and what is expected.

• Anticipate potential logistical issues and resolve them before they affect the visitor experience.

What you’ll need

• 2+ years of experience in operations, executive or administrative support, logistics, supply chain, project coordination, recruiting coordination, or another coordination-intensive role.

• Demonstrated experience independently managing complex schedules, calendars, meetings, or other time-sensitive logistics.

• Experience coordinating business travel or comparable multi-step logistics involving reservations, schedules, itineraries, transportation, and last-minute changes.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, deadlines, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and recognize what needs to happen next without always being prompted.

• Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize effectively when multiple things require attention.

• Resourcefulness and comfort solving problems when there is not an established process.

• A personable, polished, and professional presence when interacting with employees, candidates, executives, suppliers, investors, and visitors.

• Ability to work independently while recognizing when an issue needs to be escalated.

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, schedules, and plans can change quickly.

• Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace or similar productivity tools.

• Ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information.

• Ability to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting executives, senior leaders, or multiple internal stakeholders.

• Experience coordinating external visitors, investors, vendors, suppliers, candidates, or customers.

• Experience with Greenhouse or another applicant tracking system.

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, reporting, trackers, or dashboards.

• Experience creating process documentation, SOPs, or improving operational workflows.

• Experience in a startup, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, hardware, or other fast-paced technical environment.

A bachelor’s degree is not required.

Additional Requirements

• Must be able to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.

• Must meet Rangeview’s ITAR eligibility requirements.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $65,000–$80,000 annually + equity.

Compensation within the range will be determined based on demonstrated experience, qualifications, scope of previous coordination responsibilities, and relevant operational experience.

Rangeview offers a competitive benefits package, including equity, unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Compliance

Rangeview is a DDTC-registered, ITAR-compliant business. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Rangeview is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Rangeview is governed on the basis of merit and aptitude and will not be influenced in any manner by any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Renewals Manager, Indirect Procurement
jobs.description:
The Role

As Renewals Manager, you'll own Everlaw's rolling pipeline of internal SaaS and IT contract renewals, making sure no agreement lapses into an unfavorable auto-renewal while driving cost savings through usage analysis and license right-sizing. Partnering closely with internal teams across Engineering, IT, HR, and Marketing, you'll manage the day-to-day commercial lifecycle for our expiring vendor contracts and build disciplined, data-backed renewal processes.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Maintain a rolling 12-month renewal calendar, initiating cycles 90–120 days prior to expiration to prevent unintended auto-renewals or contract lapses.

• Analyze utilization data alongside IT Asset Management to identify unused seats, over-provisioned tiers, and shelfware before setting negotiation targets.

• Negotiate in-scope software and IT renewals using established playbooks, benchmarks, and pre-approved fallback positions to limit uplifts and secure favorable terms.

• Coordinate cross-functional reviews across Legal, Security, IT, Compliance, and FP&A to confirm data privacy, security, and budget approvals prior to execution.

• Administer procurement software systems (specifically ZIP) and maintain accurate contract records, renewal dates, spend data, and savings metrics in the system of record.

About You

• You have at least 5 years of progressive procurement experience, ideally within a fast-growing technology or software environment.

• You've managed end-to-end renewal pipelines and have experience establishing or refining procurement functions across multi-location organizations.

• You bring strong data analysis skills and a track record of using usage metrics to build reduction cases and right-size software agreements.

• You communicate effectively across all organizational levels, building collaborative cross-functional relationships with Legal, Security, IT, and Finance teams.

• You're process-oriented with high attention to detail, managing contract hygiene and critical notice windows across a high-volume portfolio.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• Experience working with e-procurement and SaaS management tools such as ZIP or Ironclad.

• Exposure to structured negotiation methodologies or formal negotiation training.

• Familiarity with SOC 2 compliance, data privacy review processes, or vendor security assessments.

• Experience supporting vendor consolidation or cost reduction initiatives.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Finance

The Finance team helps steward a strong business through its next stage of sustainable growth. Across accounting, planning, forecasting, reporting, procurement, controls, and financial systems, the team turns complex information into clear insights, dependable processes, and disciplined decisions. This work gives Everlaw the structure and confidence to invest thoughtfully, manage its resources responsibly, and scale without compromising what makes the company special.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $135,000–$170,000. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.

Health & well-being

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

• #LI-KP1

• #LI-Hybrid

​​About Everlaw

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR), Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Figure, you will create the first conversation with our largest prospective partners. You will work a named account list rather than a shared lead queue, so you get to know a defined set of companies well and build a point of view on why Figure matters to each one. You will research those accounts, map the people who own the problem we solve, run outbound across email, phone, and LinkedIn, and hand off meetings with enough context that the Account Executive (AE) can run a real discovery call.

This is a role for someone who has already prospected into large, complex organizations, is willing to do the research that makes cold outreach land, and is building toward a closing seat.

What You’ll Do

• Own outbound into a named list of enterprise accounts. Run multi-channel sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Carry a monthly target for qualified meetings and keep activity, notes, and next steps accurate in the CRM.

• Build a point of view on every account before you reach out. Identify who owns the problem Figure solves, map more than one path into the organization, and write outreach that references something specific rather than something generic.

• Qualify inbound and outbound interest against fit, timing, and who else needs to be in the room. Hand the AE the context behind the meeting, not just the calendar invite.

• Build account plans with the Account Executives you support. Agree on which accounts matter this quarter, who you are trying to reach inside each account, and what the entry point is. Bring what you hear in the field back so messaging and target lists get sharper.

• Partner with Marketing on campaigns, target lists, and conferences. Build the list ahead of an event and follow up on every conversation the team has onsite.

• Keep the CRM accurate. Flag stale contacts, wrong titles, and duplicate accounts so the team is not working off records that no longer hold.

What We Look For

• 2+ years in a sales development, business development, or comparable outbound role

• At least one year prospecting into enterprise accounts where more than one person has to say yes

• A record of hitting or exceeding a meetings or pipeline target

• Comfort cold calling and cold emailing people who did not ask to hear from you

• Writing that is short, specific, and clear. You can explain what a company does and why it should care in a few lines

• Research ability. You can read a company’s site, filings, and public commentary and find the reason to reach out

• Discipline on activity and follow-through. You work a plan and keep the pipeline accurate

• Working command of CRM and sales engagement tools

• Resilience. Most outreach gets no response, and you keep going anyway

• Willingness to travel occasionally for conferences and team meetings

• Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.

• Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.

• Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience selling into financial institutions or another heavily regulated buyer

• Background in lending, home equity, mortgage, or payments

• Experience as an early SDR in a new segment or channel, where you helped build the motion

• Experience building account plans alongside enterprise Account Executives

Salary

• Base Compensation Range: $60,326 - $77,688/yr

• On-target earnings: $87,472 - $112,647

• Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

• Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits

• Employer-paid life and disability insurance

jobs.title: Engineering Leadership, NY Site Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


THE ROLE

Our agentic AI-powered products are bringing joy back to the practice of medicine, and we're building out our engineering presence in New York. We're looking for an engineering leader to be the senior technical presence in our SoHo office — someone who will own business-critical product areas end-to-end while setting the bar, the culture, and the pace for the engineers we hire around them.

This is a builder's role first and a site leader's role second. You'll scope and ship product in an area that is still being defined, grow a team from a small core, and represent Abridge engineering in New York.

This role is based in New York and requires working from our SoHo office five days / week. We believe the fastest way to build this team is in person, and we're looking for someone who wants to set that example.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build our New York engineering presence: Be the senior engineering voice in our NY office. Establish the operating rhythm, quality bar, and culture of the office. Make New York a place strong engineers want to do their best work.

 - AI-native leadership: Bring a real point of view on how agentic engineering changes the way software gets built — in the product you ship and in how your team works.

 - Drive pace and performance: Raise the execution velocity of the org around you. Set business context for your team, partner closely with product and design, and be a multiplier for the leaders and engineers you work alongside.

 - Own an area and ship it: Take a product area from ambiguity to shipped, enterprise-grade software. You'll set technical direction, make the architecture calls, and be accountable for the output of your team. We don't expect you to code daily, but we expect you to be close enough to the tech to unblock, and to still enjoy being hands-on.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - At least 5+ years managing software engineering teams — including time as a manager of managers or as the most senior engineering leader in a location.

 - Track record of building something from zero to real scale, and of owning the product outcome rather than just the engineering process.

 - Hands-on technically. You can read and review the code your team is shipping, get into a codebase when something needs unblocking, and hold your own in a technical design discussion.

 - A clear, well-formed point of view on AI and agentic engineering, and evidence you've acted on it.

 - Skilled at hiring and mentorship, with a track record of helping engineers grow their skills and careers — and of hiring quickly while keeping the bar high.

 - Has thrived in a fast-growing startup and knows how to operate in that environment. Excited to be hands-on in a fast-moving, productive, and supportive environment, and willing to pitch in wherever needed.

 - Based in New York and excited to be in the SoHo office five days a week.

 - Genuine passion for Abridge's mission to improve healthcare in America and across the world.


BONUS POINTS IF…

 - Experience as a site lead, or as the founding senior engineering leader for a new office or region.

 - Experience managing or working directly with AI/ML engineering teams and shipping AI- or ML-powered product features.

 - Experience working in a health tech environment, or in another highly regulated, enterprise-sold domain.

 - Founder or early-employee experience.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Lead Android Engineer to build Rogo’s Android app from the ground up.

Rogo is not available on Android app yet. You will start with a blank canvas and own the foundational decisions that shape the product for years to come: architecture, technology choices, design patterns, development standards, release processes, observability, and quality. You won’t be maintaining someone else’s decisions or modernizing a legacy codebase. You’ll define what excellent Android engineering looks like at Rogo.

You’ll work directly with product, design, engineering, and customers to translate Rogo’s AI platform into an exceptional native mobile experience. You’ll decide how sophisticated, AI-powered financial workflows should work on Android and then build them.

This is a rare opportunity to create a category-defining application from its first line of code, ship it to demanding professional users, and build the foundation for an Android engineering team around your work.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Build and launch the first version of Rogo’s native Android application

 - Define the application’s architecture, technical stack, and core engineering patterns

 - Establish the standards for testing, security, performance, observability, releases, and code quality

 - Partner closely with product and design to define how AI-native workflows should work on mobile

 - Own major features end-to-end, from early user research and technical design through launch and iteration

 - Create smooth, stable, and responsive experiences across the Android device ecosystem

 - Integrate Rogo’s AI platform and backend services into an intuitive native experience

 - Develop reusable foundations that allow the application and future Android team to scale

 - Work directly with customers and Customer Success to understand professional workflows and rapidly incorporate feedback

 - Help hire, mentor, and set the technical bar for future Android engineers


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 5+ years of professional Android development experience

 - A track record of building and launching high-quality Android applications

 - Strong command of Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and the Android SDK

 - Experience making foundational architecture and technology decisions

 - Deep understanding of Android application architecture, lifecycle management, and platform conventions

 - Experience with Kotlin coroutines, Flow, concurrency, threading, and performance optimization

 - Strong product judgment and an instinct for polished, intuitive user experiences

 - Experience designing reusable, testable components and maintainable application architecture

 - High standards for reliability, security, privacy, and production readiness

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity and turning an open-ended opportunity into a shipped product

 - Passion for building delightful AI-powered experiences


BONUS

 - You have built an Android app or major mobile product from zero to one

 - You have been an early mobile engineer at a fast-growing startup

 - Experience with Java, RxJava, Dagger or Hilt, and established Android architecture patterns

 - Experience integrating with backend services through REST APIs, gRPC, WebSockets, or Server-Sent Events

 - Experience with offline functionality, local persistence, background processing, and push notifications

 - Experience deploying Android applications in an enterprise context, including managed Google Play, Microsoft Intune, or mobile-device-management environments

 - Experience building secure applications that handle sensitive enterprise data

 - Background at a design-forward product company such as Notion or Figma

 - Strong interest in AI and how it can reshape professional mobile workflows


WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. 

 - You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. 

 - You are curious.  You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

 - You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.


WHY JOIN ROGO?

 - Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

 - Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

 - A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

 - Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

 - Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Habilitation
jobs.description:
Associate Director, Habilitation

Launch a new office. Build a lasting legacy.

BAYADA is seeking an experienced, mission-driven Associate Director to help launch and grow a brand-new Habilitation office serving the Sikeston Region of Missouri. This is an opportunity to shape the culture, operations, community presence, and future success of a new office from the ground up while helping individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities live with greater independence and dignity.

The Associate Director will initially work from the BAYADA Lebanon office while the new Rolla office is prepared. After approximately one year, the successful candidate must be willing to work from the Rolla office once it is ready to be occupied.

This is an onsite leadership role for a collaborative, resilient, and growth-minded professional who is energized by building relationships, developing teams, and creating dependable systems that support excellent client service.

Role details

• Practice: Habilitation

• Territory: Sikeston Region

• Office status: Brand-new office and expansion in Missouri

• Work model: 100% in office

What you will do

As Associate Director, you will help establish the foundation for a successful new Habilitation office while developing the skills and experience needed to lead office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Help launch the new Habilitation office and establish BAYADA as a trusted provider and employer in the Sikeston Region.

• Build relationships with clients, families, referral partners, community organizations, and prospective employees.

• Support local marketing, outreach, and business development efforts to grow awareness of Habilitation services.

• Learn and perform Client Services Manager responsibilities during the office launch and until the office is fully staffed.

• Support client and employee census growth, service coordination, staffing, and day-to-day office workflow.

• Manage the office using established workbooks, billed-hour expectations, key performance indicators, goals, and other operating metrics.

• Help create and maintain organized, reliable processes that support quality service, compliance, responsiveness, and a positive client and employee experience.

• Partner with the Division Director and other BAYADA leaders to identify priorities, address challenges, and move the office forward.

• Assist with hiring and onboarding the future Clinical Manager, Habilitation Manager, and Client Services Manager.

• Contribute to a culture grounded in compassion, reliability, and excellence.

• Remain on call initially while the office is being established and staffing is built.

Your first year

The first year will be focused on learning, building, and preparing for long-term growth. You will receive training in Client Services Manager responsibilities and will perform those duties while the office is being staffed. You will also help develop the local presence of HSK through outreach, relationship building, recruiting, and operational readiness.

This role requires comfort with evolving priorities. The Associate Director’s schedule will generally align with office hours, but the workday may vary based on client needs, team needs, community outreach, hiring activity, and the demands of launching a new office.

What we are looking for

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Experience in leadership, operations, or managing day-to-day business activity.

• Meaningful experience working with or supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

• Willingness to work onsite 100% of the time.

• Ability to work from the Lebanon office initially and transition to the Rolla office when it is ready to be occupied.

• Availability to participate in initial on-call responsibilities.

• Ability to travel for training and company events, including travel to Pennsylvania and throughout Missouri.

• Strong organizational, communication, judgment, and relationship-building skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience launching, growing, or stabilizing a new office, program, service line, or community-based operation.

• Experience hiring, developing, or coaching employees.

• Experience with Habilitation or other services supporting people with I/DD.

• Experience with census management, scheduling, staffing, budgets, billed hours, or operational metrics.

• Familiarity with community outreach, referral development, recruiting, or local marketing.

The qualities that will help you thrive

You will be well suited for this role if you are:

• Mission-driven and genuinely motivated by supporting individuals with I/DD and their families.

• Comfortable creating structure where processes are still being developed.

• A confident communicator who builds trust with clients, families, employees, and community partners.

• Accountable, organized, and able to follow through on commitments.

• Adaptable when priorities change and willing to step into hands-on responsibilities.

• A thoughtful problem solver who balances urgency with sound judgment.

• A team builder who recognizes that a strong office is built through collaboration, coaching, and consistent care.

• Energized by growth and motivated to leave a positive, lasting legacy in the community.

Why this opportunity matters

This is more than an opportunity to join an established team—it is an opportunity to help create one. By helping launch HSK, you will influence how the office serves clients, supports families, develops employees, and becomes part of the Sikeston Region community.

At BAYADA, our commitment to care is reflected in the way we show up for the people and communities we serve. In this role, your leadership will help create a strong foundation for future excellence and ensure that clients and families can count on compassionate, reliable, high-quality support.

Apply now

If you are an experienced leader who is ready to help build a new Habilitation office from the ground up, we invite you to apply. Join BAYADA in creating meaningful opportunities for clients, families, and employees throughout the Sikeston Region.

As an accredited, regulated, certified, and licensed home health care provider, BAYADA complies with all state/local mandates.

BAYADA is celebrating 50 years of compassion, excellence, and reliability. Learn more about our 50th anniversary celebration and how you can join in here.

BAYADA Home Health Care, Inc., and its associated entities and joint venture partners, are Equal Opportunity Employers. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.  Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Director, Stakeholder Engagement Strategy & Operations, Ad Boards
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

As part of our expanding Medical Affairs organization, we seek a dynamic and experienced Director, Stakeholder Engagement Strategy & Operations to lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Global Medical Advisory Boards. This role may also have a more limited contribution to global congress planning, ensuring seamless integration of advisory boards with congress objectives and broader Medical Affairs priorities.  This individual will report to the Head of Scientific Stakeholder Engagement within Global Medical Excellence and will partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research, maintaining leadership for global advisory boards and ensuring seamless integration with broader Medical Affairs priorities. Key responsibilities include:

Advisory Board Strategy & Operations

• Lead Medical Affairs advisory board strategy, planning, and execution for specific global and U.S. regional advisory boards, ensuring alignment with medical strategy, stakeholder engagement priorities, and key congress activities.

• Collaborate across Medical Affairs to develop and align global and regional advisory board tactical plans with broader Medical Affairs priorities.

• Ensure compliant planning, execution, and documentation of global and regional advisory boards.

• Develop and execute on processes for compliant cross-functional sharing of advisory board insights.

• Partner with internal teams (Medical Affairs, Clinical, Commercial) to design impactful advisory board agendas and content to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research to ensure consistent communication and scientific engagement while maintaining appropriate governance and firewalls.

• Act as the central coordination point for cross-functional teams to align on advisory board priorities, deliverables, and messaging.

Operational Leadership & Governance

• Lead operational execution of global and regional advisory boards, including agency/vendor oversight, contracting and logistics, budget management, and coordination of internal and external stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with global and regional regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, PMDA, EFPIA, IFPMA).

• Establish best practices, SOPs, and governance processes for advisory board execution.

• Establish scalable, compliant processes to capture, synthesize, and disseminate actionable advisory board insights across appropriate cross-functional stakeholders, in partnership with Medical Affairs Insights & Analytics.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD or equivalent in life sciences preferred but not required).

• 10+ years’ experience in Medical Affairs within biotech/pharma, with a strong background in scientific engagement and advisory board strategy and execution.

• Proven track record in leading global and regional advisory boards across U.S., EU, and APAC regions.

• Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex advisory boards and stakeholder engagements simultaneously, from strategic planning through execution and post-meeting insights.

• Strong understanding of the oncology therapeutic landscape, particularly pancreatic cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and colorectal cancer.

• Deep knowledge of compliance standards governing global advisory boards, external scientific engagement, and scientific exchange.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional collaboration in a complex, matrixed environment.

• Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

• Experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational processes related to advisory boards and other scientific stakeholder engagements.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in early and late-phase development and product launch preparation in oncology.

• Prior leadership of global advisory boards strategy alignment.

• Experience working in fast-paced, innovative, clinical-stage biotech organizations.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead two squads building Omada’s Platform and Engineering Systems.  These squads own problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what they ship.  You are responsible for those squads: what they work on, in what order, and how your people and teams grow.

As a Engineering Manager, you ship code alongside your AI-powered engineers.  You own the execution and will run the squad’s rituals: iteration shaping, prioritization, backlog refinement, and initiative estimation are your calls.  Being in charge means you have an opinion about the tradeoffs you and the squad are making, and are comfortable partnering with the squad’s stakeholders and finding solutions to problems, should they arise.

You partner closely with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Design, IT, InfoSec, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and beyond. Your relationships with the people in those departments will be very important. You will manage millions of dollars in annual vendor budget and spending, through key contracts including Amazon Web Services, Datadog, Gitlab, and Anthropic. You will be responsible for annual internal and external audit controls, and must help your teams develop automation and evidence management processes to streamline audit responses.

About you:

You are comfortable being accountable for what your squad ships.  You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agentic workflows as your squad: you’ll feel the friction your people feel because you experience it first-hand.

You are an experienced engineering leader, and you are opinionated about the systems you maintain. You understand why the most important work must be done, and you own the roadmap that will get it done. You are respected technically, but do not need to be the strongest engineer in the squad: your work generally stays off the critical path, but you must possess the fundamental understanding to know what great looks like, and the communication skills to build strong relationships with your teams and colleagues.

You are opinionated about where AI-assisted development helps and where it produces work someone else has to redo, because you have first-hand experience from doing the work rather than from reading about it.

Above all, you are enthusiastic about providing the best possible care for our members, and building the best engineering team of your career.

What you'll be doing:

• Managing, Hiring, and Mentoring. You will lead 5 people. You will quickly find opportunities to expand your teams, and must have a strong perspective on how to hire amazing people. Meanwhile, you must ensure that the people who work on your teams today continue growing and challenging themselves.

• Own the squad's delivery. Sprint shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation are yours. Make the calls, write them down, and be accountable for them.

• Own cycle time at constant or better quality. Your squad's contribution to it is yours to move and yours to explain.

• Ship code. Production work every sprint, off the critical path, using the same agent workflows your squad uses. This is what keeps the standing to review their work and the credibility to defend the model.

• Grow your engineers. Omadans care about each other: we believe everyone can grow, and you will provide your reports with the best leadership they have ever experienced.

• Own the operational health of your squad. On-call rotations, MTTR and post-incident analysis are shared work you lead.

• Escalate early, often, and precisely. You bring tradeoffs, you use your engineering and product taste to come up with recommendations.

• You will hire the new generation of AI-augmented Omadans. We believe in co-intelligence: we will continue hiring amazing humans, and help them build a career with us.

What you need for this role:

• 8+ years in software engineering, including at least 2 years managing engineers, or equivalent experience leading delivery for a team you were accountable for.

• A track record shipping mission-critical software to production, and living with it afterwards: we all make mistakes, what separates you from others is that you own these, and use this as an opportunity to build something even greater.

• The ability to build a roadmap, plan for capacity, evaluate trade-offs, and know how to negotiate with your stakeholders.

• Experience owning prioritization and estimation for a team, including saying no, not now, and explaining why.

• Experience giving direct developmental feedback, and at least one case where you managed someone through underperformance with real support attached.

• Currently shipping, or recently shipping production code in at least one layer of our stack (Multi-account AWS, self-managed continuous integration, k8s, backend (Ruby, Python, ...), GitOps release management, internal tools and services) with enough range to follow the conversation in the others and review architecture decisions critically.

• Hands-on experience directing AI agents through real world production changes, and a considered view on where they help and where they produce work someone else has to redo.

• Understanding of CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and telemetry, at the level where you can tell whether your squad's operational story checks out or falls short.

• A Security-mentality in everything you design and build

• Excellent written communication. Much of this job is writing things down clearly once so they do not have to be discussed four times.

Technologies we use:

Architecture & Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, IAM, RDS, SQS, etc), Docker, GitLab, Argo/Kargo, Vault, Datadog, PagerDuty.

Application Engineering: Ruby on Rails, Python (Flask, FastAPI), React, native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Claude

Benefits:

• Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

• Equity grants

• Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)

• Remote first work from home culture

• Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

• Generous parental leave

• Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)

• 401k retirement savings plan

• Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

• Mental Health Support Solutions

• ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

• Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.

• Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.

• Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.

• Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.

• Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.

• Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.
