Instacart+ is Instacart's membership program, the connective tissue between the brand and its most loyal, high-value customers. With benefits like $0 delivery fees, partner perks, and exclusive savings, Instacart+ is the foundation of our long-term customer relationship strategy. Members shop more, spend more, and stay longer, and this role is responsible for making sure more customers become Instacart+ members and realize the benefits of doing so.

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Instacart+. You'll shape how we position, message, and grow the membership program from acquisition campaigns that convert first-timers to lifecycle strategies that deepen engagement with existing members. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of product, brand, and growth.

The ideal candidate has deep roots in subscription or loyalty marketing, having grown a membership program, driven retention through value communication, and knows how to make the math of membership feel like a no-brainer to a consumer. • Members have a reason to stay: you've identified the moments where member value is highest and built messaging and lifecycle programs that bring those moments to life across email, push, in-app, and paid.

• Acquisition is measurably stronger: you've partnered with growth and performance marketing teams to develop and test messaging frameworks that convert trial users and lapsed members into committed subscribers.

• The product roadmap reflects member insights: you've become the internal voice of the Instacart+ member, bringing qualitative and quantitative research into roadmap conversations that shape what gets built next.

• New Instacart+ features launch with best-in-class GTM plans: you own the brief, the messaging, and the channel strategy from kickoff through post-launch performance review.

• Senior stakeholders and XFN partners trust you as the category expert: you've developed a compelling POV on the subscription and loyalty landscape and use it to sharpen the Instacart+ strategy.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples

• Deep fluency in subscription/loyalty marketing mechanics: you understand member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and churn, and know how to use marketing to move each lever.

• A sharp strategic mind that can synthesize consumer research, behavioral data, and competitive signals into positioning and messaging that cuts through

• Proven ability to influence product roadmaps. You've brought the voice of the customer into planning cycles and shaped what gets built, not just how it gets marketed.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting and defending strategy to VP and C-suite stakeholders.

• Experience partnering closely with growth, lifecycle/CRM, creative, and data science teams to develop and execute multi-channel campaigns

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Optional garnishes

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We're challenging the status quo, updating the current system, and empowering our partners to build better solutions. Together, we're building the most advanced financial infrastructure, open, instant, and global, inspiring a future where anyone, anywhere can access the full potential of digital money.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy building and shipping quickly, learning how other teams work, and seeing their work change how an entire company operates. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data & AI team, you'll expand Lighthouse, our internal data and AI platform, into the layer that lets every function at Lightspark run on trusted data and AI agents.

Most of the value in applied AI comes from the connective work: wiring models to a company's data, its tools, and the way people actually work, then getting the result adopted. We've built that layer for analytics, where Lighthouse now handles most of what our team used to do by hand and is used across the company. This role extends it to Sales, Finance, Ops, Legal, Compliance, and Partnerships: the agent harness, tool integrations, governed source-of-truth data, and the execution layer those teams run their workflows on. General-purpose assistants get partway there and miss things; you'll build the structure underneath so the answers are right, repeatable, and owned by the teams that need them.

You'll work on a small, senior team with a lot of ownership. Problems come from talking with the teams you support rather than from a spec; you'll scope them, ship the solution, and make sure it sticks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Building and owning our internal AI platform: the agent harness, MCP servers and tool integrations, context and access services, sandboxed execution, and cost and usage tracking

 - Embedding with Finance, Sales Ops, Compliance, and onboarding to understand how their work actually happens, then shipping the systems that replace the manual version and handing them off to those teams

 - Extending our data infrastructure alongside our Staff Data Engineer: DBT models, BigQuery, orchestration, and the production pipelines

 - Sharing ownership of monitoring, alerting, and data reliability for the systems that unblock product launches

 - Partnering with Engineering to optimize their own dev systems and tooling



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 4+ years experience shipping and maintaining production systems; data engineering, ML engineering, and backend/full-stack backgrounds all fit

 - You've built an internal platform or workflow system that other teams adopted, not just features on top of one

 - You've built with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and MCP in production, beyond prompting, and you know what belongs in code versus a model

 - Strong fundamentals in TypeScript/Node or Python and the willingness to work in both, plus fluency with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks

 - You can sit with a non-technical team, understand how their work actually happens, and come back with a system

 - Comfortable working with ambiguity in a startup environment

 - Experience in payments, crypto, or blockchain is a plus, but not required

 - Based in LA or Openness to relocate to Los Angeles, California

This is not an ML infrastructure, model-training, or prompt-engineering role. You might currently be an AI engineer, ML engineer, data engineer, or full-stack engineer who has spent the last year or two building agents and internal tooling. If you don't match every line above but have built systems like these, we'd like to hear from you.

Lightspark is on a mission to build the future of open, instant, and global financial infrastructure making payments accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. We're committed to creating a more inclusive and diverse workplace to reflect the customers we serve. We welcome interest from individuals of all backgrounds and levels of experience who share our mission. jobs.title: Senior Director Marketing/VP Marketing
jobs.description:
This is a senior role within the World Surf League (WSL) (VP/Senior Director title, as commensurate with experience and qualifications), responsible for building and executing the marketing strategy that grows WSL's audience, deepens fan engagement and positions the WSL as the home of surfing in the USA and beyond.

Successful candidate will own fan growth, digital marketing, paid media, CRM, brand tracking, and campaign execution with the range to stretch into creative and PR when the business requires it. Successful candidate will lead a team of direct reports and serve as a key partner to regional marketing leads, social media, commercial, content and events functions.

The role reports directly into the Global CMO and President of North America. Based on business and team priorities, the successful candidate should be based in Los Angeles, California, in a hybrid working environment (in office Tuesday-Thursday).

Responsibilities include:

Fan Acquisition & Audience Growth

• Lead the Global and North America fan acquisition strategy with center-out model, fan segmentation and audience growth.

• Drive viewership growth across YouTube, owned and operated platforms and broadcast, owning watch hour and unique viewer targets against OKRs.

• Build and execute athlete-led marketing campaigns that grow the profiles of US and Hawaiian surfers ahead of LA28.

• Partner with the social media and content team on creator program briefing and partnerships, driving paid amplification and performance measurement.

• Drive broadcast viewership growth, owning strategies that move audiences from social and digital onto live broadcast and O&O platforms, building habitual viewing behavior.

Athlete Marketing & Storytelling

• Own the athlete marketing strategy developing year-round profiles, narratives and content plans.

• Work with athlete management, content and social teams to build always-on athlete presence between events, ensuring surfers are known by name, story and personality, not just competition results.

• Use athlete channels as a primary distribution engine - co-creating content, briefing amplification strategies and measuring athlete-driven audience growth against OKRs.

• Build athlete marketing plans that ladder directly into LA28 positioning US and Hawaiian surfers as the faces of professional surfing before the Games arrive.

Digital Strategy, Martech & Membership

• Own the digital marketing strategy including paid media, SEO/GEO, app and web growth, performance analytics and channel mix.

• Lead Martech and CDP strategy and execution, including fan data strategy, segmentation, personalization and lifecycle marketing.

• Drive WSL membership and loyalty via acquisition funnels, retention campaigns and monetization of the owned audience base.

• Build and optimise CRM and email marketing developing fan journeys, automated lifecycle communications and engagement reporting.

Campaign Planning, Event Marketing & Market Awareness

• Lead integrated campaign strategy for all Championship Tour events and NA majors of US Open of Surfing, Trestles Pro, Pipe Masters, El Salvador Pro and Big Wave - owning always-on, in-season and tentpole execution.

• Partner with Tours & Events together with Revenue and Partnerships on onsite fan experience, local area marketing and partner activation delivery.

• Maintain active awareness of the competitive landscape, monitoring industry developments, emerging platforms and market threats.

• Bring market intelligence into campaign planning, ensuring strategy reflects the latest shifts in fan behavior, media consumption and cultural trends

Partner & Promotional Alliances

• Work closely with the Partnerships team to develop promotional alliances with WSL sponsors and partners - activating their off-channel assets (social audiences, email databases, OOH, retail and owned media) to extend WSL's marketing reach and drive event awareness

• Brief and manage partners on co-branded campaign execution, ensuring partner activations are aligned to WSL brand standards and NA marketing objectives.

• Identify and develop new promotional alliance opportunities that expand WSL's reach into non-endemic audiences and drive measurable fan acquisition.

Team Leadership, Cross-Functional Collaboration & Creative Range

• Lead, develop and inspire the North America marketing team.

• Partner closely with Social, Communications, Content, Partnerships, Tours & Events teams to align NA plans with the broader WSL strategy and OKRs, ensuring earned media, campaign creative and storytelling are aligned and mutually reinforcing.

• Be a supportive stakeholder in event creative management, key art, onsite marketing collateral and campaign assets across all NA events, ensuring delivery is on-brand and aligned to HQ brand guidelines.

P&L, Revenue Growth & Commercial Accountability

• Own and actively contribute to the Global and North America marketing budget with full responsibility for planning, monthly tracking and performance reporting against OKRs.

• Connect marketing investment directly to revenue growth, demonstrating measurable contribution to sponsorship value, partner ROI, ticket and merchandise revenue, membership growth and fan acquisition.

• Execute brand health and campaign measurement frameworks, including brand tracking studies and fan growth surveys, that track awareness, NPS, watch hours, earned media and audience growth, translating those metrics into commercial impact for the business.

Qualifications:

• Minimum 8 – 10 years of experience in marketing, with at least three years in a senior leadership role owning a marketing function and team.

• Proven track record in fan, audience or customer acquisition - sport, entertainment, media or lifestyle brand experience strongly preferred.

• Strong digital marketing background - paid media, CRM, email marketing, SEO/GEO, app growth, web analytics and performance optimization.

• Hands-on experience with Martech and CDP platforms including vendor evaluation, implementation and day-to-day operational use.

• Experience leading and developing a team, managing external agencies and working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, live-event environment.

• Demonstrated experience in creator and influencer marketing - strategy, briefing, contract management and measurement

• Experience developing and activating partner and promotional alliances, leveraging off-channel partner assets to extend marketing reach

• Strong understanding of communications and PR - not a specialist, but able to partner with and stretch across the communications function when needed

• Understanding of brand and creative - able to brief, review and direct creative work at a senior level

• Commercially minded - able to connect marketing activity to P&L outcomes, revenue growth and business value

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field

• Must be fluent in English; additional language skills preferred

• Experience with Google Suite, project management and campaign reporting tools

• A flexible schedule is preferred - live events, evenings and weekends may be required

• Experience in live sports, action sports or surf is highly desirable, as is a genuine passion for surfing and surf culture

Personal Attributes:

• Above all, integrity and honesty.

• An exceptional work ethic and attention to detail.

• Optimism and energy for surfing and its future.

• An open and collaborative nature.

• Incredibly organized and capable of juggling multiple projects simultaneously.

• A high degree of self-awareness of one's own personal style, strengths and weaknesses, and sources of motivation.

• Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for learning.

• Enjoys working in a fast-paced, corporate environment.

• Action-oriented - enjoys working hard and looks for challenges; able to act and react as necessary, even if limited information is available; willing to take unpopular stands when necessary.

• Culturally connected - understands youth culture, action sports, coastal lifestyle and the world that surfing lives in.

• LA28 mindset - sees the Olympic window as a once-in-a-generation audience growth opportunity and builds toward it with urgency.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: equal opportunity employer M/F/D/V.

jobs.description:
About Sleeper

Sleeper is a sports-focused games platform with messaging at its core. We are a young and energetic company, fueled by a passion for sports and a drive for innovation. Our mission is to create a digital playground for sports fans and their friends to hang out. We bring people together over sports. Currently, we are looking for highly motivated customer support associates to join our Customer Success team.

Join our team

The customer support role at Sleeper is the heartbeat of the company. You will play a key role in supporting and nurturing our user relationships, by collecting the voice of the customer and funneling feedback to appropriate channels.

You will join a small, but passionate team that acts as the front-line to our users, and help with user onboarding, resolve bug and usability issues, and collect and prioritize product and feature requests.

Successful candidates for this job are skilled problem-solvers who are adept at asking questions to help distill the causes and intent of our users. In addition, a high degree of empathy and customer-centric personality is required for the role.


What you’ll do as a Customer Success Associate:

 - Provide exceptional customer service through demonstrating product knowledge

 - Effectively communicate with our users across several channels – email, chat, and social media

 - Promote Sleeper through your conflict resolution abilities and effective communication skills

 - Comfortable questioning conventional wisdom, eager to take initiative, able to identify and develop creative solutions



What you’ll bring to the table:

 - Competence with Intercom is preferred but not required

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate and collaborate across multiple departments and our users

 - Ability to work weeknights and weekends due to varying shifts, which includes 5 days of work with 2 days off is required

 - Sleeper fandom!

Benefits

 - Competitive salary

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k)

 - Flexible working hours and remote work options

What we offer

Sleeper believes in quality over quantity, and intentionally keeps our team small as a result. In past roles, we found it very hard to make a big impact when companies grow too large in size, which has a detrimental effect on the product and the impact any single individual can have. Our team includes designers, engineers, product experts, and finance & operation focused on one thing — connecting people over sports. We believe in fair and equitable pay. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to jobs@sleeper.app.

Headquartered in Las Vegas, NV, Sleeper is backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Expa.

jobs.title: Manager, Containment
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions.

If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

As Manager, Containment you will lead the technical design of containment across existing and fully temporary venues, defining the types and formats that keep cables and infrastructure safe, organized, and Games-ready. You will work alongside Broadcast, Energy, Technology, and Venue Development, adapting IOC requirements to local practice across assigned cluster(s) of venues.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead containment technical design and development, defining suitable types and formats for existing and fully temporary venues.

• Develop technical engineering design guides and principles, adapting IOC and other stakeholder requirements to local practices.

• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to develop cost-effective, streamlined containment solutions for Games-time.

• Oversee external resources and manage the review process to meet departmental milestones.

• Collaborate across Broadcast, Energy, Technology, and Venue Development to support requirements and align cable routes.

Required Competencies

• A minimum of 5 years' experience with large infrastructure integration, including specific experience in containment.

• Experience with Event Technology, Data Center, or related infrastructure design and installation, with preference for temporary infrastructure and overlay.

• Advanced knowledge of engineering and collaboration tools and software, including Revit and AutoCAD.

• Experience with key industry codes and practices, and knowledge of containment activities including site preparation, installation, operation, maintenance, removal, and remediation.

• Command of project management fundamentals — scope, schedule, and budget — and a bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Valued Experience

• Preferred experience with local or major sporting events, such as the Olympic and Paralympic Games or the World Cup.

• Command of collaboration tools such as Office 365, SharePoint, Smartsheet, and Autodesk Cloud, with an accredited bachelor's degree in Engineering or Architecture.

What We Offer

• Real ownership of containment design and delivery across the venues hosting the Games.

• Cross-functional exposure across Broadcast, Energy, Technology, and Venue Development.

• The chance to set technical standards from the ground up, on an inclusive, co-creative team.

What This Role Means for the Games

Containment is the quiet backbone that keeps venue infrastructure safe and organized — your work helps deliver a brilliant, accessible Olympic and Paralympic Games, and standards that outlast the event.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office, with site visits to venues as needed.

• Site visits require movement around varying environmental conditions in external locations.

• The LA28 office is an open floorplan environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle setting.

• Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

• Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve and may include operational responsibilities during the Games.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $88,000.00-$115,000.00. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

Accommodation

LA28 is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Equal Opportunity

LA28 is committed to fair and unbiased recruitment procedures allowing all applicants an equal opportunity for employment, free from discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, color, ethnic or national origin, or any other classification as may be protected by applicable law. LA28 will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and all applicable laws. We strive to build a team that is inclusive and encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities to apply. We assess applications based on relevant skills, education, and experience a candidate can add to our team.

jobs.title: Fleet Operations Training Lead - US & Japan
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead for the US and Japan, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

Key responsibilities:

• Training strategy: Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the US and Japan, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion.

• Learning programme development: Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams.

• Training needs analysis: Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements.

• Training delivery: Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge.

• Learning standards and localisation: Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments.

• Competency and certification: Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively.

• Training effectiveness: Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance.

• Continuous improvement: Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes.

• Train-the-trainer: Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively.

• Learning systems and records: Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities.

• Operational change: Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities.

• Learning culture: Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations.

About you

In order to set you up for success as a Fleet Operations Training Lead at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

• A strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation.

• Demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment.

• Experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible.

• Experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts.

• Excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with a proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.

• The ability to work effectively across US and Japan time zones and travel between operational locations when required.

• Availability to work on-site five days a week.

• A clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements.

• A safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks.

Desirable

• Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions.

• Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts.

• Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches.

• Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers.

• Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware.

• Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions.

• Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry.

• Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan.

• Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $100,000 to $130,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition  (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

jobs.title: Commercial Launch & Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill’s residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry’s first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

The Role

Are you someone who thrives in an environment where physical hardware meets high-stakes operational challenges? Have you executed complex new product introductions (NPI) or scaled infrastructure solutions across commercial business footprints?  Have you coordinated activities across multiple customers simultaneously?

As the Commercial Launch & Deployment Manager, you will serve as the tactical execution lead for Mill’s commercial launch and expansion. You will work closely with our Head of Deployments and the Operations team to transition our business from initial commercial pilots to full-scale enterprise operations. This is a fast-paced operational orchestration role designed for an exceptional, detail-oriented leader.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Readiness & Launch Program Management

• Help to develop, iterate and support the "Mill Commercial Site Readiness Checklist" and launch playbooks across heterogeneous commercial kitchen, grocery and other food service configurations

• Build and maintain the integrated master launch schedule for all customers bridging Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Field Operations, and Partner Success teams.

• Lead daily/weekly cross-functional syncs to mitigate risks and work through bottlenecks, tracking critical paths to ensure hitting committed deployment schedules.

2. Vendor Management & Third-Party Orchestration

• Manage third-party vendors needed for successful deployments.

• Act as the escalation lead for field issues during active deployments, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are rigorously maintained through installation phases.

• Audit vendor performance, ensuring work conforms to Mill's standards, technical specs, and partner-specific security or access requirements.

3. Partner Success & Sustaining Operations Hand-off

• Partner deeply with the commercial account team to translate complex technical workflows into simplified, high-adoption standard operating procedures (SOPs) for grocery kitchen staff.

• Co-develop and deploy training curricula, localized quick-reference documentation, and train-the-trainer frameworks optimized for high-turnover service environments.

Who You Are

• Hardware Deployment Experience: You have a proven track record of shipping or deploying physical hardware products. Backgrounds in enterprise IoT, commercial charging/energy infrastructure, commercial appliances, or industrial supply chain hardware deployments are highly valued.

• An Operations Mindset: You possess a tactical, "measure twice, cut once" philosophy. You are comfortable interfacing with a lot of people daily and dealing with logistics, general contractors, loading docks, and facilities managers.

• Cross-Functional Liaison: You know how to translate technical constraints to corporate leaders and floor managers alike with clarity, empathy, and absolute professionalism.

• AI-enabled Approach: You err on the side of diving into optimizing workflows through applying AI to help scale at increasing speed and efficiency.

Qualifications & Requirements

• 4+ years of program management, field operations, or hardware launch experience, with at least 2 years specifically dedicated to B2B, commercial infrastructure, or enterprise hardware environments.

• Technical literacy; comfortable diving into hardware specifications, electrical/space constraints, facility architectural diagrams, and network connectivity profiles.

• Willingness to travel nationally up to 50% during peak site-deployment and validation cycles.

• Experience operating within health, safety, food-handling, or building compliance frameworks (OSHA, NSF, UL, etc.) is a distinct advantage.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $150k to $170k, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs. At Mill, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Where Growth Gets Strategic - and Your Career Does Too

Mid-Market Sales is where experience meets impact. You’ll partner with growing businesses (1–19 employees), navigating the complexity of expansion—helping them strengthen their people operations and scale with confidence.

This is a consultative, relationship-driven environment where you’re not just closing deals—you’re solving real business challenges. Every conversation builds insight, every deal sharpens your expertise, and every win positions you as a trusted advisor to business owners.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

• Drive new business by prospecting and winning new logos within your assigned territory
• Sell a robust suite of solutions, including Paychex Flex® and advanced HR services.
• Execute consistent outbound activity (calls, outreach, networking, partnerships, and follow-ups) to build a pipeline
• Lead consultative sales conversations with business owners and key decision-makers
• Manage a high velocity sales process with small and mid-size businesses (1-2 call closes)
• Own the full sales process—from discovery and solutioning to closing

What It Takes to Win

• 1+ years professional or sales experience (HCM experience preferred but not required)
• Ability to navigate consultative, solution-based sales conversations
• Strong prospecting mindset with comfort driving outbound, in-person field activity
• Resilience, accountability, and a results-driven approach
• Coachability with a desire to continuously improve and grow

Why This Role

• Unlimited earning potential with performance-based incentives
• More complex, higher-value deals that accelerate your sales expertise
• Opportunity to become a trusted advisor to growing businesses
• Clear path to advance your career in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment with clear pathways to the next step in your career

If you’re ready to elevate your sales career while helping businesses scale, this is where you grow next.

Qualifications

• H.S. Diploma - Required
• Bachelor's Degree - Preferred
• 2 years of experience in B2B Sales/Marketing.
• Cold Calling experience.
• Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Software experience - Preferred.
• Valid Driver's License - Required

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the compensation range for this position is typically $65,000- $110,000. This range includes BOTH base pay plus commissions but does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.

Live the Paychex Values

• Act with uncompromising integrity.
• Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
• Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
• Work in partnership and support each other.
• Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
• Treat each other with respect and dignity.

What's in it for you?

• We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
• We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
• We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.

jobs.title: QA/QC Laboratory Technician I
jobs.description:
At Amyris, we value that everyone’s career journey is unique and authentic to who they are. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply and grow alongside us! You may be just the right candidate for this or other open roles.

Are you passionate about quality, safety, and science? We’re looking for a QA/QC Laboratory Technician I to join our high-performing team in a 24/7 manufacturing facility.

In this role, you’ll conduct chemical and physical laboratory tests that ensure our products meet the highest quality standards. If you enjoy hands-on lab work, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are ready to grow your technical skills, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

• Perform in-process and final product testing on both solid and liquid materials.

• Set up and conduct chemical and physical analyses using laboratory instruments such as Gas Chromatograph (GC), Auto titrators, Karl Fischer titrators, Refractometer, Tintometer, and Viscometer.

• Record, analyze, and report laboratory data with accuracy and integrity.

• Support the Quality Control Manager and lab team with sample processing, data interpretation, and process troubleshooting.

• Perform inspections on packaging materials (jerricans, drums, and totes) and torque lids to specification using a manual torque wrench.

• Torque lids on jerricans, drums and totes to 75ft/pounds using a manual torque wrench.

• Maintain clean lab instruments, equipment, and a safe, organized work environment.

• Comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and ISO 22716 standards for cosmetics.

• Collaborate with chemists, production staff, and the engineering team to support production quality goals.

• Process and prepare raw material weigh-outs and sample shipments.

Basic Qualifications

• 1–2 years of experience in a laboratory technician or chemical technician role

OR

• Associate’s degree in chemistry or a related scientific field

• Knowledge of standard lab practices and chemical testing procedures

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data recording

• Willingness and availability to work a rotating 12-hour shift schedule (including nights, weekends, and holidays)

• Ability to follow safety protocols and maintain a clean lab environment

• Good communication skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a manufacturing or chemical plant environment

• Proficiency with laboratory equipment such as GC, titrators, viscometers, and refractometers

• Familiarity with ISO 22716 guidelines and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs)

• Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to solve lab-related technical issues

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to safely lift and handle up to 45 pounds

• Regularly required to use hands to handle materials or operate instruments

• Vision abilities include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

• Must be comfortable working on your feet for extended periods in a production/lab environment

jobs.title: Residential Counselor I/II - Sun, Mon, & Tues AON 8pm-8am - Monaco House
jobs.description:
WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support.

Our Guiding Principles:

• Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.

Position Summary:  Residential Counselors facilitate and work with consumers on a variety of activities of daily living (ADLs) needed for consumers to become more self-sufficient and move toward recovery. Additionally, you will facilitate group therapy, manage intakes/discharges, monitor medications, create a safe environment for the consumers, help coordinate treatment, and advocate for individuals with severe and persistent mental illness. Responsible for direct service care to consumers as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

Work Location: 1512 Monaco Pkwy

Shift/Hours: Sunday, Monday & Tuesday AON 8pm-8am

• RCI - 27.79/hr

• RCII - 30.12/hr

• Awake Overnight - $3/hr

Job Duties & Functions:

• Provide individual psychotherapy with consumers to provide support and insight.

• Facilitate group therapy sessions within the house.

• Coordinate clinical care with case management services and other services both inside and outside of MHCD.

• Assess consumers throughout the workday, and provide appropriate interventions.

• Encourage, support, and train consumers in activities of daily living (ADLs) - teaching consumers about hygiene, help make appointments, show how to do household duties/chores, such as cooking, cleaning, etc.

• As part of a multi-disciplinary system, help facilitate the treatment and continuity of clinical care.

• RC II: Bachelor's Degree in social work, psychology, human services, or related field.

EXPERIENCE:

Certifications:

• QMAP (Qualified Medication Administration Person)

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, (Fullstack/Frontend)
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. Our engineering teams play a critical role in achieving this by building the end to end product experience that helps patients understand and manage their health.



As a Senior Engineer, you will be a hands on technical leader responsible for building and optimizing the patient facing experiences and back end services that power our platform. You will design, build, and iterate across the full stack, from modern, performant front end interfaces to reliable back end services and integrations with external partners, ensuring every feature is accurate, dependable, and delivers measurable impact for patients.



In this role, you will collaborate closely with product, design, operations, data, and other engineering teams to launch new features and workflows, improve the user experience, and refine the patient journey. By combining strong technical execution with a product minded, data informed approach, you will help more patients get meaningful value from our platform while improving the overall quality, reliability, and performance of the systems you own.




YOU WILL:

 - Lead the design and architecture of scalable, performant full stack solutions that meet product requirements and enhance the patient experience.

 - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on best practices, design patterns, and coding standards.

 - Advocate for your team's technical priorities and ensure alignment within the broader engineering organization.

 - Participate in product discovery sessions to assess feasibility, explore patient needs, and validate ideas through prototypes and experiments.

 - Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive, engaging interfaces that help patients understand and act on their information, improving completion and engagement.

 - Build and maintain reliable, well monitored integrations with external partners and internal systems, with strong attention to data accuracy, privacy, and compliance.

 - Work closely with other engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and communication across systems and services.

 - Contribute to the team's technical vision by identifying strategic technologies and investments that improve scalability, reliability, and performance.

 - Break down complex projects into clear, actionable tasks and lead execution to successful outcomes.

 - Elevate engineering standards by improving workflows, processes, and tools to increase development velocity and quality.

 - Analyze product, operational, and patient feedback metrics to identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement.

 - Create and maintain technical documentation for architecture, integrations, experiments, and development processes.

 - Conduct code reviews and contribute to knowledge sharing initiatives across the team.

 - Model a culture of open communication, feedback, and continuous learning by coaching and supporting teammates at all levels.




YOU HAVE:

 - 5+ years of professional experience building production web products with strong full stack skills in React/Next.js and Node/TypeScript (or similar).

 - Proven experience delivering scalable, high quality web applications and services in a modern cloud environment.

 - Experience building and operating third party integrations and asynchronous, event driven workflows (queues, webhooks, retries, idempotency) where correctness and reliability matter.

 - Proficiency in front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, GraphQL) and back end technologies (Node.js, Nest.js, PostgresDB, Redis, Amazon SQS).

 - Track record of shipping experiment driven features that improved conversion, activation, or retention; comfortable with feature flag systems and experimentation platforms such as GrowthBook, Optimizely, or LaunchDarkly.

 - Fluency in web performance optimization, accessibility, and modern UI engineering, with an eye for presenting complex information clearly and responsibly.

 - Strong analytical and data skills, including event instrumentation, debugging analytics, and writing basic SQL or partnering with Analytics to define success metrics and guardrails.

 - Deep product mindset: cares equally about UX, copy, and pacing as about architecture and APIs; approaches problems with iterative, testable solutions.

 - Experience with Agile development methodologies and CI/CD pipelines, including automated unit and integration testing.

 - Excellent problem solving abilities and sound judgment in balancing speed, quality, and impact.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to align partners, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive initiatives from idea to execution.

 - Highly organized, self directed, and capable of prioritizing multiple projects to meet goals with minimal oversight.

 - Bonus: experience in healthcare or another regulated domain (HIPAA, PHI handling), or with third party partner integrations and industry data standards.




OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS):

 - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

 - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

 - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

jobs.title: AI-Native Software Engineer (New Grad)
jobs.description:
Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education. We build market-leading, online college credit and test-preparation solutions that help working adults earn their degrees, advance their careers, and achieve economic mobility. Recognized by Fast Company and GSV 150 as one of the world’s most innovative education companies, we are also at the forefront of AI-first learning, combining artificial intelligence with the latest learning science to improve access and outcomes at scale.

Our product is our impact. Through our Keys to College and Keys to the Classroom initiatives, we have saved students over $700 million in tuition and enabled hundreds of thousands of learners to pursue and succeed in careers across nursing, teaching, counseling, business, and other high-demand fields. We are deeply focused on measurable outcomes and building products that create meaningful, lasting change in people’s lives.

You're early in your career and you already ship real software with AI coding agents. Here that's just how we work. We want you doing it for millions of learners from your first week.

About the Role

Engineering at Study.com is AI-native. Our engineers direct coding agents every day, inside an agent framework we built ourselves: skills that teach agents our codebase and conventions, guardrails that keep them on the rails, and evaluation that tells us whether the output is good. We define what "done" means and hold the bar on quality, security, and architecture; the agents do the typing. The question on our teams is no longer whether to use AI, but how much further it can go.

You will join a cross-functional team and grow into the work alongside the engineers around you. You will take features from acceptance criteria to production: understand the problem with product and design, break it into work an agent can execute, drive the agents, test what comes back, and see it ship to real students and teachers. This is a role for learning the craft, with the support to do it well. Architecture, security, and system-wide decisions stay with the team while you build toward them. Engineers who grow here move on to larger scope and their own product areas.

This role is based in our Mountain View, CA office and is hybrid in office Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

What You'll Do

• Build and ship features with AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar tools) as your primary way of producing software.

• Work across our stack: Java and Spring services, MySQL, and TypeScript/React frontend.

• Write the tests and acceptance criteria that tell an agent when a feature is done.

• Work with your team to review and ship your code.

• Flag the skills and guardrails that fail you, and help make them better.

• Follow your features after release: watch the metrics, take the feedback, and learn from the trade-offs your team makes.

Your First 90 Days

• Days 1 to 30: Ship to production in your first week, with help close at hand. By the end of the month you have several features live and you know your way around the product and the codebase.

• Days 30 to 60: Take on larger features. Understand the metric each one is meant to move, ship it, and follow through on what the data says. Land your first improvement to a skill or guardrail the team uses.

• Days 60 to 90: Work on features with more ambiguity in them. Join the technical design discussions for your team's work and start contributing to them. Move faster on the paths you now know well.

What You'll Learn

In your first year you will get good at:

• Breaking a product problem into work an agent can execute well, and spotting when it has not.

• Reading a diff critically, and taking a review on your own work.

• Testing and observability practice on a system that real students depend on.

• Our stack, end to end, and where its load-bearing parts are.

• When to trust what an agent hands you, and when to go read the code yourself.

What You'll Bring to the Role

• Evidence that you build and ship software. Internships, personal projects, open source, and hackathon work all count. Show us the things.

• Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build non-trivial functionality, and opinions about where they excel and where they still need a human.

• Working proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Java or TypeScript preferred) and familiarity with how web applications fit together, front end through database.

• Solid fundamentals in data structures and algorithms.

• Clear written communication. Much of your work is specifying intent precisely, for people and for agents.

• A BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, recently completed or expected before your start date.

Nice to Have

• A portfolio or GitHub that shows a pattern of finishing and shipping things, especially things built largely with agents.

• Experience with Java and Spring, React, SQL, or NoSQL databases.

• Experience writing prompts, skills, or evaluations that make LLM-based tools more reliable.

• A habit of finishing what you start, and of asking about the things that look wrong.

Compensation

The hourly pay range for this position is $43.00 – $59.00 per hour. This range reflects the full pay progression for this level. New hires, including recent graduates, typically begin in the lower portion of the range and grow their pay as they gain experience within the role. Actual pay depends on factors including skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This is a non-exempt position and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.

Director, Technical Training & Qualifications

Who We Are:
Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

The Role:

The Director, Technical Training & Qualifications is responsible for building and leading Atlas Energy Solutions’ Technical Training & Qualifications Center of Excellence (COE) across Power, Sand, and Logistics.

Reporting to the VP, Head of Human Resources, this leader will establish the enterprise framework, standards, processes, tools, and governance required to consistently develop and qualify Atlas’s technical workforce.

The Director will partner closely with Operations, Operational Excellence, Safety, Engineering, Talent & Culture, and technical subject matter experts to create a repeatable approach for translating critical work and standard operating procedures into effective technical training and demonstrated qualifications.

This role is a core component of Atlas’s workforce resilience strategy. By creating greater visibility into technical capabilities, building deeper benches of qualified employees, reducing reliance on tribal knowledge, and creating repeatable pathways to develop critical skills, the Technical Training & Qualifications COE will help ensure Atlas has the qualified workforce needed to safely and reliably operate today while preparing for future growth.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Integration Engineer
jobs.location: Ann Arbor, MI; Forth Worth, TX; Blacksburg, VA
jobs.description:
Meet the Team

Join Torc's System Integration & Enablement team, where we build the tools, test infrastructure, automation frameworks, and integration environments that enable Torc's autonomous driving platform to operate reliably at scale.
Our team works at the intersection of hardware, embedded software, platform software, systems engineering, validation, and autonomy integration. We partner closely with teams across Compute Platform and the broader autonomy organization to improve the efficiency, repeatability, and quality of platform integration activities.

Through Hardware-in-the-Loop systems, on-truck development, automation frameworks, validation infrastructure, and integration tooling, we ensure software developed across Torc can be successfully integrated, tested, and deployed on its intended hardware platforms.

We are looking for a Senior Systems Integration Engineer to lead on-truck platform bring-up and integration. You will be the engineer others turn to when a new compute platform, sensor, or software release needs to work on a real truck, and you will shape how the team approaches integration so that it scales beyond any one person.

What You'll Do

• Lead on-truck bring-up and integration of embedded compute platforms, sensors, networking, and vehicle interfaces, from first power-on through validated, deployable configurations.

• Own integration of platform, embedded, and autonomy software releases onto target hardware, defining acceptance criteria and making the call on integration readiness.

• Drive root-cause investigations that span hardware, firmware, OS, middleware, and application software, and see them through to durable fixes.

• Design and evolve Hardware-in-the-Loop, Software-in-the-Loop, and on-vehicle validation environments so they faithfully represent production trucks and catch issues before the field.

• Architect automation frameworks, diagnostic tooling, and integration processes that other engineers adopt, and define system-level test strategies for new platform variants.

• Represent integration in cross-functional design reviews, using lab and field evidence to influence hardware and software architecture decisions and to surface systemic risks.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and author the bring-up procedures, troubleshooting guides, and reference documentation that become the team's standard.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field; Master's preferred.

• 5+ years of experience integrating hardware and software systems, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-disciplinary integration efforts.

• Hands-on experience bringing up embedded Linux compute platforms, including boot flow, kernel and driver configuration, BSP customization, and system-level debugging.

• Strong Python and C++ (or comparable) skills, with experience building tools and automation used by other engineers.

• Experience designing or maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop, Software-in-the-Loop, or equivalent validation environments, and working with CI/CD and automated test frameworks.

• Working knowledge of vehicle and robotics communication stacks such as Ethernet, CAN, PTP, DDS, and ROS 2, including deployment on embedded targets.

• Proven ability to lead cross-domain root-cause investigations using logs, telemetry, bus captures, and lab instrumentation.

• Strong written and verbal communication, experience mentoring or leading technical work without direct authority, and comfort working in vehicles and lab environments with occasional travel to test sites.

Bonus Points

• Experience integrating autonomous vehicle, ADAS, or robotics platforms in a production or pre-production setting, especially trucking or heavy-duty vehicles.

• Familiarity with functional safety or safety-critical development practices (ISO 26262, SOTIF, or equivalent).

• Experience with automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, or time-sensitive networking.

• Experience with NVIDIA DRIVE or similar SoC/GPU platforms, or with Yocto, Buildroot, or custom Linux distributions.

• Experience with sensor integration and calibration, fleet telemetry, remote diagnostics, or over-the-air update systems.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Pharmacy Benefits
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.  Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service.  With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

• Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

• Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.

• Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

The Customer Success Team is focused on helping SmithRx’s clients derive the full value of their PBM services. We build and manage effective relationships with our customers’ operational leadership, communicating the value of our services in the context of customers’ business goals with the goal of retaining high performing, satisfied customers. We identify risks to client satisfaction proactively and collaborate across product and operational lines to tenaciously pursue solutions and advocate for our clients.

As a SmithRx Account Executive, you will be the primary strategic partner for our clients (employers, health plans, or TPA groups). You aren't just a "point of contact"; you are a healthcare consultant responsible for managing a book of business, driving client retention, and identifying opportunities to optimize pharmacy spend while improving member outcomes. You will bring strong industry and PBM knowledge and serve as a trusted advisor and business partner for your client’s operational leadership.

What you will do:

• Establish and maintain relationships for large complex accounts

• Own and facilitate end to end renewal process

• Accountable for client satisfaction

• Lead internal teams and act as internal client advocate

• Provide executive updates on client status and risks.

• Represent Customer Success in Finalist meetings.

• Analyze pharmacy claims data to identify trends, provide cost-containment recommendations, and deliver quarterly/annual business reviews (QBRs).

• Create and maintain a client strategic action plan.

• Partner with clinical pharmacists to present formulary changes and clinical program recommendations to clients.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, including drug pipelines, legislative changes, and competitive PBM landscapes.

• Partner with leadership to review deliverables (QBR’s, reporting and client communications) to ensure "executive-ready" quality.

• Coordinate with internal teams (Implementation, Operations, and Pricing) to resolve member issues and ensure seamless service delivery.

• Serve as a formal or informal mentor to Account Managers (AMs), Account Specialists, and Account Coordinators; provide guidance on client communication strategies, career development, and navigating complex PBM workflows.

• Responsible for understanding the Client's organization & structure, knowing the Client's product/services and staying aware of Client news and changes. Maintain and update Client record with changes.

• Develop and maintain effective working relationships in liaison role with Pharmacy Operations, service partner contacts and client contacts.

• Ensure full, proactive communication of all important client account activities with cross-functional partners

• Prioritize issues and assess escalations that may lead to client attrition risk with the Account Managers to ensure a strong mitigation plan is in place

• Travel required: Up to 25%

What you will bring to SmithRx:

• Requires 3-5 years of Account Executive experience in PBM or health insurance

• Requires 5+ years of direct account management or relationships management experience in the healthcare space; working knowledge of commercial health insurance and pharmacy benefits strongly preferred

• Ability to interpret complex data sets (claims, rebates, and ROI) and translate them into actionable stories for C-suite executives.

• A positive growth mindset with the ability to approach difficult situations in a calm and focused manner; understand the challenge and move forward tactfully towards a solution

• Executive-level communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively navigate and mediate conflict and foster honest dialogue

• Experience in Client relationship management ensuring expectations and deliverables are documented and met, key stakeholders are informed, and client satisfaction is achieved

• Ability to work independently as well as part of an extended, cross-functional team

• Self-driven, results-oriented and disciplined work ethic

• Ability to take initiative with little to no direction

• Be transparent and honest in a positive, professional and polite manner

• Expert conflict resolution skills

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

What SmithRx Offers You:

• Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance

• Flexible Spending Benefits

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Program

• Short-term and long-term disability

• Discretionary Paid Time Off

• Paid Company Holidays

• Wellness Benefits

• Commuter Benefits

• Paid Parental Leave benefits

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Well-stocked kitchen in office locations

• Professional development and training opportunities

$129,000—$150,000 USD

• Non metro Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and West Virginia

Compensation & Benefits

• Base Salary: The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: American Girl Restaurant Host (part-time)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: The Host is located at the AG Retail Flagship Los Angeles location and reports directly to the Café Manager. This position is responsible for greeting and seating restaurant guests, managing reservations and working with the restaurant team.  If you thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment and can handle challenging service situations with sound judgment and a positive, professional demeanor, we want to hear from you.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Greets guests promptly and provides timely seating of guests by maintaining accurate waitlists, while maximizing seating capacity.
• Manages large crowds in a professional manner and is able to resolve challenging service situations diplomatically.
• Creates and maintains a pleasant ambiance in the dining room and party rooms through lighting, music, and table placement.
• Communicates accurate dining room and party room setup, along with special requests and birthday information, to the restaurant team.
• Shares information on the store and restaurant events with guests.
• Utilizes Zomato reservation and InfoGenesis register systems, along with Microsoft Office, to perform job functions.
• Initiates training opportunities with restaurant staff.
• Assists restaurant staff as needed in providing an outstanding dining experience.

What We’re Looking For:

• Experience as a restaurant host, hotel concierge, or related customer service position, preferred.
• Computer skills including restaurant reservation and POS systems, Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, and use of basic office equipment (copiers/fax), preferred.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran and protected veteran status, disability status, and or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
