jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
MISSION

The Path is a research lab and consumer health company on a mission to provide therapy-grade help for anyone, anytime.

Over 3 billion people a year have a problem large enough to warrant therapy but the barriers to access - around price, time, geography, stigma, and language - are so large that less than 10% of these people are getting the help they need.

The Path exists because help shouldn’t depend on privilege, because intelligence should serve humanity, and because clarity is the first act of care.

As a member of The Path, you will have an opportunity to build a generational company that aims to have more positive impact on the world than any other company in human history.




WHO YOU ARE

Serve as a full-stack Product Designer who owns the end-to-end design of features, including user research, ideation, prioritization, and high-fidelity mocks. Solve business and user goals with design thinking and user empathy at the center. Bring a high quality bar to everything, working with Engineering to make the final product look outstanding. Move at startup speed, establishing a brand and driving product growth at The Path.




OUTCOMES

 - Mobile App Launch: Design a beautiful new mobile app from scratch, launching the flagship The Path Therapy product with beautiful visuals, intuitive interactions, and an innovative UX. Bring user empathy and strong visual communication to bear on every problem.

 - Mobile App Launch: Design a beautiful new mobile app from scratch, launching the flagship The Path Therapy product with beautiful visuals, intuitive interactions, and an innovative UX. Bring user empathy and strong visual communication to bear on every problem.

 - Design System: Build a comprehensive design system from scratch, incorporating the new The Path brand (colors, typography, grid, core components). Be thoughtful about future-proofing the design system with things like internationalization & accessibility, while also making it composable and implementable.

 - Own Quality: In a high-trust environment without dedicated QA, take full responsibility for design integrity, lifting the quality bar across the company. Quality definitely includes the visuals, animations and “wow” factor of the look and feel. But quality is mostly about solving users’ problems and driving growth.

 - Feature Implementation: Deliver designs for 10+ major features per quarter. Be collaborative and strategic in making key roadmap prioritization decisions, and helping scope the implementation with engineers.

 - User Research: Periodically talk to our users (active and churned), and form deep hypotheses about the underlying patterns in what they need. Do this 3-6 times per year, speaking with 10+ users in a batch and presenting findings to the team. Then use those insights to help prioritize our roadmap and create novel solutions to those users’ problems.

 - AI-First: Leverage AI design tools to accelerate ideation, while ensuring final outputs are polished, human-centered, and free of AI slop that could undermine The Path’s brand. Also, think deeply about the future of Human-AI interactions, bringing your novel ideas to life inside the The Path Therapy product.
   
   


COMPETENCIES

 - Design Expertise: Expert in Figma for building full design mocks end-to-end. This includes all aspects of product design: UX, strong use of imagery, typography, iconography, and animation. Nice-to-have would be also strong in making marketing designs that fit the brand but are better for top-of-funnel and grabbing attention.

 - Experienced: Portfolio shows exceptional visual communication and design thinking, for prominent mobile consumer products in the market touching millions of customers. Is able to draw on that expertise to make The Path’s product an A+.

 - Quality Focus: Track record upholding standards in lean teams, delivering exceptional designs and partnering with Eng to polish implementation (without QA oversight).

 - Fast & Scrappy: History shipping high-volume work, hitting deadlines, getting a lot done without needing to just outsource things to external resources. You are resourceful, and thrive under pressure.

 - Strategic: You help us understand what NOT to build, not just what to build. This is grounded in your experience and understanding the product problems very deeply.

 - Innovative: Understands where the puck is going in terms of AI trends, and is able to know what’s possible with the technology today vs in the future. Can then use this insight to deliver designs that can be implemented now, but that also avoid the cookie-cutter approach to AI-driven interfaces, and that fully leverage the power of the tech we have.
   
   


LOGISTICS

 - San Francisco, hybrid (Tue–Thu in office). Not remote. Full-time.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid) or Remote (US)

What You'll Do:

The Project Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of customer projects across Togetherwork's Professional Services portfolio. This role manages projects from initiation through closeout, ensuring outcomes are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with customer objectives and defined scope.

The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional delivery teams, maintains clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders, manages project risks and dependencies, and follows established PMO standards and delivery practices.

Project Delivery & Management

• Own end-to-end delivery of assigned customer projects.

• Develop and manage project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones, and resource needs.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across consulting, technical, data, and product functions.

• Manage scope, change control, project financials, and delivery commitments throughout the project lifecycle.

Risk & Issue Management

• Proactively identify, track, and mitigate delivery, resourcing, and customer risks.

• Coordinate resolution of project issues and develop action plans with the appropriate delivery team members.

• Escalate risks and issues appropriately, providing clear context, impact, and recommended next steps.

Stakeholder & Client Management

• Serve as the primary day-to-day point of accountability for customer project stakeholders.

• Provide clear, transparent, and timely project status reporting.

• Build productive, trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

Quality & Standards Adherence

• Ensure delivery aligns with PMO standards, methodologies, and governance.

• Uphold quality expectations across milestones, deliverables, and outcomes.

• Provide feedback on delivery frameworks, tools, and processes based on project experience.

Project Administration & Practice Participation

• Maintain accurate and timely project documentation, status, forecasts, risks, issues, decisions, and action items.

• Ensure project data and time/budget tracking are current in designated delivery systems.

• Use established templates, tools, and reusable delivery assets consistently.

What You'll Bring:

• 3-5 years of professional project management experience

• Working knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid).

• Strong organization, prioritization, problem-solving, and follow-through.

• Clear and effective customer and stakeholder communication capabilities.

• Financial awareness with attention to project budgets, forecasts, and delivery economics.

• Proactive, accountable, and outcomes-oriented mindset.

What Drives Us

At Togetherwork, we exist to help community-driven organizations grow and thrive—creating better experiences for the people they serve. As part of our team, you contribute to our TW28 vision by living our core values:

• Obsess over our customers.

• Own it. Together.

• Move fast with purpose.

These values guide how we lead, collaborate, and deliver impact as we build a stronger company—together.

jobs.title: Facilities Engineer II
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Facilities Engineer to join our Facilities team. You will help design, build, activate and maintain our next-generation spacecraft manufacturing facilities. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects at a time and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. As a Facilities Engineer, you will participate, coordinate, and execute infrastructure projects as well as oversee ongoing operations and maintenance of facilities, equipment, and utilities. This will involve corrective, preventive, and predictive maintenance techniques as well as operational and design feedback for maintaining and improving all systems at Muon Space’s San Jose facility.

This position is onsite and requires working in our San Jose, CA office five days a week.

Responsibilities

• Lead internal technical facilities and infrastructure projects, consulting engineers and contractors throughout the entirety of the engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, documentation and maintenance process.

• Provide technical engineering support/information to ensure construction/maintenance complies with all standards, codes, and specifications.

• Verify maintenance is being completed and coordinate all repair, build, and contingency systems efforts for HVAC (including cleanroom/HEPA infrastructure), security systems, fire protection, and other manufacturing infrastructure.

• Resolve production facility design and construction conflicts in the field in real time with multiple parties (internal and external).

• Support the capital expenditure process; including reviews, approvals and execution of site capital projects ensuring technical specifications, budget and deadlines are met.

• Work with the relevant local authorities to acquire building permits when appropriate and ensure all certificates and final inspections have been obtained prior to project close out.

• Communicate and deliver building/maintenance activities and schedule to personnel, subcontractors and material suppliers to effectively and efficiently execute targeted deadlines.

• Ensure the reliability and maintainability of new and modified installations.

• Respond to facility emergencies and own facility readiness procedures for environmental threats

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of professional experience with the design or build of MEP (Manufacturing Electrical Plumbing) and HVAC building systems.

• Experience in planning and day-to-day management of engineering, procurement, and construction processes for aerospace, industrial or large commercial construction projects.

• Primary experience with electrical and power distribution systems including delta/wye transformers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding.

• Experience with critical power infrastructure including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches.

• Experience with plumbing design and operation including domestic and process water systems.

• Knowledge of HVAC operation and design principles including refrigeration, chillers, boilers, HEPA filtration and air handling equipment.

• Able to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair.

• Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems.

Nice-to-have Skills

• Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, or engineering design software.

• Experience in conceptual design and budgeting.

• Familiarity with National Electric Code, ASHRAE, National Fire Protection Association, and International Building Code.

• Experience with aerospace manufacturing equipment (clean rooms, vibration tables, thermal vacuum chambers, in-air thermal chambers)

• Experience with test and process automation equipment (Data acquisition systems, PLCs)

Salary

The salary range for this role is $132,000 - $143,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too.  Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As a Sales Strategy & Operations Manager, you will help shape and execute strategic initiatives that improve sales performance in Motive’s SMB Business. You will translate business priorities into actionable plans, provide rigorous analysis and recommendations, and serve as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross-functional partners.

This role is ideal for a strategic, analytical, and execution-oriented operator who can navigate complex business questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive solutions from insight through implementation. • Serve as the primary sales operations business partner to the SMB New Logo and Account Management Organization

• Own the day-to-day operating rhythm for the business, bringing exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor to reporting and recurring business review cadences.

• Develop and execute strategic initiatives that support sales growth, productivity, and operational effectiveness.

• Analyze sales performance, pipeline, capacity, and business trends to identify opportunities and risks.

• Improve sales processes, operating rhythms, reporting, and planning mechanisms.

• Lead cross-functional projects involving Sales, Systems, Business Intelligence, Finance, and Marketing

• Translate complex data and business problems into clear priorities that inform leadership decision-making and drive measurable outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

• Experience in sales strategy, sales operations, business operations, consulting, finance, or a related analytical function.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data and develop practical recommendations.

• Demonstrated experience leading projects with diverse scope and driving initiatives from planning through execution.

• Ability to build consensus across teams and communicate recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders.

• Expert with SQL, Google Sheets / Excel and Salesforce

• Proficient in AI tools (LLMs, Agents, Apps Script, N8N) to maximize efficiency and accuracy of daily work

• Sound judgment, strong ownership, and an ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Growth Operations
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Operations team builds how the company plans, forecasts, and makes decisions—turning strategy into execution. We sit at the center of the business and tackle high-impact, often ambiguous problems that directly affect growth, efficiency, and scale. This means deep-dive analysis, process redesign, and pragmatic solutions that make the company run better.

We work closely with senior leaders, move fast, and focus on outcomes. This is a team for people who like solving hard problems, building & iterating, and leaving things better than they found them.

ABOUT THE JOB

As Senior Manager, Growth Operations, you will lead quantitative deep-dives on high-stakes questions from C-Suite—structuring the analysis, building the models, deriving insights, and presenting recommendations—that inform major company decisions on long-range planning, portfolio prioritization, and resource allocation.

You will also lead cross-functional efforts to translate top-line forecasts to downstream implications across the business, running focused strategic sprints that address complex, evolving questions. You will regularly engage with C-suite leadership, own the analytical rigor behind strategic decisions, and ensure that growth planning processes evolve as the business scales.

This role is ideal for someone who excels at synthesizing complex data, translating insights into executive recommendations, and driving execution on high-stakes projects that shape company direction. You will regularly engage with C-suite leadership, own the analytical rigor behind strategic decisions, and ensure that growth planning processes evolve with the business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own ad-hoc strategic projects from C-suite that directly impact top-line growth strategy and business expansion

• Run strategic sprints on all downstream planning related to the ACV forecast including tie-in with long-term strategic plans, product mix, and enabling manufacturing and delivery capacity at the targeted pace

• Lead scenario planning efforts to model different growth trajectories, government program office trends, and strategic options for leadership decision-making

• Build and refine planning frameworks, forecasting models, and analytical tools used by growth leadership

• Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for executive audiences

• Lead cross-functional workstreams involving Business Development, Finance, and Operations to ensure alignment on growth priorities

• Present findings and facilitate strategic discussions with senior leadership, including the executive team

• Ensure initiatives move from insight to execution with clear accountability and measurable impact

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 6+ years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or consulting with additional operational experience at a hyper-growth company, hardware is a plus

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills with demonstrated experience in forecasting, financial modeling, and scenario analysis

• Proven track record of owning complex, ambiguous initiatives with measurable business impact

• Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to distill sophisticated analyses into clear insights and influence senior stakeholders

• High ownership mindset with a bias toward action and an ability to drive projects to completion

• Comfortable operating independently in ambiguity and making sound judgement calls with incomplete information

• Experience working on growth strategy, revenue operations, or strategic planning initiatives strongly preferred

US Salary Range

$150,000—$200,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: VP, Customer Success
jobs.description:

We are looking for a Warehouse Associate/Driver to join our Rexel USA team in Glenwood Springs CO!

Warehouse Associate/Driver I or II level:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities.

Summary:

The Warehouse Associate/Driver is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns

Come join us!

About The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven, and accomplished Existing Business Sales professional to join our growing US team, focused on growing existing client relationships and selling to the Financial Services market. This is an opportunity to join a high-growth company and sell an award-winning product that is rapidly getting adopted across the market internationally, and this person will be able to make a significant contribution to the company’s growth and future success.

Who You Are

• Experience selling to financial market place (buy side and sell side), preferably in a SaaS technology, financial information and/or research organization

• Proven track record of achieving sales targets; we are building a team of top sales performers and a great winning culture, so looking for people who share the same experience and values and together we can continue on our explosive growth

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Home Improvement
jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About this Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Home Improvement Loan product. In this pivotal role, you'll own and drive key initiatives shaping both merchant and customer experiences. The role is perfect for those who are self-motivated and excel in an agile environment. You’ll be responsible for leading and collaborating with sales, designers, engineers, marketers, and key partners to deliver impactful, measurable outcomes. Please note that this is a role in hybrid capacity based in our downtown San Francisco office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

What You'll Do:

• Spearhead product strategy and execution for Upgrade's Home Improvement business, owning critical components of the platform including conversion funnel optimization, underwriting, servicing, and both merchant- and customer-facing experiences

• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept through delivery and post-launch optimization, continuously improving merchant retention and customer acquisition

• Drive partner integrations and unlock new monetization opportunities through APIs with external fintech ecosystem partners

• Partner closely with Engineering, Risk, and Compliance, leveraging their expertise to shape the product roadmap and execution plans

• Identify market opportunities, analyze the competitive landscape, and propose innovative solutions that strengthen our lending products and grow market share

• Translate customer insights, business goals, and market trends into prioritized product requirements, using data-driven decision making to maximize impact

What We Look For:

• 5+ years of product management experience with demonstrated success in driving KPIs through thoughtful product development and user-centric design

• Technical proficiency including experience with financial services APIs, integration architectures, data analytics platforms, A/B testing methodologies, and SQL

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical degree a plus

• Proven track record of successful product delivery in consumer finance, lending platforms, or fintech environments; financial services product experience strongly preferred

• Strong understanding of lending regulations, underwriting processes, and credit risk principles

• Exceptional stakeholder management skills with ability to align diverse teams and navigate complex organizational dynamics

What We Offer You:

• Competitive salary and stock option plan

• 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

• Competitive 401(k) and RRSP program

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

The compensation range of this position in San Francisco, CA is USD $180,000-$200,000 annually plus equity and benefits. Within this range, an individual's base pay will be dependent on a variety of factors, including without limitation, job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.

#BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Supervisor, IT Network Infrastructure - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPERVISOR, IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE - 2ND SHIFT

SpaceX technical teams work in a complex environment supporting a variety of critical production, launch and landing activities. The Network Infrastructure team installs and supports the low voltage used for all types of telecommunications in support of the production and launch vehicles and spacecraft.  This includes but not limited to installation and support of the layer 1 fiber and copper data network cabling infrastructure, support of mission video, ground-side vehicle and payload interface systems, ground stations, telemetry and optical tracking systems, marine communications, readiness testing, and other systems involved in real-time communications and operations for Falcon, Dragon, Starship and other missions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Supervise technician teams to install and maintain mission critical communication systems

• Prioritize and schedule work to meet required timelines

• Provide feedback and progress updates to project stakeholders

• Evaluate, diagnose, troubleshoot cabling infrastructure systems and perform repairs as necessary

• Coordinate with other contractors and project teams as needed

• Collaborate with the communication engineers and telecommunication specialist in system designs, selection of materials, and creation of documentation

• Interface with external carriers (private and government) at cross-connect facilities, and transition points

• Provide superior customer service to SpaceX launch customers

• Provide QA and auditing before and after work

• Maintain the integrity of the documentation of all installations including assets, locations, connectivity, and the patch record databases

• Assist with the creation of local and companywide installation and workmanship standards

• Provide ongoing feedback, periodic review, and corrective action to direct reports

• Review timesheets, manage overtime and time off requests

• Verify compliance with OSHA regulations and SpaceX safety requirements

• Assist in the evaluation and selection of candidates for open positions in the team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 5+ years of telecommunications systems experience

• 2+ years prior leadership experience (leading teams, projects or people)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Technical expertise in the installation, termination, testing of low voltage cables and fiber optical cables to include twisted pair, coaxial, stranded and solid conductor low voltage cables, single mode and multi-mode fiber optical cables

• Strong knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA); different types of fiber (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage; Cat5E, Cat6 and Cat6A data cabling; and cable pathways such as conduit, fire penetrations and cable trays

• Knowledge of the telecom network best practices and concepts including network security, network architecture design, technical standards and deliverables, troubleshooting tools (e.g., line analyzers, breakout boxes, and network traces), software and hardware installation and configuration, network hardware, and protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DLC, and ASYNC)

• Working knowledge of audio, video, and wireless systems and corresponding physical means of delivery (analog, digital, AoIP, VoIP, etc.)

• Operational knowledge of oscilloscopes and multi-meters, soldering wires and connectors, various crimping tools, wire stripping techniques, Ohm’s law, continuity testing, pinning out a military type connector, routing and tie wrapping cables, drilling and tapping holes, and building junction boxes

• Experience with DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts

• Experience with IP and HD-SDI video cameras and infrastructure

• Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity

• Experience operating articulating boom lifts, fork lifts, scissor lifts, and other work site machinery

• Proficient in the use of Visio or other CAD software to read and develop system documentation

• Experience in the installation and operation of RF communication systems

• IP and HD-SDI Video cameras and infrastructure

• Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity

• Working knowledge of electrical systems including UPS and standby power systems

• Sound knowledge of computer skills, MS Words, Excel, and Power Point

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work 2nd shift: Monday-Friday, 1:30PM-11:30PM

• Ability to distinguish between different colors and possess manual dexterity to complete fine motor tasks

• Ability to work at elevated heights and/or tight spaces

• Physical effort including standing, lifting and carrying moderately heavy materials (up to 25 lbs unassisted) or equipment

• Regularly exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain

• Work occasionally performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Willingness to work long hours, some nights and weekends when need to meet critical deadlines

• Ability to travel (up to 25%) as required to common destinations including Hawthorne, CA (SpaceX headquarters); McGregor, TX (SpaceX test site); Vandenberg, CA (SpaceX west coast launch site); Cape Canaveral, FL (SpaceX east coast launch site)

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Operations Team Lead 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring for a Operations Team Lead to contribute to our 2nd shift Order Pulling team in Roseburg, OR.  An Operations Team Lead supports all operational and administrative activities required to run a department of major warehouse activity.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization.  We ensure that our distribution centers and warehouse facilities function at maximum efficiency.   Safety is a core value in our distribution environment.  We emphasize this through training, education and accident prevention programs.  Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people to the content they want in the simplest ways.  If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

Pay:

Schedule:

Required Qualifications:

• HS Diploma or equivalent
• 1-year experience with PC based applications
• 1 year work experience in a warehouse operation environment

• Acts as the department contact for all warehouse systems issues and questions

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack
jobs.description:
The Company:

Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning. In our fast-changing world, the traditional educational system struggles to meet the diverse and evolving needs of young learners. Outschool reimagines this system, offering flexible and engaging learning experiences as a supplement and alternative to traditional education. By connecting learners with a global community of teachers and peers through our online platform, we make learning personal, dynamic, and deeply human.

We've made significant strides since launching our marketplace of live online classes in 2017. Finding initial success with secular homeschoolers, we then expanded to enrichment learning to meet the needs of a wider audience, growing our business 16x since 2019. Post-pandemic, we have evolved our platform to power academic learning, incorporated AI, and have begun to grow our international community. We're proud to have served over 1.5M passionate learners with more than $100M in annual bookings.

Driving disruptive, positive change in education is rewarding and hard. Outschool team members are encouraged to challenge themselves, take risks, and grow in their careers. We look for talented people whose sense of urgency, innate curiosity, and determination to drive impact will help Outschool achieve outsized results in pursuit of our mission. We invite you to be part of an ambitious team dedicated to ensuring every learner can navigate the future with curiosity, resilience, and a love of learning.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack to join our Product Engineering team in South Korea. The team’s mission is to build high-quality product experiences that help learners, families, and educators connect and succeed on Outschool. You'll own challenging problems across the stack, from designing intuitive user experiences in React, to building scalable backend systems and APIs, to evolving our data models and architecture, to improving product quality and performance, to using AI-native tools and approaches to help us build and iterate faster.

We are an effective team of engineers distributed across the US, Canada, and South Korea. Our philosophy is to start small and then intentionally iterate to test our assumptions and learn quickly. We're iteratively building up a complex product for a highly engaged audience.

This role requires working from our Haeundae, Busan office Tuesday–Friday from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Mondays are remote.

Our Stack:

• Product Engineering

• TypeScript · React · Node.js · GraphQL/Apollo · PostgreSQL · OpenSearch

• Our engineers work across the full stack, from building polished user experiences to designing APIs, data models, and backend services.

• Infrastructure & Developer Platform

• AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda) · Terraform · GitLab · Prometheus/Grafana · OpenTelemetry

• Product engineers partner closely with our Infrastructure team and are empowered to understand, deploy, and operate the systems they build.

• AI-Native Development

• We use AI throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.

• We're also actively incorporating AI into the Outschool product and exploring new ways AI can improve learning experiences for families, learners, and educators.

Core Responsibilities:

• Product development: Build high-quality product experiences for learners, families, educators, and partners across the full stack, from React and TypeScript in the frontend to GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and backend services.

• Technical ownership: Own projects from problem definition through design, implementation, launch, and iteration. Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and user impact.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Researchers, Analysts, and other Engineers to shape requirements, explore solutions, and deliver the right product—not just implement predefined specifications.

• Architecture & engineering quality: Design scalable, maintainable systems and APIs. Improve application architecture, testing, performance, observability, and engineering practices as the product and team grow.

• AI-native development: Use AI tools throughout the development workflow to move faster and improve quality, and help identify opportunities to incorporate AI into Outschool's product and learning experiences.

• Production ownership: Deploy and operate the software you build. Participate in on-call, investigate production issues, and use monitoring and user feedback to continuously improve reliability and product quality.

• Technical leadership: Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and mentoring. Help other engineers make strong technical decisions and grow their skills.

• Continuous improvement: Identify friction in our product, codebase, and development processes and proactively improve it. Look beyond the immediate task to make the team and platform more effective over time.

Desired Experience & Skills:

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Strong experience building modern web applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js

• Experience designing and building APIs and backend services, ideally using GraphQL, REST, or similar technologies

• Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query design

• Experience owning complex technical projects from design through implementation, launch, and ongoing operation

• Understanding of software architecture, testing, performance, reliability, and maintainability in production systems

• Experience collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers to shape solutions, not just implement requirements

• AI-forward approach: you actively use AI tools in your workflow, can prompt effectively, validate output critically, and know when to override or take a different approach

• Ability to provide technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and mentoring other engineers

• Intermediate or higher English reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills; our interview process and daily engineering work are conducted in English

Other Considerations:

• Experience in EdTech or building products for learners, educators, or families

• Familiarity with search and discovery systems

• Familiarity with payment APIs (e.g. Stripe)

• Experience at a fast-paced startup or high-growth company

Benefits in South Korea:

• Coworking office located directly at exit 11, Jangsan Station in beautiful Haeundae, Busan.

• Necessary equipment (MacBook, monitor, etc.) and software for work provided

• Finish work early in the day - working hours from 7AM - 3PM.

• Flexible vacation, use whenever you like. Korean national holidays plus 15 extra days per year.

• Invitation to join the annual company retreat once per year (flight to United States, hotel, meals paid for by company).

Benefits & Culture:

At Outschool, we believe that taking care of one another enables us to do our best work. To us that means:

• Shared Financial Success: Competitive salaries, stock options, and retirement plans

• Health: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance

• Wellness: Annual wellness stipend, access to coaching & therapy, and pet wellness plans

• PTO & Family Benefits: Generous PTO and family leave policies

• Hybrid & Remote-Friendly: Outschool has a distributed team across the U.S. and Canada and an office in San Francisco. Bay Area-based employees work in the office part of the week and receive commute-related benefits. Team members outside the Bay Area remain fully remote, with support for expensable home office setup and internet to stay connected no matter where you are.

• Lifelong Learners: Annual budgets for professional development and DEI learning; budgets for children to take Outschool classes

• Community Impact: Outschool matches employee donations to eligible charities and supports Outschool.org’s nonprofit programs

Outschool is an equal opportunity employer. We view diversity as a moral imperative and competitive advantage. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We plan and structure our interviews to directly assess skills and experience.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact recruiting@outschool.com.

Benefits packages are included for full-time employees only. Please note benefits and perks may vary for employees based outside of the US and Canada.

Full-time employees must be a citizen or legal residents of the U.S. or Canada and reside in U.S. or Canada, unless specifically indicated otherwise.

Once you submit your application, Outschool will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy for employment. Unless specifically indicated otherwise, we hire employees only in the U.S. and Canada. Applicants else where should be aware that we may discard your application upon submission or we may ask if you would like us to retain it later should there be consideration (this is not typical at all).  If you are selected for interviewing, your data will be shared with interviewers and personnel involved in that process. If not hired, your application will be retained for one year in case there is another suitable role. You may opt out of this at any time. Please see our Employee/Applicant Privacy Notice for more detailed information. If applicable, as you progress through the process, we will be clear about what information is being asked for and what happens with that information.

jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse I (LPN) or II (RN) - Sun/Mon/Tues 7am-7:30pm - BHSC
jobs.description:
WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support.

Our Guiding Principles:

• Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.

• Exceptional Care. We offer compassionate, innovative services that meet people where they are, from immediate support to long-term recovery.

• Integrity. We operate from a deep foundation of ethical, accountable practices in all we do.

• Organizational Resilience. We meet the moment and adapt to changing contexts with collaborative creativity, agile business processes, and financial stewardship.

Position Summary:

Provide direct nursing services, mental health assessments, and treatment to the people we serve with severe and persistent mental illness. You will obtain, record, and communicate important clinical information, and provide clinical services within a multidisciplinary team environment.

Department Specific Information: This is an inpatient position with our Behavioral Health Solutions Center and is a 24/7/365 first responder drop-off location for individuals in the community experiencing a behavioral health crisis.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Psychiatric Nurse I (LPN) - $30.12 - $31.62/hour

• Psychiatric Nurse II (RN) - $40.56 - $48.56/hr

• Psychiatric Nurse III (BSN) - $43.08 - $52.58/hr

• Language Differential - $2.50/hr for bilingual proficiency in Spanish & ASL

• For complete overview of our robust Benefits: https://wellpower.org/workplace-of-choice/

The posted range represents the full hiring range. Offers will not exceed this range, the majority of candidates are placed near the midpoint based on experience and qualifications.

Job Duties & Functions:

• Provide psychological problem identification, crisis interventions, and similar services to assigned patients.

• Provide limited case management services to people we serve as needed.

• Assist consumers with psychological and social development and rehabilitation.

• Coordinate consumer’s use of other WellPower programs and outside community resources.

• Coordinate medical care and intervention with other clinical staff and psychiatrist(s).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Experience
jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box is on a mission to power how the world works together. Box AI is central to that mission—bringing intelligent assistance and agentic workflows to our customers across web, mobile, and desktop. The AI Experiences team works on the core user experiences that bring Box AI to life across Box products

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of cross-platform AI experiences with speed, quality, and strong technical judgment. You will own or co-own team-level initiatives across web & mobile that ship ship delightful Box AI user experiences to customers. Your primary focus will be on front-end architecture in React and React Native while partnering closely with backend engineers and cross-functional stakeholders. If you’re passionate about making AI the new user interface for Box content, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• You will own or co-own the design, implementation, and delivery of Box AI chat and agentic frontend experiences across all of Box's web and mobile applications, spending approximately 80% of your time on frontend development and 20% collaborating with backend engineering teams.

• You will shape and inform requirements alongside Product Managers and UX Designers — not just implementing specs, but helping define them, making trade-offs quickly, and driving decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• You will ship weekly to production, contributing daily PRs and making incremental advances toward feature delivery within one-week sprint cycles.

• You will help define cross-platform best practices for new feature development across web, iOS, and Android, establishing patterns and standards that scale across the team.

• You will uphold accessibility, performance, and quality standards through thoughtful engineering, code reviews, and testing — spending at least an hour daily on PR reviews to raise the bar for your peers.

• You will stay current with rapidly evolving AI model capabilities and translate them into meaningful customer value, responding quickly when new models require corresponding frontend experience changes.

• You will partner with backend engineering teams to define interfaces, contracts, and incremental delivery milestones, ensuring full-stack quality even as your primary focus remains on the frontend.

• You will participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise.

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

• You have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on front-end development, and you bring deep expertise in React; React Native is a strong plus, but React alone is sufficient — having both is a significant advantage.

• You bring full-stack understanding — you are comfortable with backend APIs, system design, and defining interfaces and contracts, enabling you to collaborate effectively with backend partner teams even as your primary focus is frontend.

• You actively use AI coding tools — such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex — as a core part of your development workflow, including requirements gathering, writing tests, and feature delivery; this is a hard requirement, not a bonus.

• You have a demonstrated track record of shipping significant changes across multiple components or systems with minimal guidance, in fast-paced environments where you shape requirements rather than wait for them.

• You bring a collaborative mindset, a commitment to inclusive and accessible design, and a passion for mentoring peers and elevating engineering practices through high-quality code review.

• You have experience with CI/CD pipelines, A/B testing, and feature flag-driven development; exposure to GCP and cross-platform mobile architecture is a plus.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead an electrical engineering team in creating embedded compute solutions for vehicle management, DSP, and networking

• Own the full PCB development cycle of host boards for FPGAs / SoCs / SoMs (Developing requirements, schematic capture, board layout, bring-up, test, and integration)

• Create, maintain and communicate product development schedules with sufficient detail to ensure that all assigned personnel are aware of their tasks and deadlines.

• Experience with leading an Electrical Engineering team focused on Digital Design

• Proficiency in an HDL language (VHDL, Verilog)

• Familiarity with common MCU, CPU, FPGA devices and technologies.

• Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc.

jobs.title: Product Counsel
jobs.description:
About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity’s mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you’re excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Counsel, R&D / AI to serve as the primary legal partner to Doximity’s AI team. You will sit with the engineers, data scientists, and product managers building our clinical AI products — ambient documentation, clinical search and answers, and AI-powered clinician workflows — and help them ship quickly and responsibly. This is a hands-on, high-judgment role for a lawyer who wants to be in the room where AI products are designed, not downstream of them.

As a Product Counsel, R&D / AI, you will:

• Act as embedded counsel to our AI and R&D teams, advising on product design, model development, and launch decisions from concept through release — and owning the most significant legal questions our AI organization faces.

• Advise on health data throughout the AI lifecycle: HIPAA and HITECH, business associate arrangements, de-identification, permitted uses for model training and evaluation, and state health privacy and consent laws.

• Counsel on AI-specific risk, including training data provenance and licensing, third-party model and API terms, output accuracy and reliability, clinical decision support and FDA software boundaries, intellectual property in AI outputs, and transparency and disclosure obligations.

• Draft and negotiate the agreements R&D depends on — data licenses, model and infrastructure provider terms, research and clinical collaborations, BAAs and DPAs, and evaluation and pilot agreements.

• Build the legal infrastructure that lets AI development scale: intake and review processes, product launch checklists, playbooks, self-service guidance, and training for engineering and product teams.

• Partner closely with Privacy, Security, Regulatory, Clinical, Trust & Safety, and Marketing to align on governance for new AI capabilities.

• Track the fast-moving AI and health data regulatory landscape and translate it into concrete, actionable product guidance.

Location: This role is In-Person in San Francisco, CA.

What We’re Looking For

We’re excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

• J.D. and active membership in the California bar (or eligibility to register as in-house counsel in California).

• Approximately 5–9 years of legal experience, including meaningful in-house time supporting a technology, digital health, or healthcare organization.

• Demonstrated experience as product counsel — embedded with engineering and product teams, advising on features in flight rather than reviewing finished work.

• Healthcare data fluency: HIPAA, business associate relationships, de-identification standards, and the practical realities of working with PHI. Digital health, health IT, or provider-facing experience strongly preferred.

• Working knowledge of the legal issues specific to AI and machine learning — training data rights, model licensing, output liability, evaluation and monitoring, and emerging AI regulation.

• Genuine hands-on facility with AI tools, and the technical curiosity to engage substantively with the people building models.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward practical, risk-calibrated advice delivered at product speed.

• Clear, concise written communication and the ability to make legal complexity actionable for a technical audience.

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $184,000 - $214,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

• Base salary

• Equity (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Flexible paid time off and company holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Professional development and learning opportunities

• Wellness and mental health resources

• Commuter support and onsite amenities at our San Francisco office

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you’ll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

• Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

• Shape how clinical AI gets built. You will help set the standards for how AI is developed and deployed for U.S. clinicians — novel questions, real consequences.

• Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

• Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

• Bring your authentic self. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Survey Project Manager | Renewables, Power & Energy

Help Shape the Infrastructure Powering Tomorrow

Some survey projects are routine.

These aren't.

In this role, you'll help deliver projects that directly support utility modernization, renewable energy expansion, and community growth. From utility corridors and electrical infrastructure to large-scale solar developments and commercial sites, you'll play a key role in bringing critical projects from concept to construction.

Whether your background is rooted in power & energy, utilities, or land development, we're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and helping teams succeed.

If you're the type of professional who is always looking for the next challenge, enjoys mentoring others, and takes pride in delivering exceptional work, we'd love to connect.

As a Survey Project Manager, you'll serve as a trusted leader for both clients and project teams, helping guide projects from initial planning through final delivery.

Your responsibilities will include:

This isn't a role where you'll simply inherit projects and maintain the status quo.

We're looking for someone who wants to do meaningful work, take on bigger challenges, and grow alongside an organization that's continuing to expand its presence in the power, energy, and renewable markets.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own the full PCB development cycle of host boards for FPGAs / SoCs / SoMs (Developing requirements, schematic capture, board layout, bring-up, test, and integration).

• Develop and improve workflows throughout the FPGA / HDL design cycle (Architecture, functional block definition, simulation, system testing, HDL library standardization).

US Salary Range

Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Principal Software Architect
jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.

About the Role

Abacus is scaling fast – more Data Solutions applications, more agent-assisted engineering, more complexity worth getting right. We're creating this role to put a single, senior technical voice at the center of that growth: someone who can take sharp architectural judgment and turn it into standards the whole organization can build on with confidence.

We're looking for an experienced Principal Software Architect to set the technical vision for how Abacus builds, secures, and scales its healthcare data platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role, not a management track – you'll be the architecture guru and evangelist for our platform, translating business and customer needs into target-state architectures across data, applications, cloud, and agent-assisted engineering, and mentoring engineers and Solution Architects as you go.

You'll build the reusable application foundation – design system, application blueprints, integration contracts, and production-readiness gates – that lets Data Solutions applications move fast without reinventing the wheel every time. And as agent-driven development becomes a bigger part of how we ship, you'll be the one turning architecture standards into skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that let AI-assisted output meet the same bar as our best human-written code – putting you at the center of how Abacus builds software for years to come.

You'll bring enough depth to guide decisions across data, application, integration, cloud, and agentic development, while staying pragmatic about fit-for-purpose architecture and delivery constraints. You won't do it alone – you'll partner closely with Product Engineering, our XPORT Principal Engineering team, AI Engineering, Security, and Client Solutions, bringing architecture to life from concept through production, not just on a whiteboard.

Core architecture leadership

• Own and evolve the reference architecture for Abacus's core platform – data ingestion, transformation, distribution, and serving – partnering with teams where ingestion and distribution ownership is shared, and with Product Engineering on application and service layers.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for scaling, high availability/disaster recovery design, serverless patterns, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture across our AWS and Azure environments.

• Guide architecture for HITRUST and GovRamp compliance alignment, partnering with Security and Compliance so designs meet audit and control expectations from the outset rather than as an afterthought.

Healthcare data and platform architecture

• Design scalable architectures for payer data solutions spanning claims, membership, provider, clinical, lab, and pharmacy/Rx domains, and their analytical and operational serving layers.

• Apply FHIR-based interoperability patterns and healthcare data standards where relevant to product or client implementations.

• Establish data contracts, lineage, quality controls, metadata, and integration patterns across ingestion, transformation, and serving layers.

Application architecture and user experience foundation

• Own the design system and front-end/UX standards for Data Solutions applications, partnering with UX/Design on accessibility, branding, and consistent interaction patterns.

• Define standard user-management capabilities – tenant setup, roles, permissions, and admin experiences – as reusable patterns instead of something each team reinvents.

Agent-driven development and AI-enabled engineering

• Translate approved architecture standards into skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that our ADD Harness and agent-assisted development workflows can consume directly.

• Evaluate agent-generated code and designs against architectural gold standards, and build the scoring and review mechanisms that let us scale the quality of agent-produced merge requests across engineering teams.

• Partner with AI Engineering on semantic/context layers, agent interfaces (MCP and A2A), retrieval patterns, AI gateways, evaluation, traceability, and governed model access.

Architecture governance, mentoring, and influence

• Be an active senior member and contributor to Abacus's Architecture and Data Guilds – introducing ideas, taking them to realization, and helping drive a culture of innovation through hackathons and beyond.

• Mentor engineers and Solution Architects through pairing on designs, reviews, and pilots, growing architectural capability across the team rather than concentrating it in one person.

• Establish lightweight architecture review mechanisms that protect critical standards without slowing delivery, measuring adoption through signals like reuse, exception volume, and escaped design defects.

Production readiness and operability

• Ensure every architecture package includes deployment topology, support model, rollback strategy, and operational telemetry, partnering with DevOps/Platform and Security on CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. Help to establish quality metrics like DORA

• Hold designs to a resiliency bar appropriate for a platform of Abacus's scale, and help teams reason through trade-offs between delivery speed and operational risk.

The impact you'll have

In your first 6–12 months, you'll leave a clear mark on how Abacus builds software:

• Deliver a reference architecture for Data Solutions applications that teams adopt from day one – a shared blueprint, design system, API/data contracts, and starter implementations that let new work move faster instead of starting from scratch.

• Stand up the skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that let our ADD Harness and agent-assisted workflows produce work that meets our architectural bar – a foundation that scales with the team, not just with you.

• Build the architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, and operational-readiness checklists that give every release clear evidence it's production-ready – deployment, observability, support, and rollback accounted for before go-live.

• Grow architecture capability across the team through pairing, reviews, and ownership handoffs – leaving Abacus with more senior architectural judgment than it had when you started, not just your own.

What you bring to the team

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

What we'd like to see, but not required
