• Experience defining architecture standards, rules, or evaluation rubrics for AI- or agent-assisted development workflows.

• Experience with FHIR-based interoperability or other healthcare data exchange standards.

Compensation: Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What you’ll get in return

jobs.title: Digital Hardware Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead an electrical engineering team in creating hardware solutions for vehicle management, DSP, and networking

• Develop and improve workflows throughout the FPGA / HDL design cycle (Architecture, functional block definition, simulation, system testing, HDL library standardization)

• Independently reviewing high speed digital and compute based designs

• Oversee the full PCB development cycle of host boards for FPGAs / SoCs / SoMs (Developing requirements, schematic capture, board layout, bring-up, test, and integration)

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to create the strategy for delivering hardware and IP core solutions across Anduril

• Create, maintain and communicate product development schedules with sufficient detail to ensure that all assigned personnel are aware of their tasks and deadlines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent

• 7+ years of experience designing, testing and troubleshooting complex board designs in military, automotive or similar hardware.

• Experience with leading an Electrical Engineering team focused on Digital Design

• Proficiency in an HDL language (VHDL, Verilog)

• Familiarity with common FPGA, CPU, MCU, GPU devices and technologies.

• Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc.

• Experience in design for signal integrity / power integrity.

• Knowledge of modern analog and digital electronics and electronic circuits.

• Competence with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, thermal chambers, current-probes, and automation of tests.

• Proficient with Altium Designer or equivalent electronic design automation design tool

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Understanding and familiarity with DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160, DO-311A

• Understanding and familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-704, MIL-STD-461

• Expertise in computer networking

• Experience with implementing enhanced security measures

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Marketing & Communications shapes how Instacart shows up in the world. As the organization evolves and its leadership operates at increasing levels of complexity, people decisions need a dedicated strategic partner who can keep up. You'll work directly with Marketing & Communications leaders at the Sr Director and VP levels, bringing the connective tissue between business strategy and talent: proactive org design, leadership coaching that actually sticks, and people practices that hold up as the function scales.

What you’ll cook up in your first year

• Senior Marketing & Communications leaders — at the Sr. Director and VP level — have a trusted strategic advisor shaping how they build, develop, and retain their teams, so people decisions are made with confidence and are visibly tied to business outcomes.

• Organizational health across Marketing & Communications is measurable and improving: talent trends are surfaced early, retention risks are flagged before they become attrition, and the team is structured to scale sustainably.

• A cohesive talent strategy is in place for Marketing & Communications — covering attraction, engagement, and development of diverse, high-caliber talent — that positions the org to compete in a tight market.

• Change doesn’t catch the team flat-footed: leaders and employees move through transitions with clarity, supported by communication strategies and change management plans that you own end-to-end.

• People Team Centers of Excellence are better calibrated to the needs of Marketing & Communications because you’ve brought business context into their planning — pushing back where needed and ensuring programs land with impact, not just intent.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• 3–5 years of HRBP experience in a high-growth technology company, with 7+ years of overall HR or related experience.

• Proven ability to independently lead all aspects of the talent management lifecycle — performance management, org design, calibration, engagement, and leadership development — with minimal oversight.

• Demonstrated track record of coaching and influencing Director and VP+ level leaders with autonomy and confidence, shaping organizational strategy and decisions.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to craft clear narratives, build change management plans, and influence across all levels of an organization.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and financial metrics to surface actionable insights and drive strategic planning.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to assess downstream impacts of decisions across functions and connect people strategies to company-wide priorities.

• Working knowledge of employment law and its application in day-to-day people operations.

• BA/BS degree in a relevant field.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Prior experience supporting Marketing or Communications organizations.

• Comfort — and genuine enthusiasm — for operating in environments of rapid growth and change.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Martech
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Martech Solution Architect is a senior technical role within Wynn's Customer Data Platform (CDP) team, responsible for the design, development, and evolution of Wynn's custom campaign management application and the broader marketing technology ecosystem. This role combines deep data engineering and solution architecture expertise with hands-on product development capability, owning the end-to-end technical design of martech integrations, data pipelines, and application components that power guest engagement and campaign execution across Wynn Resorts!

The ideal candidate is an AI-native practitioner who actively uses AI tooling to accelerate design, development, and delivery — not as an experiment, but as a standard part of how they build. They bring full-stack awareness, strong data architecture instincts, and the engineering discipline to operate within CI/CD pipelines on GitHub. They are equally comfortable whiteboarding a solution architecture with stakeholders and writing production-quality code or data pipeline logic.

Key Competencies

Architecture Thinking

• Designs for the system, not just the ticket
• Surfaces trade-offs explicitly before committing
• Writes decisions down; does not rely on tribal knowledge

AI-Native Practice

• Uses AI tooling as a daily accelerant, not a demo
• Validates AI outputs before shipping to production
• Brings concrete AI capability proposals, not abstractions

Engineering Discipline

• CI/CD is non-negotiable, not an afterthought
• Read before write; single-purpose changes; rollback plan
• Test coverage is a delivery requirement, not optional

Communication & Leadership

• Translates architecture to business impact clearly
• Mentors without gatekeeping; elevates the team
• Surfaces blockers and risks early; does not absorb silently

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Management Application Development & Ownership

• Lead the technical design and ongoing development of Wynn's custom campaign management application — owning architecture decisions, feature delivery, and platform evolution roadmap.
• Design and implement application components across the full stack — including front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, and data integration layers — with production-quality standards for reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
• Define and enforce the application's data model and integration contracts; ensure campaign execution data flows correctly between the campaign management application, the enterprise data warehouse, and downstream martech activation platforms.
• Identify and remediate technical debt within the campaign management application; propose phased modernization initiatives with clear business impact framing for leadership review.
• Manage the application development lifecycle in GitHub — branching strategy, pull request review standards, release tagging, and deployment pipelines — in alignment with enterprise CI/CD practices.

Martech Solution Architecture

• Design end-to-end solution architectures for Wynn's martech ecosystem — spanning campaign management, customer engagement platforms, CRM integration, guest feedback systems, and enterprise data warehouse connectivity.
• Produce architecture artifacts — including C4-level component diagrams, integration sequence diagrams, data flow maps, and API design specifications — to a standard suitable for engineering handoff and executive review.
• Evaluate new martech capabilities, platforms, and integration patterns; provide structured build vs. buy vs. integrate recommendations with TCO and risk analysis.
• Define and govern integration standards for martech data flows — including payload schemas, event contracts, error handling patterns, and data latency SLAs — across the enterprise integration layer.
• Partner with the Lead Data Architect and VP to align martech solution design with the broader CDP platform strategy, data governance policies, and enterprise architecture principles.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Design

• Design and implement data pipelines that move campaign, engagement, and behavioral data between martech source systems, the enterprise data warehouse, and activation platforms — with appropriate transformation, validation, and error-handling logic.
• Define data engineering patterns for martech ingestion — including schema mapping, data quality gate design, CDC (change data capture) patterns, and idempotent load strategies — for adoption by the broader data engineering team.
• Contribute to dimensional and relational data model design for martech subject areas; ensure pipeline outputs conform to agreed grain, key, and SCD strategies documented by the data architecture team.
• Instrument data pipelines with observability — monitoring hooks, alerting thresholds, and DQ validation checkpoints — so failures surface to the CDP team before downstream impact.
• Apply disciplined engineering practices to all pipeline and schema work: read before write, single-purpose changes, documented rollback steps, and peer review before production deployment.

AI-Driven Product Development

• Actively use AI coding assistants, code generation tools, and LLM-based development workflows to accelerate campaign management application feature delivery and martech solution prototyping — treating AI tooling as a standard engineering accelerant, not an experiment.
• Design and prototype AI-assisted capabilities within the campaign management application and the broader martech platform — including intelligent campaign recommendations, audience segmentation assistance, and natural language interfaces for campaign configuration.
• Define responsible AI integration patterns for martech use cases: prompt design, output validation, hallucination guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review workflows where required.
• Stay current with the AI tooling landscape relevant to martech, campaign management, and data engineering; bring concrete capability proposals to the VP and Lead Data Architect for prioritization.

CI/CD, DevOps & Engineering Governance

• Own and maintain CI/CD pipeline configuration for the campaign management application and associated martech integration components on GitHub — including automated test gates, linting, build validation, environment promotion, and deployment automation.
• Define and enforce branching conventions, pull request standards, code review practices, and release management processes for the martech engineering workstream.
• Implement automated testing coverage for the campaign management application — unit, integration, and regression test suites — as part of the CI pipeline; set and maintain coverage thresholds for production-bound code.
• Participate in infrastructure-as-code practices for cloud-hosted components of the martech stack; ensure environment configuration is version-controlled and reproducible.
• Champion engineering quality across the CDP team — code review participation, documentation standards, and knowledge transfer for architectural decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery

• Translate martech business requirements into detailed technical specifications, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready User Stories within the team's ADO delivery framework.
• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for martech vendor and integration partner discussions — evaluating APIs, reviewing technical documentation, and negotiating integration design with external teams.
• Communicate architecture decisions and design trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; produce written decision records for all significant architectural choices.
• Mentor junior engineers and analysts on the CDP team — architecture thinking, engineering discipline, AI tooling adoption, and CI/CD practices.

Required

• A minimum of six (6) years of experience in solution architecture, data engineering, or senior software engineering roles — with at least two (2) years in a martech, CRM, or customer data platform context
• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering production applications or data platforms end-to-end — from architecture through deployment — in a cloud-native environment (Azure preferred)
• Strong data architecture skills — dimensional modeling, integration pattern design, API contract definition, and data quality framework development
• Hands-on Snowflake experience — including pipeline design, schema development, query optimization, data sharing, and external function patterns in a production data warehouse environment
• Hands-on Databricks experience — building and operating data engineering workloads using PySpark or SQL notebooks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog in an Azure-hosted environment
• Hands-on experience with Azure data engineering tools — including Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure Event Hubs, and Azure Blob Storage — for pipeline orchestration, event-driven processing, and data movement at scale
• Experience with Apache Airflow (or Azure-managed equivalent) for workflow orchestration — DAG design, dependency management, scheduling, and operational monitoring of data pipelines
• Full-stack development awareness: ability to design and contribute to front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, and data integration layers; direct coding experience in at least two tiers
• Hands-on experience with GitHub for source control, CI/CD pipeline configuration (GitHub Actions or equivalent), pull request workflows, and release management
• Demonstrated AI-native working practice — active use of AI coding assistants, code generation tools, or LLM-based development workflows in professional delivery contexts
• Experience designing integrations between campaign management, CRM, marketing automation, or customer engagement platforms and enterprise data platforms
• Strong written and verbal communication skills — architecture diagrams, design documents, and stakeholder presentations to VP and executive audiences
• Comfort with Agile/Scrum delivery — User Story authoring, sprint planning participation, and backlog management within an ADO or equivalent framework

Preferred

• Direct experience building or evolving a custom campaign management, marketing orchestration, or customer engagement application
• Experience designing or implementing AI-assisted product features — recommendation engines, intelligent segmentation, natural language interfaces, or LLM-powered workflows — in a production martech or CDP context
• Familiarity with hospitality or gaming industry data domains — guest profiles, loyalty programs, player development, hotel operations, or reinvestment analytics
• Experience with enterprise integration platforms (MuleSoft, Azure API Management, or equivalent) for martech and CRM data flow orchestration
• Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools (Bicep, Terraform) for Azure-hosted application and data platform components
• Experience with observability tooling — application monitoring, pipeline alerting, and data quality dashboards — in a production data engineering context

Wynn Resorts is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. Wynn Resorts does not discriminate on the basis of disability, veteran status or any other basis protected under federal, state or local laws confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Lightspeed Systems is seeking an Account Executive, to drive new business growth across an assigned book of mid-market K-12 school districts. This role is focused on acquiring net-new district customers through consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
You will own your territory end-to-end - building pipeline, developing relationships with district technology and curriculum leaders, and closing deals that advance student safety and effective technology use across school systems. When you close a deal, you stay in the driver's seat: you manage that account day-to-day for the remainder of the calendar year, continuing to sell additional products and expand the relationship, in coordination with the Account Manager team.
Key Responsibilities

• Own and execute a territory strategy to drive net-new revenue within an assigned list of mid-market K-12 school districts (specific territory assignment provided at hire).

• Build pipeline from four sources: outbound prospecting, inbound marketing-qualified leads, channel/reseller partner referrals, and field events (ISTE, state ed-tech conferences, regional events).

• Lead full-cycle sales efforts from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.

• Conduct deep discovery to understand district challenges, priorities, and funding path (general funds, CapEx, E-Rate, grants, or bond cycle) before advancing a deal.

• Position Lightspeed's safety, filtering, and device visibility solutions as strategic investments aligned to district goals.

• Lead contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and procurement processes, including co-op and state contract vehicles where applicable.

• Build and maintain a pipeline that supports consistent quota attainment, with accurate Salesforce hygiene on every active opportunity - stage, close date, and next step always current.

• Manage your closed accounts day-to-day for the remainder of the calendar year - staying the primary point of contact, identifying and closing additional product opportunities, and coordinating with the Account Manager team.

• Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and the Account Management team to support deal strategy, cross-sell coordination, and execution.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

• 4+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong preference for EdTech or SaaS environments.

• Strong track record of carrying and consistently exceeding a new-business quota in a hunting role.

• Experience selling into K-12 school districts or public sector organizations, or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a public-sector sales cycle.

• Demonstrated success managing complex sales cycles with multiple decision makers.

• Strong consultative and solution-based selling skills; comfortable working a defined sales methodology [TODO: confirm and name Lightspeed's methodology - internal Sales Hub references a "Lightspeed Sales Methodology" and a 4-week Sales Academy certification new reps complete].

• Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce) and modern sales enablement tools.

• Able to work onsite at Lightspeed's Austin HQ (Code Ranch) Monday–Thursday and to travel as required (see Travel above).

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with school safety, content filtering, device management, or classroom management technology.

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer - Martech & Campaign Management
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Martech & Campaign Management is a hands-on engineering role within Wynn's Customer Data Platform (CDP) team, responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of Wynn's custom campaign management application and its integrations with the broader marketing technology ecosystem. This role owns both the frontend user experience and the backend services that power campaign creation, offer management, guest segmentation, and multi-channel activation across Wynn Resorts.

The ideal candidate is a full-stack practitioner who combines strong ReactJS and Python engineering skills with the ability to work directly with marketing and campaign operations stakeholders. They understand how complex business workflows translate to application logic, have a high bar for production-quality code, and actively use AI-assisted development tools to move faster without sacrificing reliability.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Frontend Engineering

• Design and implement ReactJS-based user interfaces that support complex campaign management workflows — including campaign creation, offer matrix configuration, approval routing, audience selection, and post-execution reporting.
• Build component-based UI architecture with strong separation of concerns; ensure components are reusable, testable, and maintainable across a multi-property application context (WLV and EBH).
• Implement role-based access control, field-level validations, and multi-step workflow logic in the frontend layer; ensure consistent error handling and user feedback across all screens.
• Partner directly with marketing and campaign operations stakeholders to understand UX requirements; translate business workflows into intuitive, performant user experiences without requiring a dedicated product designer.
• Ensure UI consistency, accessibility, and responsiveness across campaign creation, approvals, and execution screens; contribute to and maintain a shared component library.
• Write frontend unit and integration tests; maintain coverage thresholds as part of the CI pipeline; participate in cross-browser and regression testing ahead of releases.

Backend Engineering & API Development

• Build and maintain FastAPI-based backend services that orchestrate campaign execution, manage offer and rate code logic, handle system valuations, and expose APIs consumed by the frontend and downstream integrations.
• Use SQLAlchemy ORM to model and manage application data; design schemas that support campaign lifecycle state, offer hierarchies, audience segmentation, and audit trails.
• Develop and maintain integration APIs that connect the campaign management application with enterprise martech, CRM, hospitality, and gaming platforms — ensuring reliable data exchange, idempotent operations, and graceful degradation.
• Design and implement backend validation logic, business rule enforcement, and workflow state management that mirror the complexity of Wynn's campaign and offer approval processes.
• Instrument backend services with logging, error handling, and observability hooks; participate in production support and root cause analysis for a business-critical platform.

Data Integration & Snowflake

• Integrate application data flows with Snowflake — including query design, data-driven application logic, campaign performance data retrieval, and writing execution results back to the data warehouse.
• Work with the data engineering team to understand and consume CDP data assets — guest profiles, segmentation outputs, engagement history, and offer eligibility data — as inputs to campaign management application logic.
• Ensure data consistency between the campaign management application's operational data store and the enterprise data warehouse; design integration patterns that minimize latency and data drift.
• Contribute to data model design for application-owned entities — offer hierarchies, campaign lifecycle states, audience definitions — ensuring alignment with CDP data architecture standards.

AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Practice

• Actively use AI coding assistants and code generation tools (including Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code AI extensions) as a standard part of the development workflow — for code generation, test writing, refactoring, and documentation.
• Validate and own all AI-generated output before committing — reviewing for correctness, security, and alignment with application architecture; AI tooling accelerates delivery but does not replace engineering judgment.
• Stay current with AI-assisted development tooling relevant to full-stack engineering; bring concrete productivity improvement proposals to the team.

CI/CD, Deployment & Engineering Governance

• Package frontend and backend services using Docker; ensure containerized builds are consistent, reproducible, and environment-agnostic across development, staging, and production.
• Contribute to and operate within Wynn's CI/CD pipelines on GitHub — including automated test gates, linting, build validation, and environment promotion — following team branching and PR review standards.
• Participate in code review as both author and reviewer; maintain shared engineering standards for code quality, documentation, and test coverage across the campaign management application codebase.
• Follow disciplined engineering practices for all changes: read before write, single-purpose commits, documented rollback steps, and peer review before any production deployment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery

• Work within the CDP team's ADO delivery framework — writing User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and sprint tasks from business requirements; contributing to backlog grooming and sprint planning with product owners and marketing stakeholders.
• Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and blockers clearly to non-technical partners; translate complex engineering constraints into business-consumable language.
• Participate in feature grooming sessions with marketing, campaign operations, and revenue management stakeholders; ask clarifying questions before building rather than silently interpreting requirements.
• Support expansion of campaign management application capabilities — including real-time offer execution, personalized booking windows, promotional kiosk integrations, and communication-only campaign types.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Full-Stack Ownership

• Owns the feature end-to-end — UI through API through data
• Does not wait for handoffs; closes gaps independently
• Designs APIs and data models before writing a line of UI

AI-Native Practice

• Uses AI tooling as a daily accelerant, not a demo
• Reviews and owns all AI-generated output before it ships
• Uses AI for tests and docs, not just feature code

Engineering Discipline

• Tests are a delivery requirement, not optional cleanup
• Single-purpose commits; documented rollback for every change
• Nothing ships outside the CI pipeline

Stakeholder Partnership

• Clarifies requirements before building, not after
• Translates technical constraints to business language
• Surfaces blockers early; does not disappear on hard problems

• A minimum of five (5) years of experience in full-stack software engineering, with a portfolio of production applications that includes both frontend and backend ownership
• Strong ReactJS proficiency — component architecture, state management, routing, form handling, and performance optimization in a complex, multi-workflow enterprise application
• Strong Python and FastAPI proficiency — RESTful API design, async patterns, dependency injection, middleware, and production-grade error handling
• Hands-on SQLAlchemy ORM experience — schema design, relationship modeling, migrations, and query optimization for relational data stores
• Hands-on Snowflake experience — SQL query design, application-layer integration, data retrieval patterns, and writing results back to a cloud data warehouse
• Experience with Docker for containerizing full-stack applications; familiarity with environment-specific configuration management and container deployment patterns
• Hands-on experience with GitHub CI/CD workflows — GitHub Actions or equivalent, pull request standards, automated test gates, and environment promotion
• Demonstrated AI-native development practice — active use of AI coding assistants or code generation tools in professional delivery contexts, with strong judgment about when and how to apply AI output
• Experience building enterprise applications with complex business logic — multi-step approvals, role-based access control, state machines, or workflow orchestration
• Strong ability to work directly with non-technical business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate designs, and communicate trade-offs

Preferred

• Experience in a martech, CRM, campaign management, or customer engagement application context — understanding how campaign logic, audience segmentation, and offer management work end-to-end
• Familiarity with event-driven or real-time integration patterns — message queues, webhook architectures, or streaming event consumption in an application context
• Experience with TypeScript for large-scale ReactJS applications; familiarity with modern frontend tooling (Vite, ESLint, testing libraries such as Jest or React Testing Library)
• Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management) for hosting and integrating full-stack application components
• Familiarity with hospitality or gaming industry workflows — campaign operations, loyalty programs, offer and rate management, or guest engagement platforms
• Experience contributing to or maintaining a shared frontend component library or design system
• Prior exposure to supporting high-visibility production systems with defined SLAs, on-call rotation, and incident response processes

Wynn Resorts does not discriminate on the basis of disability, veteran status or any other basis protected under federal, state or local laws confidential according to EEO guidelines.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

You

jobs.description:
In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

As part of this role, you will:

• Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.

• Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.

• Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.

• Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.

• Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.

• Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

The ideal candidate for the role:

• Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.

• Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.

• Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.

• Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.

• Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com/accounts/treasury.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter, Business Development
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Business Development Recruiting team is responsible for attracting and hiring the talent that builds Anduril's growth engine. We recruit across the full spectrum of Business Development, including Capture, Strategy & Proposals, Business Development Representatives, Government Relations, and Program Management. As Anduril scales into new markets, new programs of record, and new customer sets, these functions grow in complexity and criticality — and the quality of the people we bring in directly shapes how the company identifies, wins, and expands its most consequential opportunities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Recruiter for Business Development to join our rapidly growing team in Washington, DC (preferred), Costa Mesa, CA, Seattle, WA, or Boston, MA office.

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruiting across Business Development, Government Relations, and Program Management, while providing flex support to adjacent Growth searches as needed. You will build deep partnerships with your hiring managers, becoming a trusted extension of their teams, while developing real relationships with candidates throughout the process. This will require the versatility to context-switch across searches that demand very different domain fluency, candidate pools, and assessment approaches. In a given week you might be sourcing a Capture Manager with PEO experience, screening a Director of Business Development - Air Force for our Air Dominance & Strike Division and closing a Senior Proposal Manager who has run $500M+ competitive bids. You will need to learn each sub-function well enough to credibly evaluate candidates and advise hiring managers on talent strategy, market dynamics, and role design. If you are someone who thrives on variety, closes with precision, and earns trust from both hiring managers and candidates through the quality of your work, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

• Own end-to-end recruiting across Business Development, Government Relations, and Program Management, with flex capacity into adjacent Growth hiring during peak periods

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies tailored to each sub-function, recognizing that a capture manager pipeline rooted in the DoD acquisition community looks very different from a government relations pipeline built around former Hill staff and agency liaisons

• Conduct screens that assess functional depth, customer knowledge, and organizational fit, with an evaluation approach calibrated to each search — a capture lead requires different proof points than a proposal manager or a BD representative

• Manage the interview process from intake through close: calibrate with hiring managers, prepare interview panels, facilitate debriefs, and drive offers to signature

Strategic Partnership

• Partner with BD and Growth leaders to understand current and upcoming hiring needs, team composition, and the specific profiles that will succeed in each sub-function and division

• Advise hiring managers on market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and candidate availability across BD disciplines — including where cleared talent is concentrated and what it takes to move senior candidates out of primes or government service

• Provide transparent pipeline updates and market intelligence, especially when conditions require recalibrating timelines, expectations, or clearance assumptions

• Influence role design and leveling by bringing external market perspective to internal conversations about scope, customer alignment, and requirements

Process and Craft

• Own the candidate experience from first outreach through close, making sure every interaction reflects the credibility and mission-seriousness that senior BD candidates expect

• Maintain data integrity in the ATS/CRM to support accurate reporting, capacity planning, and pipeline analytics

• Identify and implement improvements to recruiting processes, tools, and interview practices within your portfolio

• Collaborate with the broader Talent Acquisition team to share market intelligence, sourcing strategies, and best practices across the Growth and BD recruiting functions

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5–8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Direct experience recruiting within business development, capture, proposals, government relations, program management, or adjacent growth functions — ideally in defense, aerospace, or national security

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent searches across different functional areas while maintaining quality and candidate experience

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to advise, calibrate, and build trust with hiring managers across levels

• Data-informed mindset: you track pipeline metrics, use conversion data to diagnose search health, and present market intelligence to influence decisions

• Clear, effective communication with candidates and hiring teams, with the ability to build rapport and assess fit across a range of BD disciplines

• Ability to move fast and prioritize without letting quality or candidate experience slip

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience recruiting in defense, aerospace, or a related industry where cleared talent, customer relationships, and program knowledge are central to candidate evaluation

• Familiarity with the DoD acquisition ecosystem — you understand what a PEO does, how capture campaigns work, and why a candidate's program history matters

• Experience recruiting across multiple BD sub-functions rather than a single specialty (e.g., both capture and government relations, not just one)

• Track record of improving recruiting processes, interview design, or assessment frameworks

• Working knowledge of security clearance processes and how clearance status affects pipeline timelines and offer strategy

• Established network or sourcing muscle in the defense BD talent market, including candidates moving between primes, non-traditional defense companies, and government service

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

This position will lead and support a team responsible for maintaining the general ledger and banking activity for a portfolio of more than 400 properties. Key responsibilities include bank reconciliations, wire and ACH transfers, credit card and customer ACH payment processing, chargeback activity, monthly reimbursement and distribution calculations, month-end close support, and SOX compliance. The Senior Accountant will also partner with 3PM Client Services to research and resolve customer inquiries.

The Role

This position will report to the Third-Party Management Accounting Manager and will collaborate with colleagues across the Third-Party Management organization and broader company. Responsibilities include:

• Manage the monthly bank reconciliation process for a portfolio of 400+ properties, supporting accurate financial reporting and strong account controls
• Manage weekly customer credit card settlements and the transfer to the respective properties
• Record a variety of cash related transactions to the ledger, including chargebacks, bank fees, payment processing fees, NSF checks, cash/check/credit card/ACH variances, and more.
• Help manage the daily and monthly bank reconciliation process, which is performed entirely by the Cash accountants and serves as a key financial and account control. Bank accounts reconciled are used by more than 400 stores and owner entities and are highly complex in nature. Be the “go to” person to address and resolve reconciliation-related questions and issues raised by staff, store personnel, and other corporate accountantsAdminister the ReconNET / Blackline reconciliation software system, which are central to the bank reconciliation process.

• Record monthly accounting entries, adjustments, and accruals related to 3PM properties.

• Calculate monthly reimbursements to PS and revenue distributions to owners.
• Assist the broader accounting team with banking issues, payment systems, cash control, and treasury-related matters when needed.
• Train and review work completed by Global Cash GL staff accountants.
• Ensure financial activities and records comply with GAAP and internal controls.
• Contribute to SOX monitoring and compliance while working closely with both internal and external auditors.
• Support the timely and accurate completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
• Collaborate with other Finance, Accounting, Analytics, and IT teams across the organization to continually streamline, automate, and improve existing processes.

We are looking for the right fit from not only the technical perspective, but a team fit as well. In addition to showing a desire and demonstrated potential for growth and advancement, some of the characteristics we would like to see in the successful candidate are:

jobs.description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

About the Role

We are looking for an expert in US Federal government proposals to support our sales and business development efforts. This role is the critical point of contact to move the ball forward and shepherd opportunities through the solicitation process. You will lead the development of competitive proposals in response to Federal government solicitations (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, BAAs, and Sources Sought). This role owns the proposal lifecycle end-to-end — from opportunity kickoff through submission — ensuring compliance, quality, and win-theme alignment across technical, management, and cost volumes.

This role will be deeply impactful team member in the build-out of our Federal business and our customers’ ability to acquire our product. You will work collaboratively with sales, capture, legal, finance, contracts, operations, leadership, etc., but also work in a fast-paced, autonomous environment with the ability to drive projects quickly and be creative with how to accomplish goals. You will take ownership of winning, compliant proposal responses to customers with a deep empathetic understanding of their business, funding and procurement processes.

About You

• You are deeply familiar with managing the full proposal lifecycle for Federal solicitation opportunities, adhering to FAR/DFARS compliance requirements and agency-specific instructions including: Developing compliance matrices, outlines, and schedules aligned to solicitation requirements. Leading color team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold) and drive resolution of review feedback. Coordinating inputs from sales, capture managers, subject matter experts, technical teams, contracts, pricing, and executive leadership. Facilitating proposal kickoff meetings, storyboarding, and win-theme development sessions. Managing proposal production, formatting, and final submission (including SAM.gov and agency portals). Tracking proposal metrics and supporting post-submission debriefs/lessons learned.

• You possess the talent and know-how to build out a Federally focused proposal capability and process that aligns with Peregrine’s business approach.

• You have the knowledge to implement and operate a proposal infrastructure including reusable materials, proposal tools (e.g., AI, third party platforms, etc.), processes, and more.

• Develop partner and direct proposal approaches.

• Create approaches that maintain Peregrine’s fast-moving culture while ensuring viability with Federal procurement requirements.

• You are skilled at internal communications, allowing key stakeholders to clearly understand Peregrine’s options and associated tradeoffs to make the best decisions possible.

What we look for

• 7+ years managing Federal proposals (DoD, civilian agencies, or intelligence community preferred).

• Strong knowledge of Federal acquisition processes and proposal compliance standards.

• Experience with Shipley or similar proposal methodologies.

• Excellent writing, executive level communication, editing, presenting and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency with MS Office/SharePoint; experience with proposal management software a plus.

• Active or eligible for security clearance a plus.

• Bachelor's degree required; APMP certification a plus

• Located in the Washington, DC area and willing to come into our downtown office 4 days/week.

Annual Salary + Benefits + Equity (if applicable) + Bonus (if applicable)

$132,000—$154,000 USD

Some companies call them “Leasing Agents” or “Leasing Consultants,” but at Prometheus our Neighbor Ambassadors do so much more. As a Neighbor Ambassador, your role is a constant blend of:

jobs.title: Deployment and Training Lead, Air Defense
jobs.location: Irvine, California, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril's Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, we provide mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains our Family of Systems (FoS) in challenging operational environments worldwide.

About the Job

As a Deployment Lead on the Air Defense team, you are responsible for delivering, training, and sustaining a capability that meets our customers' mission requirements and exceeds their expectations. You own the full lifecycle of a deployment — from planning and installation through training, sustainment, and continuous improvement. You fulfill this responsibility through rigorous operational execution, detail orientation, proactive communication, deep mission understanding, and hard-won product expertise.
You feel ownership over the health and performance of all assets and technologies deployed to your customers and users, and ensure that the system delivers when they need it most. You are equally invested in ensuring that end users are trained, confident, and proficient in employing the capability. You develop and deliver world-class training programs, identify knowledge gaps, and build solutions that drive user proficiency and operational readiness.
You represent Anduril to our customers, building their confidence and trust through your professionalism and commitment to excellence. You also represent our customers back to Anduril, communicating user feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve our product and our team in response to evolving mission needs. Above all, you set the standard for what good looks like for your deployment, and you rally your Anduril teammates to meet that standard every single day.
In this role, you will manage deployments of Anduril's Air Defense products while ensuring mission readiness to support national security infrastructure. Collaborating closely with the Program Manager and Program Chief Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing long-term deployment, training, and sustainment operations aligned with customer priorities. As a key team member, you will engage across multiple business lines and facilitate customer interactions, making flexibility, humility, and a collaborative mindset essential qualities for success.

What You'll Do

• Deployment planning and execution: We execute hundreds of deployment events each year, including site installations, test and evaluation exercises, demonstrations, and training and maintenance visits. You will orchestrate these events, leading a cross-functional team that spans hardware supply, logistics, engineering, and more to do whatever it takes to achieve mission success for Anduril and our customers. Meticulous, resourceful, and detail-oriented, you will manage every step of the deployment process, from site survey to testing, pack-out, installation, training, and sustainment. No job is too small. You consistently demonstrate extraordinary judgment, grit, and composure in high-pressure situations. You anticipate every contingency, build lightweight processes, soberly assess and mitigate risk, and deliberately learn from your experiences to continuously improve.

• Training development and delivery: You own the training mission for your deployments. You develop and deliver training curricula across a variety of formats — from computer-based simulations and knowledge portals to hands-on individual and collective training events. You create and maintain training materials that keep pace with evolving product capabilities. You identify knowledge gaps and training opportunities, plan and resource realistic training events, and ensure end users are proficient and confident in employing the full Family of Systems. You are passionate about educating others on groundbreaking technology and measure your success by the operational readiness of the forces you support.

• Relationship management: Build trust with customers, industry partners, users, and Anduril teammates through effective communication, positive attitude, and follow-through. With careful listening and observation, you internalize your counterpart's priorities and requirements. With empathy and responsiveness, you quickly build rapport, trust, and confidence in our capability. You develop relationships across the organization and communicate honestly and directly. You are committed to giving and receiving feedback well. Your partners always know what you expect from them, and know exactly what to expect from you.

• Mission expertise: Develop a deep knowledge of your customer's mission requirements, including the nature of the threats they face, regulatory challenges, resource constraints, rules of engagement, and more. You will become a subject matter expert and the voice of the customer, capable of effectively communicating requirements and CONOPS to Anduril engineers so they can continue to enhance our capability to meet evolving mission needs. You serve as the counter unmanned systems (cUAS) subject matter expert for your customers, helping them resource realistic training and manage all hardware and software configurations for cUAS-peculiar equipment. You are deeply motivated to shape the future of air defense.

• Product expertise: Develop a thorough understanding of the capabilities and limitations of Anduril's Family of Systems. You are innately curious about the technology underpinning our capability, and are not satisfied with a superficial understanding of how and why it works. You are constantly educating yourself about the strengths and weaknesses of different sensor modalities, the challenges of sensor fusion, power and networking requirements, and more. You will become an opinionated power user who can reliably forecast how our capability will perform against a broad range of threat profiles, environmental conditions, and mission constraints.

• Hardware and software configuration management: Manage the end-to-end hardware and software configurations for all assigned equipment at your deployment sites. You ensure systems are properly configured, updated, and maintained to deliver peak performance.

Required Qualifications

• Advanced degree or 5+ years of experience in a technical field, preferably in the defense, national security, or aerospace domain

• Proven experience planning and delivering technical training programs

• Highly organized creative problem-solver with proven project management skills

• Experienced in the creation and upkeep of documentation for new or developing processes, including training curricula and programs of instruction

• Proven experience leading tech-enabled teams of peers while building a culture of influence through relationships

• Deep interest in national security issues and defense technologies, with a commitment to lifelong learning

• Experience translating technical concepts into operational requirements, performance specifications, and training materials

• Ownership mentality with strong initiative in managing your own work in isolated or remote environments

• Comfort communicating complex concepts simply across various methods of communication and tools

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance; Top Secret preferred

• Willing to travel up to 50% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior military experience, particularly in Air Defense, Fires, or related operational roles

• Graduate of the U.S. Air Force Weapons School (USAFWS)

• Experience within the United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) or Special Operations Forces (SOF) community

• Operational experience delivering defense technology solutions to USG customers in hazardous areas or combat zones

• Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$112,000—$149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Executive Producer, Executive Communications
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?



Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.

We're looking for an Executive Producer, Executive Communications to own and evolve Cohere’s narrative globally as we grow to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI. This is a rare opportunity to use video as the primary medium to share voices and tell stories of executives at one of the fastest growing companies in the most dynamic space in technology.

In this cross functional role, you will partner directly with C-Suite and VP executives, helping to determine how we talk to customers, partners, and employees. The role takes Cohere's narrative—the through-line that connects sovereign AI, transatlantic growth, and the product story—and turns it into the content the world sees and shares.

You will execute Cohere's strategic narrative through various forms of content including video, podcast, and in-house production. While the role flexes across formats, we see video as the primary and most effective medium. The Executive Producer has dual aims: to grow the personal thought leadership profiles of Cohere's senior voices on their own channels and to deliver Cohere's narrative to the market through company channels.


As Executive Producer, Executive Communications you will:

 - Build and execute Cohere's strategic narrative across three storytelling surfaces: Executive Thought Leadership, Policy Storytelling, and Corporate Storytelling

 - Partner with the VP Global Communications on narrative architecture and translating Cohere's narrative into content strategy and execution across the aforementioned three storytelling surfaces

 - Audit and gap analyses across Cohere's senior voices including the co-founding team, CFO, Chief AI Officer,  SVP Government Affairs, and various VPs supporting the business

 - Develop content playbooks for predictable inflection moments (regulatory milestones, product launches, customer wins, IPO milestones) to be launched on executive and company pages

 - Partner with Marketing to create content for company accounts

 - Stand up the production function including stage capture systems, content atomization workflows, and freelance crew networks

 - Build AI-enabled workflows using Cohere's own products (Command, North, Embed, Rerank) for transcript-to-asset pipelines, executive prep automation, and narrative consistency

 - Initiate executive stage content capture and distribution at major events with lean, scalable production

 - Conduct executive content audits and gap analyses across senior voices

 - Refine and systematize content production workflows with predictable cadences

 - Develop flagship thought leadership pieces and corporate storytelling output

 - Scale successful surfaces based on impact analysis and team capacity
   

You may be a good fit if you:

 - Have 8-10 years of experience building executive and corporate narratives from ideation through execution, ideally within a fast-paced, high-growth tech or AI environment

 - Are adept are creating production workflows from scratch (stage capture systems, content atomization pipelines)

 - Have experience in the high-paced broadcast television environment

 - Have experience building trust and rapport with executives and senior leaders naturally

 - Are scrappy. You thrive in thinking “outside the box” and find joy in marrying a problem to its solution

 - Are highly organized and process-driven, with strong project management skills and a bias for action

 - Bring high levels of creativity to communications – in format, channel, and storytelling

 - Are comfortable navigating organizational dynamics and building strong relationships across all levels

 - Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and know how to ruthlessly prioritize
   

Ideal Candidate Profile The successful candidate will have experience in strategic communications, content production, and executive storytelling, with the ability to build scalable systems and leverage AI tools. They should be comfortable navigating executive relationships, managing production workflows, and adapting content strategies based on performance data. Experience in tech/AI environments and familiarity with Cohere's product suite would be valuable assets.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

We believe that people don’t just want to work for a company—they want to be part of something bigger. At Engine, we’re building more than a team; we’re building a movement. One where individuality is celebrated, where challenge fuels growth, and where the status quo is never enough. We know we’re not for everyone, and that’s okay. But if you thrive in a fast-moving, high-impact environment and want to shape the future of travel, you just might belong here. Curious? Check out our DNA—if it resonates with you, let’s chat!

We’re looking for a passionate, team-first Sales Development Manager to lead, coach, and inspire our growing Sales Development Representative team. This person will be instrumental in shaping early sales talent, guiding them toward successful careers as Account Executives, and driving the performance of our outbound sales efforts.

Note: this role will require you to work out of our Tempe office Monday-Thursday.

Your Mission:

• Coach & Develop: Provide daily hands-on coaching to entry-level SDRs with a focus on cold calling skills, objection handling, prospecting strategies, and professional development.

• Talent Growth: Foster a career path for SDRs with clear milestones, and champion internal promotions into Account Executive roles.

• Inspire & Motivate: Create an environment of energy and positivity; be a consistent source of motivation for a team doing the hard work of outbound prospecting every day.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry.
