jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Alliances & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
SimSpace serves as an AI Proving Ground where organizations can confidently train, test, and outmaneuver adversaries in any environment. Trusted by allied governments, militaries, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide, SimSpace enables adaptive, AI-ready defenses that stay ahead of evolving threats. Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform unifies training, testing, and validation in a realistic, live-fire simulation—helping teams evaluate security investments, optimize performance, and compress cyber readiness cycles from months to days.



Why join SimSpace? We are an organization that is focused on building our culture and mindfully enhancing our atmosphere every day which is why we have collaborated on an integral value system. Our governing philosophy of being Human Centered is deeply embedded within our value system. We apply this philosophy to every one of our internal team members, external clients, and their customers.



How Do We Work? We believe that people are at the center of everything we do. SimSpace fosters a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. That belief shows up in action: in-house training, internal and external learning platforms, cyber conferences, industry events, and dedicated time for skill development. Our people are empowered to shape their careers - and it shows. Year over year, SimSpace consistently outperforms industry benchmarks in internal mobility, promotions, and total rewards growth.



Who Thrives Here? We are a team of innovators, protectors, and problem-solvers. We believe diversity of thought and experience fuels better solutions, and we’re committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve. Whether you’re remote or office-based, you’ll collaborate with talented colleagues across departments and time zones, united by the mission to create a safer digital world.



We invite you to apply today!



SimSpace is seeking a Technical Ecosystem Manager to build and scale our third-party security technology ecosystem and SimSpace’s industry AI Proving Grounds Consortium. This role is critical to enabling realistic, high-fidelity customer use-cases, as well as managing partnerships with technology providers that offer joint-value propositions to the market and for prospective participants in AIPGC.



The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of security technology, product management, and strategic partnerships. You will work directly with security vendors to educate them on how their products are used inside SimSpace for customer use-cases—while planting the foundation for deeper partnerships, co-development, and future sell-to or sell-with relationships as part of our ecosystem.



This role is highly cross-functional, partnering closely with SimSpace Product Management, Engineering, Sales Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams.




WHAT WILL YOU FOCUS ON AS A SENIOR MANAGER, TECHNICAL ALLIANCES & ECOSYSTEM?

SimSpace Technical Ecosystem and AI-Proving Grounds Consortium

 - Develop SimSpace’s cyber range ecosystem for SimSpace’s customer use-case marketplace, and potential GTM joint offerings. The primary focus will be on relationships that accelerate the testing and adoption of agentic capabilities in offensive and defensive cyber operations.
   
   - Partner with SimSpace’s Head of Partnerships and Alliance, CTO, Product and Sales Engineering on category prioritization and bi-directional technical and business value theses.
   
   - Manage joint tech-validation process and areas for alignment
   
   - Develop and scale joint GTM and revenue-generating strategies with ecosystem partners

 - Act as primary point-of-contact and program management for participating entities in SimSpace’s sponsored industry AI-Proving-Grounds Consortium, collaboratively partnering with cutting-edge agentic AI cyber vendors and consulting firms who aim to advance the safe, trusted and effective adoption of AI agents in cybersecurity operations.
   
   - Thought-Leadership Virtual and In-Person Events for C-Suite execs and cybersecurity leaders
   
   - Collaborate with SimSpace Marketing on execution for the AIPGC events
   
   - Collateral development with Consortium partners
   
   - Maintain monthly cadence with each participating partner



Security Ecosystem Licensing, Enablement & Vendor Education

 - Through direct and indirect acquisition channels, structure and negotiate production multi-tenant licenses that allow SimSpace to deploy partner technologies inside the cyber range, primarily dedicated to customer use-cases. Typical categories include:
   
   - EDR/XDR
   
   - SIEM, SOAR, and security data platforms
   
   - Identity and access management
   
   - Cloud, network, application, and data security
   
   - Attack simulation and pen-testing

 - Educate technology partners on the below and develop relationships with the providers to garner necessary support and stay within vendor acceptable use-policy.
   
   - How their products are used in simulated environments
   
   - How telemetry, APIs, and workflows are leveraged for customer scenarios
   
   - How SimSpace supports technology partners’ expansion and retention objectives by selling to and partnering with us

 - Act as the primary sourcing  point of contact for onboarding, documentation alignment, and technical coordination with SimSpace Range Operations and Customer Support teams.

 - Architect the SimSpace internal workflows and SLAs for how customers and prospect request inclusion, budget and purchase third-party technology through engage




WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?

 - SimSpace maintains a best-in-class security technology ecosystem that materially improves customer outcomes.

 - Customer Range Operations teams have rapid access to the right tools and telemetry to build realistic scenarios within defined and supported use-cases

 - Technology partners clearly understand the value of SimSpace to their product strategy and go-to-market efforts.

 - Multiple partners progress from simple licensing relationships into strategic, revenue-impacting partnerships.




TO BE SUCCESSFUL AS A SENIOR MANAGER, TECHNICAL ALLIANCES & ECOSYSTEM AT SIMSPACE, YOU NEED:

 - 6–8 years of experience in technical partnerships, alliances, product management, or business development within cybersecurity or enterprise software.

 - Strong understanding of modern security architectures, SOC workflows, and security data pipelines, and how AI is transforming such.

 - Experience working with security vendors, MDRs, or hyperscaler security ecosystems.

 - Comfort engaging with product managers, engineers, and security architects on technical topics.

 - Proven ability to project manage revenue-focused technical ecosystem partnerships

 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into partner value.

 - Ability to travel: ~20–30% (partner meetings, industry events, customer sessions)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Background in SOC, threat detection, incident response security vendor business development and partnerships.

 - Experience supporting agentic security, AI-driven tooling, or automation platforms.

 - Familiarity with sell-with / ecosystem-driven go-to-market models.




WE’RE PROUD TO OFFER A COMPETITIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE PACKAGE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR WELL-BEING, GROWTH, AND SUCCESS:

 - Compensation. Base salary range: $125,000 – $175,000, reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for commission tied to individual accomplishments.

 - Health & Wellness. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans—coverage starts on day one!

 - Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

 - Financial Well-Being. Plan for your future with a 401(k)-retirement savings plan featuring a company match.

 - Flexible Time Off. Take the time you need with unlimited vacation and dedicated health & wellness days. SimSpace provides flexible solutions to meet the diverse work-life needs of team members.

 - Continuous Learning. Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Messaging & Communities
jobs.description:
This role will be based in New York, San Francisco, Mountain View, or Bellevue.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our mission.  Gen Z is entering the workforce at scale and bringing new expectations for how professional relationships begin and grow. They are gravitating toward spaces where people with shared interests can exchange ideas, learn from one another, and build identity and trust over time. Unlike one-way content experiences, communities create an ongoing loop of participation and belonging: every conversation adds context, strengthens relationships, and gives people a reason to return. By bringing together trusted identity, the professional graph, messaging, and global reach, we can create spaces where people return, contribute, and build relationships that move their careers and lives forward.

What this role is:  We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to build a new member product at the intersection of messaging and communities. Think of the best parts of modern messaging and community products, rebuilt for the professional world and powered by what makes LinkedIn unique. This is a true zero-to-one role. You will define the vision, find the wedge, validate the core use cases, launch an MVP, and build toward product-market fit. There is no established playbook. We need someone who is excited to write it.

What you’ll do:

• You will operate like a founder: close to members, close to the product, and close to the details. You will move from insight to prototype to launch quickly, learn from what works and what does not, and bring engineering, design, data science, research, trust, and operations along with you.
• You will bring deep expertise in messaging and communities: how conversations start and persist, why people join and return, and how product mechanics shape participation and belonging. Success is not simply more messages sent. It is healthy, retained communities where members keep showing up and form relationships that matter.

Why are we here: The best opportunities often come through people: someone who shares your interests, understands what you care about, introduces a new idea, or opens a door you did not know existed. And today, your network is far more fluid than a list of connections. It includes the people you learn from, exchange ideas with, and build relationships with over time in the communities where you belong. Our job is to help every professional find their people; and turn shared interests into relationships that move their work and lives forward

Responsibilities

• Define the vision and strategy for a new LinkedIn experience spanning messaging and professional communities.
• Discover the strongest member needs, identify the right initial wedge, and turn those insights into a focused roadmap.
• Lead the product from concept through prototype, MVP launch, early adoption, and rapid iteration.
• Define the core product systems that help people discover, join, participate in, and return to healthy communities.
• Establish product-market fit signals centered on retention, repeat participation, community health, and meaningful professional relationships.
• Build trust, safety, moderation, and member control into the product and operating model from the beginning.
• Make clear trade-offs across member value, quality, speed, safety, and long-term scale.
• Align cross-functional teams and senior leaders around the opportunity, priorities, risks, progress, and key decisions.

Basic Qualifications

• BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
• 7+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in product management or an equivalent role.
• 5+ years of experience building and scaling high-quality messaging or community products for large and diverse audiences.
• Deep product judgment across conversation design, discovery, identity, participation, retention, notifications, trust and safety, moderation, and community health.
• A hands-on builder who can move easily between strategy and execution, make decisions with imperfect information, and lead through ambiguity.
• Strong technical, analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Suggested Skills

• AI Fluency
• Zero-to-One Product Development
• Consumer Product Strategy
• Trust, Safety, and Community Health

jobs.description:
The Patient Care Tech reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

Performs a variety of clinical/patient care related functions, under the direction of the clinical RN or physician that provide support to patients and staff including but not limited to the following:

• Collects, labels and transports specimens as assigned.
• Obtains 12 lead EKG’s
• Discontinues Saline Locks and Indwelling Urinary Catheters
• Discontinues Telemetry Monitoring packs
• Performs Bladder Scan
• Performs Point of Care Testing as appropriate
• Assists patients with personal hygiene and nutritional needs as identified on patient's plan of care.
• Performs hourly patient rounding in collaboration with the clinical RN.
• Obtains and documents patient care data as directed by the clinical RN and as noted in the plan of care.
• Assists with patient ambulation and positioning as directed in the plan of care.
• Assists the health care team members in meeting the individualized needs of the patient.
• Responds to patient call lights and request for assistance in a professional and timely manner.
• Assist the health care team in maintaining a clinical care environment that supports patient, family and staff safety.
• Assists with post mortem care.
• In collaboration with the Nursing Manager/Director, Clinical Nurse Specialists/Nurse Clinicians and NM Academy identifies and meets learning needs. Completes annual required training and updates knowledge through periodic in-services.
• Participates in performance improvement activities that advance innovative processes to achieve unit targets and exceptional performance.

Additional Responsibilities as Safety Attendant/Telesitter Monitor

• Maintains visual observation at all times with no distractions
• Provides prompt notification to care team if patient requires assistance
• Monitors and maintains patient environmental safety, and notifies care team if any hazards are discovered
• Performs care checks in accordance with care plan
• Follows appropriate policy

Additional Responsibilities under direction of department leadership include but not limited to:

• Answers, screens and directs incoming calls.
• Facilitates obtaining a hard copy of the patients advance directive if patient indicated he/she has one and places in Electronic Medical Record.
• Manages admissions through Electronic Bed Board.
• Assures patient care unit readiness for EMR downtime and facilitates data recovery following downtime.

Required:

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Completion of an accredited CNA program and listed on the state of Illinois CNA Registry OR Nursing student who have successful completed one clinical rotation. Must provide written verification of successful completion of said rotation.
• BLS through American Heart Association.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Assistant, Media Management (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
About the Position

The Golden State Warriors are looking for an Assistant to help implement our technical and media management strategy for Warriors Studio. In this role, you will develop a solid understanding of our media management workflow and partner with editors and producers to ensure content is delivered with consistent quality and timeliness. The ideal candidate will have a passion for new technological tools, strategies and the ability to learn the Studio asset management system. This position reports to the Senior Media Manager.

This is a great opportunity to share your expertise while learning more about this growing sports and entertainment organization that values your initiative and dedication!

This is a part-time position and is based in San Francisco, CA.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in Warriors Studio media management workflow using HPE Greenlake storage solution and CATDV database

• Assist in managing archival system using on-prem object storage, LTO, and Google Cloud systems

• Process requests for highlights, historic clips, and partner activations for the Warriors and other Golden State-owned properties

• Troubleshoot with producers, writers, editors on media management

• Provide a “first line of defense” support for Adobe Creative Suite

• Help maintain the technical operations of all edit and ingest stations within Warriors Studio

• Assist in the logging, cataloging and inputting of metadata

• Assist in processing all internal and external photo, video, and audio requests

• Ensure that deadlines are met and that videos meet the required codec standards

• Provide overall support for editing, shooting and production in Warriors Studio

• Other duties as assigned

Required Experience & Skills

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in video or film production, or equivalent work experience

• Minimum 1 year of media management experience in a production facility

• Experience cataloging media assets in one or more large scale databases

• Proficiency in organizing video files and transfers across local and remote servers and storage networks

• Familiarity with video fundamentals (i.e., frame rates, sync and timecode), audio and lighting for video, color correction, editing, video file formats and properties, video transcoding principles, and media asset life cycles in a production environment

• Attention to detail, and ability to maintain accuracy and precision across multiple records

• Ability to assess and adjust attention to assigned workflows as needed; suggest and provide alternatives as needed

• Ability to build positive working relationships with clients and peers across the organization

• Ability to balance multiple projects at once in a fast-paced work environment

Time Commitment

• Flexible work schedule and ability to work non-traditional hours including nights, weekends, and holidays throughout the season

Compensation

• $20.00 Per Hour

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Golden State is an equal opportunity employer.

We will ensure that qualified applicants with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Want to learn more about who we are and what we value? Visit www.warriors.com/employment

Please refer to our California Privacy Notice for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights.

jobs.title: Distribution Center Associate
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Distribution Center Associate to join our Rexel USA team in Garden Grove, CA!

Distribution Center Associate I, II, or Senior level:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities.

Summary:

The Distribution Center Associate is responsible for signing for deliveries, checking in and putting away product, picking material for outgoing orders, and packing orders for delivery. Will be responsible for safely operating various types of material handling equipment and tools.

This position's schedule is from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM Monday through Friday.

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment. Assume responsibility for immediately addressing safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other distribution centers
• Verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Prepare a receiving report if none is available
• Assemble and fill orders to be shipped to customers or branches
• Load common carrier and company vehicles
• Process paperwork regarding UPS shipments including: verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct UPS postage tape, following customer shipping instructions and insuring the shipment when necessary
• Pack each order into a container and arrange the container onto a shelf according to truck route
• Gather assembled orders that are in carts and verify their quantities and descriptions against the invoice
• General maintenance of the distribution center; sweeping and disposing of trash/cardboard
• Perform other duties as assigned

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. jobs.title: Accounts Payable Coder
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring an Accounts Payable Coder to join our finance team, focused on managing expenditure classification and keeping company financial reporting accurate. In this role, you’ll process high-volume invoices, verify 3-way matching and keep our budgets lined up so our team can make smart operational decisions.

As an AP Coder, you’ll:

• Own GL coding. You'll review high-volume invoices and accurately assign spend categories, department codes and project codes based on company charts of accounts.

• Validate data and maintain compliance. You'll run 3-way matching across purchase orders, receiving reports and invoices, making sure we only pay for what we ordered while confirming all proper internal approvals are in place.

• Support vendor relationships and month-end close. You'll assist with vendor onboarding, banking verification, statement reconciliations and month-end close to keep coded invoices posted before deadline.

Location

Time spent collaborating with other Hudlies in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently prioritizing applicants within commuting distance of Lincoln, Nebraska. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

• Experienced. You have one to three years of experience in accounts payable or a general accounting role.

• Detail-oriented. You have an eye for precision, whether spotting a single-digit typo in a 20-digit GL string or flagging a duplicate invoice.

• Analytical. You understand core financial concepts, including the difference between CapEx and OpEx.

• A strong communicator. You can partner directly with FP&A leads and department heads to resolve missing approvals or clear up ambiguous expenses.

Nice-to-Haves

• Tech stack experience. You have hands-on experience using major ERP systems like Workday, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or Microsoft Dynamics, alongside intermediate Excel skills.

• Educational background. You hold an associate or bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration.

Our Role

• Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.

• Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.

• Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.

• Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.

• Support your mental and physical health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.

• Cover your medical insurance. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.

• Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$33,000—$56,000 USD

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

Privacy Policy

jobs.title: RTL Intern
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary

As an RTL Intern at Etched, you will help design microarchitecture and implement logic in verilog. You will work with cutting-edge machine learning architectures, contribute to RTL block development, and participate in the full design cycle—from microarchitecture discussions to synthesis and timing feedback. You do not necessarily need prior ML/AI hardware experience; just the ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. We are looking for Fall '26, Spring '27, and Summer '27 interns.



You may be a good fit if you have

 - Progress towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.

 - Familiarity with high-speed digital logic

 - Exposure to ASIC or SoC design concepts

 - Familiarity with SystemVerilog, UVM, or Python

 - Familiarity with verification work and writing test benches

 - Familiarity with physical design flows and tooling

 - Are able to learn quickly about transformers and other aspects of modern artificial intelligence



Strong candidates may also have experience with

 - Familiarity with modern ML and LLM model architectures

 - Familiarity with numerical representations and functions

 - Familiarity with clocking and reset schemes

 - Ability to program with Python or another scripting language

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.



Program details

 - 12-week paid internship

 - Generous housing support for those relocating

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Based at our office in San Jose, CA

 - Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers

 - Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time



For any questions, contact internships@etched.com



How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

 

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently hiring a Corporate Security Agent to join our team embedded with our client in Washington, D.C.! This position requires working onsite with our client.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This position requires an exceptionally talented, personable, and self-motivated individual to work in a highly visible, interactive role providing holistic security for the client. The Corporate Security Agent will support incident management and act to support threat management and emergency response.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Safeguard the client site and personnel from all forms of security and safety hazards

Spinnaker Support is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to design, develop, enhance, and support Customer Service Management (CSM) and case management solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This role is focused on owning and extending an existing ServiceNow CSM/TPSM implementation, reducing reliance on external implementation partners, and ensuring the platform remains scalable, supportable, and auditable.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in ServiceNow development, workflow automation, integration design, release management, and platform stewardship, particularly in environments where the developer must inherit and improve an instance originally configured by a third party. This role starts while the platform is still being implemented with an external partner. The successful candidate will work alongside that partner through user acceptance testing, production deployment, and customer cutover before the engagement closes, which is the fastest path to full ownership of the platform.

The Senior ServiceNow Developer is responsible for solution build, technical quality, environment promotion, and release ownership. This model mirrors the company’s broader platform operating structure by clearly separating business ownership from technical delivery.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience

• Experience supporting enterprise-scale ServiceNow implementations in a fast-growing global business

• Strong hands-on experience designing, configuring, developing, and supporting ServiceNow CSM applications and workflows

• Experience inheriting and stabilizing a ServiceNow environment originally implemented by a third party

• Demonstrated ability to review, understand, and improve existing configurations without introducing regression risk

• Experience performing peer review of partner-delivered configuration, update sets, and release artifacts

• Strong experience developing scalable workflows

• Experience enhancing Case Management, Customer Service Portals, Knowledge Management, Agent Workspace, Enterprise integrations

• Able to support working hours with overlap across EMEA or APAC business hours

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

• Certified Implementation Specialist, Customer Service Management (CIS-CSM) strongly preferred

• Exposure to ServiceNow AI capabilities such as Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, or intelligent workflow automation is a plus

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, enhance, and deploy ServiceNow solutions and custom applications using established SDLC standards and out-of-the-box functionality where appropriate

• Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions in partnership with the Business Analyst, platform stakeholders, and business teams

• Configure and enhance ServiceNow CSM/TPSM modules, workflows, forms, rules, and user experiences

• Review, validate, and improve partner-delivered configuration for quality, maintainability, and adherence to internal standards

• Troubleshoot and resolve platform defects, workflow issues, and performance bottlenecks

• Maintain platform integrity across production and non-production environments Support UAT, release readiness, and Change Review Board processes

• Work closely with the Business Analyst and business stakeholders to triage and resolve defects, support testing and user validation

Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the candidate, and alignment with labor market data and geographic location.

Company Overview

Perry Ellis International, Inc. represents a diverse portfolio of lifestyle apparel brands. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries owns and licenses nationally and with a brand portfolio of over 40 Brands domestically and internationally recognized brands including: Perry Ellis®, Original Penguin® by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The Company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike®  for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR®, and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Systems Administrator to manage the lifecycle of our global virtualized server infrastructure. In this role, you will be the primary architect and manager of our Proxmox environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security. You will partner with MIS teams to streamline their environment deployments and create robust disaster recovery plans. You’ll also keep your finger on the pulse of virtualization industry trends, evaluating emerging technologies for their potential impact on our ecosystem. If you’re passionate about open-source virtualization and driving scalable solutions, we want to hear from you.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (Your duties should reflect the most significant aspects of your job. Do not state anything that requires less than 5% of your time.)

• Architect & Maintain: Design, build, and manage Proxmox Virtual Environments (Proxmox VE) and Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) deployments globally.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate closely with Storage (SAN) and Networking teams to plan, test, and execute infrastructure changes seamlessly.

• Capacity Planning & Optimization: Proactively monitor Proxmox hardware capacity. Analyze usage trends and recommend strategic improvements to balance cost-efficiency with business needs.

• Security & Compliance: Ensure all systems adhere to company policies regarding documentation and security, industry best practices, and vendor security patch requirements. Develop and test robust disaster recovery plans.

• Hardware Management: Oversee the lifecycle of server hardware, including monitoring health and coordinating replacements.

• Deployment & Configuration: Provision and configure Virtual Machines (VMs) across various operating systems.

• Project Management: Effectively prioritize and manage multiple assigned IT projects through to completion.

• Mentorship: Guide, train, and elevate junior administrators, fostering a collaborative learning environment.

• Effective Communication: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable information for stakeholders with diverse backgrounds and varying levels of technical expertise

CORE REQUIREMENTS:

• 3+ years of demonstrable experience managing Proxmox DataCenter environments (Proxmox VE and PBS) in an enterprise setting or equivalent hypervisor environment (KVM, VMware, etc)

• Proven experience integrating and maintaining hypervisors within an iSCSI SAN environment.

• Solid Linux/Debian background.

• Solid understanding of network redundancy, high availability, and load balancing principles.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

OPTIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience with Ceph distributed storage architecture (especially within Proxmox VE).

• Proficiency in Bash/Python scripting and Proxmox CLI/API tools for task automation and cluster management.

• Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (K8s) clusters.

• Hands-on experience deploying and managing containerized applications using Podman.

• Expertise in Dell Server hardware management.

• Administrative experience with Windows Server operating systems.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This position requires the normal demands of any job, such as sitting, standing, reaching with arms and hands, walking, talking and hearing.  You should be capable of lifting up to 50 lbs (for occasional hardware handling).

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment is generally a moderate noise level; however, ear protection is provided and required when working in server rooms. Given the nature of IT infrastructure, this role requires occasional after-hours or weekend work, particularly during scheduled maintenance windows, peak periods, or emergencies.

What’s In It For You?

• Comprehensive Health: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision plans designed to keep you and your family healthy and thriving.

• Financial Security: Secure your future with our 401(k) retirement plan (including a discretionary company match) plus company-provided Basic Life and AD&D Insurance.

• Work-Life Balance: Take the time you need to recharge with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and a full schedule of paid Holidays.

• Growth & Support: We invest in your potential through our Tuition Reimbursement program for continuous learning and provide 24/7 personal support via our Member Assistance Program (MAP).

• Team Culture: Join a community that celebrates your hard work with regular Associate Engagement Events, ranging from seasonal celebrations to on-site wellness activities.

• Exclusive Style Perks: Look your best for less with generous Associate Clothing Discounts across all our company stores and e-commerce sites.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Support team is central to ensuring that our customers' experience with our products is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engagement Specialist on the User Operations team you will be a hands-on systems builder responsible for making product launches and frontline feedback more scaleable, measurable and actionable across both internal User Operations and external third-party teams. You’ll be responsible for not only managing the project timelines, but also designing and shipping the workflows, tooling and data systems that connect the voice of the user into actionable improvements for Product and Engineering teams.

We’re looking for people who thrive at the intersection of project management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and enjoy working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

We are also looking for individuals that will not just do the day to day work - but will also be deeply involved in architecting the systems of feedback sharing and collection with our stakeholder groups across Support, Product, and Engineering. Think data systems, not better slide decks.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design, build, and own scalable systems for launch readiness, feedback capture, triage, synthesis, and routing.

 - Coordinate product launches across internal User Operations teams and external third party teams to ensure seamless execution and support readiness.

 - Develop and implement scalable feedback loops between support teams and product/engineering teams, ensuring customer insights are integrated into product development and strategy.

 - Serve as the voice of the user, advocating for their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations) to align on product launch goals and timelines.

 - Lead efforts to document and standardize launch procedures, ensuring they are easily repeatable and scalable as the product line grows.

 - Monitor post-launch performance, gathering data from support teams to evaluate product impact and inform future improvements.

 - Identify potential risks and challenges during product rollouts, proposing solutions to mitigate disruptions to customer service.

 - Regularly report on the performance of the feedback loop, including key insights, trends, and actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have 8+ years of experience in product launch coordination, especially within a customer support environment (internal and/or external).

 - Bring product management, technical program management, or similarly hands-on experience taking ambiguous problems from discovery through delivery and adoption.

 - Enjoy working cross-functionally and are skilled at building relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

 - Are technically fluent in areas such as APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics, automation, or lightweight scripting, even if you are not a software engineer.

 - Are passionate about customer advocacy and have experience translating customer feedback into strategic product insights.

 - Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.

 - Have excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and customer pain points to diverse audiences.

 - Are proactive and take ownership of initiatives, from ideation through to implementation and post-launch analysis.

 - Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.

 - Have a data-driven mindset, using metrics and feedback to guide decision-making and optimize processes.

SeekWell is the parent company of 1-800 Contacts, Luna, and The Framery. Our goal is to make it simpler, easier, and more accessible for people to get the vision care they need. We maintain the legendary, award-winning culture 1-800 Contacts started almost 30 years ago and continue to develop innovative, pioneering products and businesses that make consumers cheer. We’re owned by KKR – one of the world’s largest and most successful private equity investment companies. We’ve built an excellent company and changed an industry by putting the customer first, always. The best is yet to come!

Why you want this job

In this role, you’ll work closely with SeekWell’s operations teams to turn data into insights that help the business make smarter decisions and improve how we work. You’ll collaborate with teams across the organization, dig into data, and have the opportunity to see your work make a real impact. If you’re a go-getter who enjoys solving problems with data, this is a great opportunity to grow your skills and build your career with a collaborative team.

• Continuously monitor data quality and provide recommendations for improvement and contribute to the development and maintenance of data infrastructure and tools.

What you'll need

• Proficiency with Databricks and SQL

Why we will love you

• Experience with data analysis tools such Python, R, and Excel

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities

• Comfortable interacting with stakeholders from all levels of the organization

• Familiarity with data management best practices and regulatory requirements for sensitive data (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA)

jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Facilities & Clinic Operations Coordinator, who will serve as the on-the-ground operational owner for Blackbird Health's clinic environments across assigned regional markets in Philadelphia Metro expansion regions, including PA and NJ. You will manage day-to-day facility maintenance, vendor relationships, and site logistics for existing offices while also playing a critical hands-on role in setting up and launching new clinic locations.

What makes you, you:

• On-the-Ground Operator: Thrives in a mobile role, balancing regular field travel across regional clinics with independent problem-solving.

• Detail-Oriented & Organized: Passionate about keeping physical spaces clean, safe, welcoming, and fully operational for patients and staff.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.
__________________________

Built is transforming how capital moves through construction and real estate finance — one of the largest, most complex sectors in the economy. Our platform connects lenders, including many of the top U.S. banks, with the owners, developers, and general contractors they finance. When a draw is approved, a builder can pay subcontractors. When a compliance document clears, a project moves forward. The work we do here is not abstract — it has a direct and material impact on how capital flows and how real estate gets built.

Our Implementations team is responsible for turning Built's platform into operational reality for lenders, developers, and contractors across the country. As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own Built's most complex and strategic implementation relationships, setting the standard for delivery excellence across the organization. You work independently with periodic guidance, are recognized as the go-to resource for the hardest implementation challenges, and informally raise the capability of those around you through the standards you set and the expertise you share.

Our Guiding Principles

• Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don't hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

• Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

• Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.

• Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked.

• Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You'll Do

• Own the largest and most complex client implementations independently — driving success across technical, organizational, and commercial dimensions from kickoff through stabilization.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to clients on organizational change, training strategy, and platform adoption; guide clients through transformational implementations with authority and care.

• Design and implement standardized methodologies, templates, and playbooks that improve delivery speed and consistency across all implementations in the function.

• Lead cross-functional workstreams with Product, Engineering, and Solutions Consulting to solve novel implementation challenges and expand Built's service capabilities.

• Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or high-impact projects — diagnosing root causes, driving resolution, and ensuring the client relationship remains intact.

• Identify and own key performance metrics for implementation health; use data to drive decisions that optimize efficiency and client satisfaction across the portfolio.

• Informally mentor implementation managers — share expertise, provide guidance on complex client situations, and help raise the standard for delivery across the team.

• Champion AI and tooling adoption within the implementations function; model how technology accelerates delivery quality and client outcomes.

What You'll Bring

• 4–7 years of experience in SaaS implementation, professional services, or enterprise project delivery, with demonstrated ownership of the most complex client engagements in your portfolio.

• Deep expertise in enterprise implementation strategy, change management, and organizational transformation — you've guided clients through hard changes and made them stick.

• A strong track record of designing processes or frameworks that measurably improved delivery speed, consistency, or client satisfaction across a team.

• The ability to influence senior client stakeholders and navigate complex, politically sensitive organizational dynamics with confidence and professionalism.

• Deep familiarity with construction finance and lending workflows — draw management, lien waivers, compliance tracking, loan administration, regulatory requirements — and the ability to credibly advise clients on how Built fits their business.

• Experience with enterprise software implementation methodologies and comfort adapting your approach to the complexity and culture of each client environment.

• A subject matter expert orientation — you share what you know, hold high standards, and leave the function's methodology better than you found it.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

• Your implementations are consistently recognized as the most successful in the portfolio — clients achieve adoption outcomes faster, escalations are rare, and satisfaction scores reflect your standard.

• At least one playbook, methodology, or framework you developed has been adopted broadly across the implementations function and is producing measurable improvements.

• The escalations that land on your desk get resolved cleanly — root causes are identified, client relationships are preserved, and the team learns something from each one.

• Implementation managers across the team seek your input on complex client situations before they escalate — your judgment and domain expertise are widely trusted.

• Cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and Sales view you as a strategic thought partner on implementation strategy, not just a delivery resource.

AI & Technology Expectations

• Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.

• Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.

• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.

• Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.

• Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built’s salary range for this position is $125,000 - 163,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.

__________________________

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

• The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry

• Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance

• Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options

• Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development

• 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

jobs.description:

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About the Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

• Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.

• Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.

• Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.

• Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.

• Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.

• Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.

• Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.

• Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.

• Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.

• Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.

• Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.

• Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.

• Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.

• Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.

• Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.

• Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.

• Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.

• Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.

• Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.

• Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).

• Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.

• Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.

• Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.

• Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.

• Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.

• Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

See Yourself at Telix

Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. The role coordinates Governance Specialists across Australia and the United States to deliver high-quality governance execution.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION: HOSPITAL-QUALITY CARE, EVERYWHERE.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!




OUR VALUES: THE PRINCIPLES THAT GUIDE US

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

 - We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.

 - We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.

 - We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.

 - We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.
   
   


OUR TEAM: WHO YOU'LL BE BUILDING WITH

You'll join a product team of two other designers working as partners with engineering and product. Design has a seat at the table from the first conversation about a problem, not a hand-off at the end. We keep bureaucracy low: no layers of approval between you and shipping, and the distance between a good idea and a live product is measured in days.


YOUR IMPACT: HOW YOU'LL HELP US HEAL A BROKEN SYSTEM

This isn't just a job; it's a chance to build something that matters. As a Product Designer at Verse, you'll shape how clinicians, care coordinators, and patients experience at-home care.

Healthcare is the most under-designed industry in America, and the one that needs great design the most. The software clinicians use every day looks and feels a decade behind the tools they use in the rest of their lives, and patients feel that gap at the worst possible moments.

Our users are specialized professionals doing high-stakes work under time pressure. The tools they use today are dense, clunky, and unforgiving, and we believe great design is a competitive advantage in this space. That's why we hold an unusually high bar for craft. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product-minded engineers and product managers who share a bias for action and a deep sense of mission to help people heal at home.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS

Within your first year, you will have the opportunity to:

 - Own the end-to-end design of high-priority product areas, from early discovery and workflow mapping through high-fidelity design and shipped product.

 - Design intricate, logic-heavy interfaces (like our clinical order flows) that turn dense, multi-step workflows into beautiful experiences users describe as effortless.

 - Raise the craft bar across the product: sweat the details of typography, spacing, motion, and interaction states, and set the standard for what "done" looks like.

 - Build and evolve our design system so quality scales with the team rather than depending on heroics.

 - Prototype quickly and at high fidelity to pressure-test ideas face to face with real users.

 - Develop deep empathy for clinicians, coordinators, and patients through direct research, and translate what you learn into opinionated design decisions.

 - Partner closely with engineers through implementation, ensuring what ships matches what was designed.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING: THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE YOU'LL LEVERAGE

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.

Core Skills & Experience:

 - 3 - 7 years of product design experience shipping complex, workflow-heavy software in production, ideally B2B, healthcare, or other specialized professional tools.

jobs.title: Mobile Business Intelligence Analyst, Mattel Games Studio
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel Games Studios is seeking an experienced Data Analyst, LiveOps to take a key role in driving meaningful insights and providing recommendations to impact our business growth for a portfolio of upcoming games. The role will be supporting our game team and ensuring we are taking a data-driven approach towards success. This role will be responsible for taking projects end-to-end, from extracting data, building dashboards and communicating learnings to the broader team. The ideal candidate has a passion for mobile and free-to-play games, with a strong understanding of core F2P mechanics, monetization systems, and LiveOps strategies.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Provide best-in-class support and collaborate with the LiveOps team to optimize game performance such as game features, player behavior and economy balancing
• Analyze game performance across all stages of the development lifecycle and post launch, turning game data into actionable insights that drive improvements to retention, engagement and monetization
• Design, run and analyze A/B tests to validate hypotheses for new features, in-game events, or promotions in collaboration with the LiveOps and Design teams
• Build and maintain clear, actionable data visualizations and dashboards to track game KPIs
• Help establish best practices and build publishing standards for telemetry and data analysis
• Drive the execution of all analytics initiatives with precision and attention to detail
• Collaborate with internal and external teams to help implement game telemetry to track game performance
• Write ad-hoc SQL queries to extract and prepare data for dashboard visualization

• 4+ Years of experience, preferably in F2P Mobile Gaming or data-driven field
• Proficiency in data visualization using tools like Mixpanel, Tableau to create dashboards powering KPI evaluation at both the detail team level and summary executive level
• Expert SQL proficiency in BigQuery, MySQL and ability to manage complex data sets efficiently
• Solid experience with programming in Python
• Strong foundation in applied statistics, such as A/B testing to validate and inform recommendations
• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and derive actionable conclusions
• Experience with experimentation design, execution, analysis in a LiveOps environment
• Understanding of data and how it translates to unique player experiences
• Comprehension of core KPI impact on product performance, especially when it comes to engagement, retention and monetization
