jobs.title: Principal Analyst, GTM Analytics
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a  Principal Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. In this role, you'll be a force multiplier for the senior manager and a technical anchor for the broader team, taking on the most complex and time-sensitive questions across the business. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll shape the requirements and propose the logic for our central data team to build.

In this role, you'll handle the team's most ambiguous and time-sensitive requests — often scoping a question live, in a meeting with senior stakeholders, and turning it into a usable answer quickly. You'll build models that blend statistical rigor and financial fluency (forecasting, pipeline coverage, quota simulation), review and unblock work from other team members, and represent the team's analytical judgment in rooms the senior manager isn't always in.

This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL, dbt, Looker, Omni, Sigma, Excel and/or Google Sheets (financial modeling), Hex or similar notebook tools (exploratory analysis), Python (statistical libraries), Salesforce, Claude (or similar AI assistants)

What You’ll Do

• Translate ambiguous, often verbal requests from senior stakeholders into a scoped analytical plan in real time

• Build and maintain complex models that combine statistical and financial methods (e.g., pipeline coverage, quota simulation, forecast accuracy)

• Deliver fast, directionally-correct analysis under time pressure, then refine to full rigor when the deliverable warrants it

• Represent the team's analytical judgment in meetings with VP+ stakeholders without requiring the manager's involvement

• Reframe stakeholder questions when the request as asked doesn't match the underlying business problem

• Review and unblock analytical work from Level 2 and Level 3 team members

• Triage incoming requests and help route them appropriately across the team

• Own end-to-end delivery of strategic, cross-functional analyses (e.g., account matching strategy, end-of-quarter deal pattern analysis)

• Apply statistical methods (e.g., regression, confidence intervals, cohort analysis) to strengthen the rigor of insights

• Collaborate with Finance's own analysts when a request touches revenue or forecasting logic, to make sure GTM models stay consistent with how Finance defines and tracks those numbers

Skills We’re Looking For

• Advanced, self-serve proficiency in SQL, dbt, and BI tools (Looker, Omni, Sigma) — able to independently get, analyze, and visualize data with minimal support

• Strong understanding of SaaS sales motions (opportunity stages, pipeline progression, SFDC structure) and working knowledge of financial/forecasting concepts (ARR, quota attainment, pipeline coverage, bookings) — enough to collaborate confidently with Finance's own analysts, not to replace them

• Statistical knowledge (e.g., regression analysis, distributions, confidence intervals) applied to business problems

• Analytical mindset with the judgment to reframe a stakeholder's question when it doesn't match the underlying business problem

• Ability to quickly scope and prioritize ambiguous requests under time pressure, often live in meetings, and strong judgment on when to move fast vs. when to prioritize rigor

• Experience reviewing or mentoring others' analytical work

• Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in front of senior or executive stakeholders

Bonus Skills​

• Experience owning forecasting or planning methodology, not just reporting on it

• Prior experience in FP&A or a quantitative finance role

• Experience building simulation models

• Some informal people leadership or team lead experience

• Advanced Python (pandas, numpy, statsmodels)

#LI-REMOTE #LI-MM1

Perks and Benefits

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*

• Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off

• RSU stock grants*

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

• Monthly cell phone stipend

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pricing and Access Analytics
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx is seeking an Associate Director, Pricing Strategy & Access Analytics to serve as a hands-on strategic partner within Market Access. Reporting to the Senior Director, Market Access Strategy, this individual will be responsible for helping lead pricing strategy, analytics, gross-to-net modeling, contracting evaluation, and related decision support. The role will also support broader market access priorities, including identifying actionable payer and PBM insights, monitoring coverage and channel strategy trends, and generating patient access analytics to inform decision-making.   The role will translate complex access, pricing, and customer data into clear, actionable recommendations that support access to avexitide (subject to FDA approval) for patients with post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), an area of significant unmet need.

Responsibilities

Pricing strategy and analytics:

• Lead pricing analysis, scenario planning, gross-to-net modeling, rebate and contracting economics, competitive pricing assessments to inform avexitide launch price and lifecycle decisions.

• Build and maintain financial models that evaluate pricing options, payer and PBM contracting opportunities, customer trade-offs, access implications, and business-case assumptions.

• Partner with Sr. Director, Access Strategy and co-lead pricing committee with Market Access, Finance, Forecasting, Legal, Compliance, Commercial, and Analytics teams to align pricing assumptions, pressure-test recommendations, and support compliant decision-making. Helps maintain and operationalize pricing committee.

• Monitor and analyze policy and pricing trends with potential to impact launch of avexitide

• Partner with finance to help assess risk and develop mitigation solution for potential government pricing calculations and reporting

• Ensure compliance and State Drug Pricing Transparency reporting.

Broader access analytics:

• Analyze payer coverage, utilization management, formulary positioning, reimbursement dynamics, claims trends, abandonment, reversals, pull-through performance, and patient access barriers.

• In collaboration with commercial operations and market access stakeholder, develop dashboards, scorecards, customer insights, and executive-ready materials that synthesize payer, PBM, health system, specialty pharmacy, channel, and patient services trends into actionable recommendations.

• Monitor external market trends, policy changes, competitive dynamics, Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement considerations, and channel evolution that may affect pricing, access, and reimbursement strategy.

• Support vendor selection and management for market access data, pricing analytics, and research projects, ensuring high-quality outputs and timely delivery.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree such as MBA, MPH, MS, PharmD, or related discipline preferred.

• 6+ years of experience in market access, pricing, contracting, analytics, finance, forecasting, patient services, or related pharmaceutical/biotech roles;

• Strong understanding of U.S. pricing, gross-to-net, payer, PBM, health system, specialty pharmacy, reimbursement, and patient access dynamics.

• Demonstrated ability to build analytical models, interpret complex data, and communicate practical recommendations to cross-functional and senior stakeholders.

• Experience in rare disease, specialty pharmacy, launch planning, pricing strategy, contracting analytics, or patient services analytics preferred.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, pivot table, financial modeling, PBM/payer negotiations & scenario analysis skills

• High business and P&L acumen, with a strong foundation of GTN accounting dynamics across access customer types (commercial, government, patient services, specialty pharmacy, trade & distribution)

• High integrity, strong collaboration skills, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska, Arizona, Hawaii, Michigan and Tennessee.

• You will be expected to travel to our corporate location in Cambridge, MA several times a year and attend other company-related events as necessary and requested.

• You must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

$182,000—$205,000 USD

jobs.description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion SCM – Order Management Product Owner who will assist in design, configuration, and implementation of the core Order to Cash modules – B2B Order Capture, EDI Trading Partner Integration, Global Order Promising, Pricing & Discounting, Order Orchestration, and Billing.

• Conduct workshops with key stakeholders to identify business requirements and map to Oracle Cloud Fusion standard processes, customizations, and organizational structures, creating a “To-Be” model.
• Define RICEF objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) and partner with Business Analysts to create associated functional and technical user stories for development.
• Identify gaps between standard Oracle Fusion functionalities and business needs. Partner with Enterprise Architects to define custom development within Oracle Fusion or establish alternate solutions and processes to meet business needs.
• Configure the Order Management module to meet business requirements and document all configurations.
• Act as a liaison between technical teams (both onshore and offshore), business teams, Oracle Fusion teams (Product Hub, Procurement, Inventory, and Finance) and SI vendor to drive a successful implementation.
• Identify and configure required security roles and associated access to the application.
• Define testing scenarios and develop test scripts.
• Support quality assurance and UAT testing teams in execution of test scripts.
• Create detailed process flow diagrams and training documentation.
• Deliver training to trainers who will subsequently train their teams (Train the Trainer model).
• Provide weekly status updates to Project Managers.

What We’re Looking For:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience: 7+ years of hands-on implementation experience with Oracle Cloud Fusion – Order Management modules
• Working knowledge of supporting SCM Oracle Fusion modules such as Product Data Hub, Inventory, and Procurement.
• Experience in all phases of SDLC lifecycle from requirement gathering, analysis, design, configuration, development, testing, and deployment.
• Communication Skills: Ability to work with stakeholders, including developers and business end-users, to define functional and technical requirements.
• Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze business processes and translate them into system configurations.
• Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead and inspire teams, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
• Cultural Awareness: Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and manage teams across different time zones.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently looking to hire a Corporate Security Lead to join our team embedded with our client! This position requires working onsite in Arlington, VA.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This position requires an exceptionally talented, personable, and self-motivated individual to work in a highly visible and interactive position, providing holistic security for the client. The Corporate Security Agent will support incident management and act to support threat management and emergency response.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Supervise and schedule on-site security staff

• Assist in the site's security SOPs and updating the Handbook as needed

• Serve as liaison to client's Protective Services, facilities, legal, and HR leadership on security matters

• Lead incident response and threat assessment, escalating to law enforcement when required

• Assists with emergency preparedness and business continuity planning (evacuation, active threat, severe weather protocols)

• Assist with vendor relationships (guard services, security technology, alarm monitoring) and staffing/budget recommendations

• Establish a front-facing security presence during business hours

• Assist in the development and implementation of SOPs

• POI management for unsolicited contact (visits, mail, phone calls, etc.)

• Assist in the development of a streamlined incident reporting and activity log, and remain diligent in maintaining an accurate record

• Integrate security support for HR functions (i.e., terminations, screenings, removal of access, etc.)

• Interact with the client’s Protective Services team on occasion to assist with specialty onsite executive needs, such as special events

• Demonstrate integrity and excellent customer service skills in all assignments in a professional office setting

• Complete daily requests from management

• Directly support clients' Security Operations at the headquarters site

• Interact with clients and the Protective Services team as needed to provide executive support, including for on-site events.

• Provide in-person support for security-assisted terminations

• Provide in-person de-escalation support as needed.

• Providing local EP and secure driving (either shadowing the CEO or transporting them in a corporate vehicle).

• Accompanying the CEO to local functions in an official EP and secure driving capacity.

• Handling travel EP duties when asked, including recent international travel to Japan with the CEO.

• Perform other duties as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be able to legally work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

• Currently possess and/or ability to obtain a Washington, D.C. Special Police Officer (SPO) certification

• Minimum of 2 years of experience, preferably in an armed corporate security position or previous law enforcement employment with an HR218/LEOSA credential

• Experience in building strong working relationships with multiple internal teams and departments to ensure seamless communication, effective problem-solving, and the achievement of organizational goals.

• All required licenses and certification requirements.

• Demonstrated knowledge and proficiency in computer software commonly used in business functions (such as Microsoft Office Suite, incident reporting systems, and other relevant security or administrative platforms).

• High ethical standards with proven ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information; excellent judgment, discretion, and diplomacy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including a comfort level in interfacing with senior company leadership

• Skilled in synthesizing facts, concepts, and principles

• Emotional intelligence and a customer-focused approach status.

• Skilled in De-escalation techniques or similar verbal judo training.

• Executive Protection and/or Tactical training preferred

• Advanced medical training (EMT, WEMT, WFR, TCCC/TECC)

• Proficiency in conducting regular risk assessments, identifying hazards (physical, chemical, environmental, or ergonomic), and implementing control measures.

jobs.title: Legal Intern Summer 2027
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

Democracy Forward Foundation (“Democracy Forward”) is accepting applications from first and second year law students for paid, full-time summer internships to carry out its mission to use the law to build collective power and advance a bold, vibrant democracy for all people via litigation and regulatory engagement.

Democracy Forward Foundation’s office is based in Washington, DC. Interns are expected to be in the office an average of 2-3 days per week. The internship program is anticipated to run from May 27, 2027 - July 30, 2027.

The application deadline for this role is Tuesday October 13 at 11:59pm ET.

Key Responsibilities:

Below are the key areas of responsibility for this role. The specifics of each responsibility may vary based on the needs of the organization and department.

• Assist Democracy Forward Foundation attorneys in their work representing clients in proceedings in federal and state courts and before federal and state agencies, including helping lawyers develop strategy and identify risks and opportunities.

• Perform legal research and draft legal documents, including substantive briefs for parties and amici, motions, comments, and/or other court or regulatory filings.

• Assist Democracy Forward attorneys in preparing for arguments, hearings, and/or other court appearances.

• Monitor and screen cases and participate in discussions where Democracy Forward considers engaging in litigation (either affirmative litigation or as an amicus or intervenor) or regulatory advocacy).

• Contribute to strategic discussions regarding Democracy Forward’s work and matters.

• Participate in meetings with clients, which may include nonprofit organizations, unions, local government entities, and other entities.

Qualifications:

We recognize that strong candidates may not meet 100% of the qualifications listed. If you believe you can contribute meaningfully to our team, we encourage you to apply.

• First or second year law student currently enrolled in an accredited law school.

• Interest in public interest litigation in a variety of subject areas.

• Demonstrated commitment to democracy and social progress.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and drive forward work under tight deadlines.

• Well-developed collaborative and interpersonal skills including demonstrated self-awareness, commitment to diversity and inclusivity, and ability to work with colleagues and stakeholders across diverse cultures and backgrounds.

• Experience or eagerness to work in a nonprofit, mission-driven, or advocacy organization.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

• This role may require occasional travel for team retreats, conferences, or organizational meetings.

• This role may involve sitting for extended periods and working on a computer. Accommodations will be provided as needed.

The compensation for summer legal interns is $28.85 per hour. Preference will be given to applicants who apply by October 13, and will then be considered on a rolling basis, consistent with NALP guidelines.

Democracy Forward Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals. We strongly encourage people of color; LGBTQIA+ people; women; people with disabilities; and veterans to apply. Please note that all lawyer positions require a law degree and active membership in the bar of a state or the District of Columbia.

Not sure you meet all of our qualifications? Research shows that men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Yet women and other people who are systematically marginalized tend to only apply if they meet every requirement.  If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. We are dedicated to considering a broad array of candidates, including those with diverse workplace experiences and backgrounds. Whether you are new to mission-based legal and policy work, returning to work after a gap in employment, or simply looking to transition or take the next step in your career path, we welcome the opportunity to have you on our radar.  Please include in your cover letter the nature of your interest in legal and policy work promoting democracy and progress and what you hope to bring to our team and the role for which you are applying.

Democracy Forward is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all, including those with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, interview, or otherwise participate in the hiring process, please email accommodations@democracyforward.org or 833-391-4732.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Video Platform Strategy & Audience Growth

● Define Mattel's global video strategy across YouTube, FAST/CTV, creator-led video, social video and emerging platforms, translating audience behavior, cultural trends and performance data into growth opportunities.

● Lead YouTube strategy and governance globally, including channel architecture, portfolio strategy, programming frameworks, audience development and distribution.

● Develop differentiated strategies for made-for-kids audiences and general audience/adult fan and collector audiences based on their distinct behaviors, content expectations and commercial opportunities.

● Build strategic relationships with YouTube/Google and other priority video and distribution partners and identify emerging platforms, formats and technologies relevant to Mattel's audiences.

Content Strategy, Development & Production

● Develop platform-native video strategies and repeatable content formats that connect franchise priorities with audience needs and platform behavior.

● Shape Mattel's general audience and adult fan and collector content strategy, including original series, repeatable formats, creator-led programming and new storytelling models.

● Ensure major franchise moments, live experiences, partnerships and entertainment launches are designed as content engines that extend storytelling before, during and after the moment.

● Develop the role of creator-distributed video within Mattel's broader strategy, identifying opportunities to reach audiences through integrations, recurring creator formats and creator-owned channels when owned-channel investment is not the most effective approach. ● Strong understanding of the broader digital video ecosystem, including FAST/CTV, creator platforms, social video and emerging distribution models.

● Strong production and financial fluency, including experience evaluating creative treatments, scopes, budgets, schedules and production models.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a full-time, 3-6 month internship/co-op, with an anticipated start date in May 2027

Nature of work:

Your responsibilities will include (but are not limited to);

• This is a great opportunity to get hands on experience in a manufacturing environment and learn about the inner workings of how standard costs are developed and maintained.

The primary focus will be reviewing current standard costs with a focus on the following:

• Identify outliers in relation to margin or potential data integrity issues
• Work closely with manufacturing engineers to ensure BOM & Routing are aligned with current production procedures
• Assist with developing a go forward plan to ensure BOM & Routing are maintained on a go forward basis

Why is this important: Standard Cost is the foundation for ensuring a plant is running efficiently and that we are going to market with the most accurate costs to produce finished products. This helps to ensure that we aren’t pricing ourselves out of the market, and ensures that we aren’t selling finished products below cost. Success in achieving the above mentioned items will result in the potential for top line growth and margin improvements, which are key areas of focus for 2026.

Skills:

• Analytical mindset
• Ability to work cross functionally with Finance, Manufacturing Engineers & potentially Product Managers
• Understanding of cost accounting and interest in Manufacturing
• Sees the importance of data integrity, as it’s the foundation for making business decisions

This role is best suited for anyone currently enrolled in a Bachelor of Accounting or Finance degree, with interest in Manufacturing. jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Payment Interfaces builds and operates the APIs and services that power payment experiences across Block, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Our systems process payment traffic worldwide, helping sellers accept payments and customers move money reliably and securely.

You’ll design, build, and scale customer-facing payment APIs and the critical systems behind them. You’ll bring experience in payments, lead complex projects from design through production, and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll learn the specifics of Block’s products and payment processing on the job.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ongoing operational responsibility. Alongside building new capabilities, you’ll maintain high-volume production systems, participate in on-call and incident response, and make improvements that prevent recurring problems. You’ll use AI throughout your work while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of what you ship.

You Will

• Design, build, maintain, and scale customer-facing payment APIs with clear contracts, predictable behavior, and compatibility that developers can rely on.

• Lead complex projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, plan incremental delivery, and own testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance.

• Operate critical payment systems serving worldwide traffic. Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and follow through on fixes that improve reliability.

• Improve performance, observability, fault tolerance, and security. Use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and make systems safer to change.

• Work with product and engineering partners across Block to turn payment requirements into reusable capabilities.

• Use AI-assisted tools for design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Critically evaluate their output and help teammates adopt approaches that improve quality and delivery.

• Shape technical decisions within the team and develop others through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

You Have

• Experience building, maintaining, and scaling customer-facing financial or payment APIs, together with a strong understanding of payments. This is a requirement for the role.

• Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available distributed systems where correctness, security, and reliability matter.

• An understanding of payment API concerns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, backward compatibility, and handling partial failures without compromising financial correctness.

• A record of leading complex engineering projects from unclear requirements through production, making technical trade-offs, and coordinating work with partner teams.

• Experience diagnosing production issues and improving systems through monitoring, incident response, and preventive engineering.

• Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and the judgment to validate generated code, protect sensitive data, and recognize when deeper investigation is needed.

• Clear written communication and experience helping other engineers develop their technical skills.

• A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

Technologies We Use and Teach

• Kotlin

• Go

• TypeScript

• AWS

• Kafka

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager, Custom Products at Roland Foods will have end-to-end ownership of project execution specific to customer-driven product commercialization for the Roland portfolio. This will include supporting overall business growth objectives across all customer channels (i.e. food service, retail, industrial, international) through custom production formulations and packaging requests.  It is an exciting time for the Manager to join, as Roland continues to invest in custom product sourcing with the newly expanded function of the Custom Products & Innovation team to drive the value of the Roland brand. The Manager will have the opportunity to ‘think big’ and partner with sales to pitch new product commercialization ideas to drive the legacy of Roland as an industry leader in sourcing global ingredients.

This role is ideal for a person with an interest in the food industry or CPG/Grocery, who is looking to develop their project management experience and lead with significant autonomy.  The Manager will operate at multiple levels, from project oversight to supplier management and product formulation development alongside our team. To be successful in the role, the person must be willing to do the day-to-day tactical work alongside the strategic planning.  The day-to-day work will be the execution of supplier communication, coordinating product formulation cuttings, and partnering closely with Sales/Sales Operations, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Revenue Management, International Logistics, Supply Chain, and Creative/Marketing to ensure seamless integration of products within the Roland portfolio. This position will sit in Roland’s Custom Products & Innovation team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Custom Products.

Roland Foods office employees have transitioned to a hybrid working schedule, requiring employees to report in-person Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to telework on Monday and Friday each week. Due to the collaborative, cross-functional nature of the organization, employees at the NY and NJ offices are required to work in-person for the abovementioned days, outside of any People & Culture-approved disability accommodation request.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the Roland Foods innovation pipeline project flow

• Lead communication with existing and new suppliers to source new products in addition to supporting supplier onboarding alongside the cross-functional team

• Partner with the cross-functional team to define target product specifications and manage cuttings to determine the optimal specification/product formulation

• Own on-time commercialization of custom items, including training content for bonus item Sales training meetings

• Partner with the Sales team to identify new product commercialization opportunities (e.g. retail private label projects)

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

Required

• 1-3 years of experience in a Project Management, Consulting, Commercialization, or Product Strategy capacity

Preferred

• Bachelor’s Degree, preferably with a focus in Business/ Business Administration or related field

• Experience in CPG/FMCG or Retail strongly preferred

• Strong verbal & written communication abilities

• Exceptional time management skills

• Prior experience operating within strict deadlines

SALARY RANGE

Roland Foods hires exceptional people to perform a wide variety of important functions that contribute to the success of the Company. One of the ways Roland Foods does that is through a competitive compensation package. The base salary for this role will be $100,000 - $105,000.

This role will be bonus eligible.

jobs.title: Staff UX Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Staff UX Designer

We’re looking for a Staff UX Designer to play a key role in shaping the next phase of Quince’s digital product experience.

This is a senior, hands-on IC role for a designer who can lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution, establish strong UX direction, and raise the quality of product design across the team. You’ll thrive here if you’re energized by a fast-moving startup environment, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and able to balance customer needs, business goals, data, and strong product judgment.

A key focus of this role will be helping Quince build with an app-first mentality. You’ll bring deep experience designing native mobile experiences and help us think beyond translating web experiences to smaller screens—identifying opportunities to make our app more intuitive, engaging, and distinctly valuable to customers.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Brand to shape experiences across iOS, Android, and web, spanning the full e-commerce journey from discovery and PDPs to checkout, order management, and post-purchase.

This role will be reporting to our Design Director.

*Please include portfolio/samples of work to be considered.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end UX for high-impact, complex product initiatives, from defining the problem and experience strategy through detailed design, testing, iteration, and launch.

• Help champion an app-first design mentality, identifying how native mobile behaviors, interaction patterns, and capabilities can create better experiences rather than simply adapting web patterns for mobile.

• Shape core e-commerce experiences across discovery, browsing, PDPs, cart, checkout, account, order management, and post-purchase.

• Establish strong UX direction for your areas of ownership, connecting individual features and initiatives into a cohesive end-to-end customer experience.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to influence product strategy, prioritization, and roadmaps, bringing a strong customer and UX perspective to decisions early in the process.

• Work extensively within and help evolve our design system, identifying opportunities to improve and extend components, patterns, and interaction standards across app and web.

• Partner with designers and engineers on design system implementation, ensuring components and patterns are scalable, flexible, and thoughtfully applied across platforms.

• Partner with Product and Analytics on experimentation and A/B testing, translating learnings into meaningful improvements to UX, engagement, and conversion.

• Use research, customer insights, behavioral data, and design judgment to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

• Bring strong interaction design thinking to the product, including micro-interactions, motion, transitions, and native app behaviors where they meaningfully improve usability and engagement.

• Maintain a high level of visual craft and attention to detail, creating experiences that feel polished, intuitive, and consistent with the Quince brand.

• Provide mentorship and high-quality feedback to other designers, helping raise the team's standards for UX thinking, systems, and execution.

• Communicate design rationale and recommendations effectively to cross-functional partners and senior leadership, building alignment around complex product decisions.

Qualifications

Required

• 7+ years of product design experience, ideally with e-commerce, marketplace, or consumer-facing digital products.

• Deep experience designing native mobile products for iOS and Android, with a strong understanding of mobile interaction patterns, platform conventions, and how app experiences should differ from responsive web.

• A strong app-first product mindset and demonstrated experience identifying opportunities to use native mobile capabilities to create more useful and engaging customer experiences.

• Experience leading complex, high-impact product initiatives with significant autonomy, from early problem definition through launch and iteration.

• Significant experience working with and contributing to mature design systems, including evolving existing patterns and introducing scalable new ones.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, libraries, variables, prototyping, and scalable design practices.

• Experience collaborating closely with Engineering on design system implementation, including component behavior, states, responsiveness, platform considerations, and consistency.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end customer journeys and the ability to think beyond individual screens or features.

• Strong understanding of core e-commerce experiences, including discovery, shopping, cart, checkout, account, and post-purchase.

• Experience using research, usability testing, experimentation, and quantitative data to inform and validate design decisions.

• Strong interaction design skills and thoughtfulness around micro-interactions, motion, and native app behaviors.

• Strong attention to detail and visual judgment, with the ability to create polished experiences that align with an established brand.

• Curiosity and a strong point of view on AI and emerging design tools, including how they can improve exploration, efficiency, prototyping, and the broader design process.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate a clear point of view, navigate tradeoffs, and influence cross-functional partners.

• Experience mentoring other designers and helping elevate the quality of a broader design team.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$202,000—$229,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

The Opportunity:

Mattel is seeking a Director, Corporate Finance, Global Technology Organization to provide oversight, thought-leadership, implementation, support and organization leadership and optimization of the technology landscape and systems supporting Finance business areas (including ERP and EPM) within the Global Technology Organization. Based in El Segundo, CA and reporting to the VP of Corporate and Commercial Applications, IT, this role plays a pivotal part in achieving the strategic objectives of the Finance Department.

The Director will partner closely with departments across Finance, to ensure chosen platforms, such as Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials platform, deliver secure, accurate, compliant and efficient operations. This platform has recently gone live and management of its stabilization and backlog will be key to its critical ongoing success. The Director will lead the Finance IT Team, oversee system project implementations and enhancements, system configuration, integrations, managing vendor relationships, compliance and driving continuous improvement, and initiatives that support business growth and operational excellence, while keeping team motivated and engaged.

What Your Impact Will Be:

Operational Leadership

• Work with Finance and execute the technology and AI roadmap to support the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform.
• Partner with Finance Leadership to ensure accurate Financial operations through the use of the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform
• Lead system releases, upgrades, testing and change management activities.
• Oversee integrations and integration challenges between legacy systems and 3rd party vendors
• Lead administration, configuration, enhancement, and support of the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financial platform
• Lead interaction of other large-scale Enterprise projects with the Financials platform
• Ensure SOX, audit, data privacy and security compliance.
• Ensure governance processes for configuration management, production support, issue resolution, and system documentation are adhered to
• Analyze financials, identify trends, and assess budget compliance for the team.
• Manage relationships with implementation partners, and third-party vendors.
• Lead Corporate Finance project portfolio, including new applications, functionality, system integrations, and transformation initiatives.
• Develop departmental budgets, resource plans, service level agreements, and performance metrics.

Continuous Improvement

• Drive system innovation, AI, establishing scalable, best-in-class system design and implementations ad enhancements to support evolving business needs

Leadership & Team Development

• Mentor and develop a team of 16+ Finance IT professionals based both in the US, as well as an expanding team in Hyderabad, India.
• Lead performance management, training, AI and professional development initiatives
• Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing IT managers, analysts, and technical professionals.

What We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Business Administration, Human Resources Information Systems, or a related field
• Master’s Degree preferred; MBA strongly desired
• 10+ years of progressive IT experience supporting enterprise, large-scale Finance systems.
• 7+ years of leadership experience managing in-house technical teams and enterprise applications.

• Strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities and business acumen
• Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials configuration, reporting, workflows, security, integrations, APIs and data management for both ERP and EPM.
• Demonstrated success leading enterprise software implementations and digital transformation initiatives, as well as support organizations.
• Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive presence and communication skills.
• Internal candidates to be considered based on experience relative to the position

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft Fabric Architect and Consulting Lead
jobs.location: St. Louis, MO | Chesterfield, MO | Hybrid | Remote
jobs.description:
The Technology Department of one of the fastest-growing accounting firms in the country is seeking a Senior Microsoft Fabric Architect and Consulting Lead who is motivated to learn, excited to collaborate and passionate about delivering outstanding results. This individual will have a direct impact on our firm’s mission of serving as a catalyst for those striving to achieve their highest potential.

The Sr Microsoft Fabric Architect and Consulting Lead is responsible for designing, architecting, and guiding the delivery of enterprise data and analytics solutions primarily leveraging Microsoft Fabric and related MS family of products (Power Platform Copilot, etc.). This role leads clients, data teams, and technology stakeholders in value identification, compelling understanding of enterprise intelligence, and defining scalable, secure, maintainable, and practical data platform solutions.

Positioned as a senior technical and consulting role, the Sr. Microsoft Fabric Architect leads client engagements from discovery and solution design through implementation, adoption, and transition. This role serves as a trusted technical advisor to clients while providing architectural direction to Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, consultants, and other delivery team members. The Architect is responsible for ensuring technical quality, effective communication, sound governance, and successful client outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

Client Engagement and Consulting Leadership

• Serve as the senior technical and consulting lead for Microsoft Fabric client engagements.

• Lead client discovery sessions, architecture workshops, roadmap discussions, and executive briefings.

• Build strong relationships with client executives, business leaders, data teams, and technology stakeholders.

• Translate business goals, operating needs, and technical constraints into clear architecture and delivery recommendations.

• Communicate complex technical concepts in plain language appropriate for both executive and technical audiences.

• Establish engagement expectations, decision processes, working agreements, and communication cadence.

• Manage client concerns, difficult conversations, competing priorities, and changing requirements with professionalism.

• Provide clear recommendations, identify tradeoffs, and help clients make informed decisions.

• Identify follow-on opportunities where additional advisory, data, analytics, automation, or AI services could create client value.

Engagement Management

• Lead assigned client engagements with accountability for scope, schedule, budget awareness, quality, risks, and outcomes.

• Coordinate delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, and responsibilities across Anders and client teams.

• Monitor engagement progress and proactively communicate status, decisions, risks, issues, and required client actions.

• Partner with project managers and practice leaders on estimates, staffing, utilization, and delivery planning.

• Contribute to proposals, statements of work, assumptions, scope definitions, and change requests.

• Ensure deliverables are complete, understandable, and aligned with client expectations before presentation or release.

• Support adoption, knowledge transfer, and transition planning so clients can operate and extend delivered solutions.

Team and Delivery Leadership

• Lead and coordinate Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, consultants, and other specialists assigned to an engagement.

• Provide clear direction, delegate effectively, and maintain accountability for team commitments and delivery quality.

• Facilitate team working sessions, architecture reviews, design decisions, and code reviews.

• Coach team members on consulting behaviors, client communication, technical standards, and delivery practices.

• Resolve delivery blockers and escalate issues early when client outcomes, scope, or quality are at risk.

• Create a collaborative environment across Anders, client, and third-party teams.

Architecture and Solution Design

• Lead the architecture and design of end-to-end Microsoft Fabric solutions.

• Define enterprise data platform strategy centered on OneLake.

• Design Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Engineering, semantic modeling, and Power BI architectures.

• Establish Medallion Architecture standards across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.

• Define Direct Lake, data integration, orchestration, and reusable engineering patterns.

• Create architecture diagrams, data flow maps, decision records, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, supportable, and aligned with client business goals.

Platform Governance and Operations

• Establish security architecture, including workspace design, role-based access control, row-level security, and data access standards.

• Define Microsoft Fabric governance, data ownership, development, deployment, and support frameworks.

• Lead capacity planning, performance management, and workload optimization.

• Implement monitoring, observability, data quality, lineage, and operational practices.

• Oversee continuous integration, continuous delivery, environment promotion, and deployment automation.

What We’re Looking For:

• Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Engineering, semantic models, Power BI, and Fabric Pipelines.

• Strong experience with SQL, Python, PySpark, and Azure Data Factory or comparable data integration and orchestration technologies.

• Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, including Medallion Architecture, data modeling, data integration, governance, security, and production data environments.

• Experience designing scalable and secure enterprise data platforms and establishing associated governance and operating models.

• Experience with capacity planning, performance optimization, monitoring, observability, data quality, lineage, and deployment automation.

• Strong understanding of cloud data and analytics technologies, preferably within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.

• Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft AI Foundry, or Azure AI Services is preferred.

• Proven ability to lead technical teams and coordinate work across business, technical, and project stakeholders.

• Demonstrated consulting experience, including client discovery, solution design, executive presentations, and technical advisory responsibilities.

• Experience contributing to project estimates, proposals, statements of work, and delivery planning.

• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

• Strong consultative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to provide direct recommendations, communicate technical tradeoffs, and guide clients through complex decisions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong client relationships and delivery quality.

• High level of professionalism and client-facing confidence.

Your Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• 8+ years of progressive experience designing and delivering enterprise data, analytics, or technology platforms.

• 3+ years of experience working with Microsoft Fabric or an equivalent modern data platform.

• Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, or other relevant Microsoft Fabric certification preferred.

• Additional certifications related to Azure, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, or solution architecture are a plus.

The stated pay scale reflects the range that Anders reasonably expects to pay for this position.  The actual pay rate for this position will be dependent on a variety of factors, including an applicant’s years of experience, unique skills and abilities, education, alignment with similar internal candidates, marketplace factors, other requirements for the position, and firm business practices.

Salary Range

$150,000—$180,000 USD

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

At Anders, taking care of our employees is a top priority. Our welcoming and collaborative culture will make you feel like a part of the team from day one. From professional development opportunities to benefits that directly impact mental, physical and financial wellness, Anders offers unique incentives that enrich your life and facilitate growth, including our Work Flex program which gives you the opportunity to work at our Chesterfield office, our Downtown St. Louis office, remotely, adopt a hybrid approach or even switch between these options as you prefer. Learn more about our full benefit offerings, Work Flex program, and our Inclusion Network at our careers page: anderscpa.com/careers/working-at-anders/

For 60 years, Anders has delivered full-service accounting, tax, audit and advisory services to growth-oriented companies, organizations and individuals. Every day, our partners and staff serve as a catalyst for those striving to achieve their highest potential and carry this mentality on to our clients and community. Ranked #75 on Accounting Today’s List of Top Accounting Firms and continually named a Top Workplace, Anders is a member firm of LEA Global, one of the largest international associations of independent accounting firms. At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. If designated as hybrid, you’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office location, so you should live within commuting distance. If designated as remote, you’ll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. Your hiring manager can share more about this role’s hybrid or remote designation.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

Small business owners don’t separate their marketing from their money. They think about getting paid, covering payroll, and keeping the lights on — often in the same afternoon. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager on our Commerce team, you’ll own the go-to-market for the GoDaddy products that sit right in the middle of that: capital, instant payouts, business banking and debit cards, and insurance.

This is a hybrid of product marketing and go-to-market. You’ll define positioning, packaging, and pricing for our financial services solutions, and you’ll cross-sell them to the entrepreneurs who already run their business on GoDaddy Payments. You’ll own the story, the audiences, and the campaigns that put the right offer in front of the right customer at the right moment.

You’ll make sure the customer’s voice comes through in every value proposition, building a differentiated message that resonates with everyday entrepreneurs trying to grow. And you’ll work closely with product, sales, and partner teams to launch these solutions well — delighting our customers and driving company growth.

What you'll get to do...

• Develop and execute product marketing strategies for financial services offerings, including messaging, positioning, pricing, packaging, and content that drives customer engagement and sales enablement.

• Lead customer lifecycle marketing programs, building targeted campaigns, audience segments, and ideal customer profiles that improve engagement, adoption, and cross-sell opportunities.

• Design and run experiments across product surfaces to test messaging, offers, and features, using insights and performance data to optimize outcomes.

• Support major product launches and independently lead go-to-market efforts for new products and features, partnering across teams to drive successful adoption.

• Conduct customer, competitive, and market research, translating qualitative and quantitative insights into recommendations that inform messaging, positioning, pricing, and product strategy.

Your experience should include...

• 7+ years of product marketing experience, including 4+ years in SaaS and 2+ years in payments or financial services.

• Strong understanding of small business customers, with experience conducting customer research, in-market testing, and developing insights that inform go-to-market strategies.

• Experience running experiments and testing within product surfaces to support data-driven decision making across self-serve and sales-led B2B motions.

• Track record of successfully launching new products and features, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments using a test-and-learn approach.

You might also have...

• Experience in pricing and packaging analysis.

• Experience marketing regulated or partner-delivered financial products.

• Deep customer empathy that influences both product and marketing efforts.

jobs.title: Counsel
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking a commercially minded, technology-savvy attorney to join our legal team and support a broad range of media buying, advertising technology, performance media and agency-related matters. This role will serve as a key legal partner to marketing, media, influencer engagement, procurement, privacy, technology and business stakeholders, providing practical advice on sophisticated digital advertising arrangements as well as traditional media buying and agency engagements.  The Counsel position is in Mattel’s corporate headquarters in El Segundo, CA.

What Your Impact Will Be:

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative and evolving legal team, take ownership of high-impact matters and expand the role as the company’s media, advertising technology and performance marketing activities continue to grow.   This position involves managing a large range and high volume of media and agency transactions. This position requires an ability to effectively work within and manage a sophisticated forms-contract practice. This position will evolve over time as Mattel’s business and legal needs evolve

What We’re Looking For:

The ability to provide thoughtful, proactive, strategic legal and business advice. Skilled at identifying issues early, and then creatively solving them, as well as spotting company-wide trends and building a consensus in managing them efficiently on a company-wide basis. A team player who can multi-task and work well under pressure, with frequently changing priorities and sometimes conflicting objectives. Excellent negotiating, drafting, and practice-management skills. Maintain a professional demeanor, in writing and in person, with support staff, business colleagues, senior management, and outside counsel. An ability to adopt technology solutions and seek efficiencies in managing work. High ethical standards. An ability to “manage up” and play well with others. A sense of humor is a plus.

The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of relevant legal experience, including meaningful experience with digital media, advertising technology, data-driven marketing or media agency agreements.

The attorney should understand how modern advertising campaigns are planned, purchased, measured and optimized across digital platforms and should be comfortable translating complex legal, technical and commercial issues into clear, actionable guidance.

Professional Licensing: Good standing in at least one state bar and, if not licensed to practice in California, an ability and willingness to register to practice in California pursuant to California’s in-house counsel registration requirements.

Education: An undergraduate degree, and strong academic performance at a J.D. from a highly-rated law school.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here!

How We Work:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer -  Account Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

WHY SAFETY?

At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world.

WHY Account Infrastructure

Authenticating and authorizing the Roblox user base sets the foundation for every other feature on our platform. Users must be confident that their accounts are not used without their permission; we must empower them with auth/security controls that meet each user’s needs and just-in-time friction that adapts to each user’s unique risk profile. On top of that, we must offer these features in a way that will scale to 1 billion active users. As a member of the Account Auth Infra Team, you will have a rare opportunity to sit at the convergence of adversarial problem solving and high scalability engineering. You will report to the Engineering Manager of Account Authentication.

You Will:

• Assume ownership of the complete lifecycle for full-stack features within Auth Infra, encompassing technical specification, implementation, rollout, monitoring, and iteration, ensuring alignment with the designated pod roadmap.

• Engage in close collaboration with partner teams in Application Security, Roblox Core Services, and the broader Roblox Safety org.

• Define the architectural direction for scaling account authentication and security.

• Contribute to and maintain user authentication and security infra.

• Take complete responsibility for projects throughout their entire lifecycle.

• Drive cross-functional engagement and lead technical initiatives to ensure the widespread adoption and success of our core safety applications.

• Report directly to the Manager of Account Authentication.

You Have:

• 5+ years of experience in software development.

• Distributed Systems Architecture: Proven ability to design and implement robust, high-throughput microservices (handling thousands of requests per second) while maintaining a strict focus on system safety and security.

• Full-Stack Proficiency: Experience with both front-end (e.g., React, Vue, Angular) and back-end technologies (e.g.,= Python, Java, Go) to deliver end-to-end features.

• Safety-Driven Mindset: A strong commitment to designing, implementing, and maintaining systems that prioritize user safety, data integrity, and compliance with safety policies.

• Equivalent experience or a BS in Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, or another technical field.

• Curious to learn new technologies and systematically grow your skills.

You Are:

• Experienced (4+ years): You have extensive experience as a full-stack engineer, proficient in back-end development, working on complex, production-grade systems end-to-end.

• Analytical & Data-Driven: You possess a strong ability to instrument, collect, and analyze user interaction data (e.g., A/B testing, usage metrics) to inform design decisions and continuously maximize user impact and product performance.

• Versatile & Adaptable: We work in Rust, Go, and C# and are currently revamping our development flows to incorporate AI wherever possible.

• Team-Player & Technical Leader: You are a collaborative team member who actively mentors peers, drives technical excellence, and takes ownership of leading and delivering key features and projects across team boundaries.

• AI native: You are eager to define and build AI-centric solutions, incorporating modern machine learning and agentic AI capabilities directly into the core user experience and system architecture.

The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand.
